tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā sbya muḥ/(sbya 085305nga000ji 'ang 5055'acu 7 bci kho migaX 507 khor
zhes 7/la
gangs can yul gyi sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal blon gtso bor brjod pa'i deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/mi rigs dpe skrun khang

deb 'di ni lha sa'i par gzhi rnying pa gzhir bzung na bsgrig pa zhig min/tsāgegyisgro tshe ca'itshe thongarngo/)75thongar thaba'agyi bod kyi deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/rgyal dbang lnga pa chen mos brtsams pa/mi ririgs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa/1957lo'i 10par par gzhi 1po bsgrig pa/ 80lo'i 11par spre cin la par thengs 2pa brgyab pa/deb rer ra rgyar skur 6

(67995 7 she/sgo77〉(9nya ༄snye 77 —— ru ri sa byebye) pho ṣṭha / ri( 97 ri bye tso na shi'imi sna ((7 7 6 (1 sdupo she 4 cho ṣṭha ri ( 7 83 4sle 3—zhi na rdzo gyi tyā//gasdong 'tsha ngo ṣka snya bzhad rsā /

—47/ /bskal pa bzang po'i blta na sdag pa'i grong khyer dbus na 'jigs bral snying stobs gser gyi gdodan khri la//grags snyan nor bu'i rna rgyan 'od gzi mngon par rab 'bar chos kun ma lus gzigs pa'i mig stong can//mtha' gnyis bcud bral sder bcas bcom pa'i rgyal rnga stong brdungs stobs bcu mnga' ba mkhar nyal tshogs kyi dpal//bla na mtho ba'i khyu mchog zas gtsang sras po 'chi med gtso bos 'jig rten gsum du dge legs mdzod/ 'chi ba'i dngos po rnam par 'joms pa'i gzhom med tshe yi g.yung drung rtag pa'i rdo rje gang //longs su spyod la zad mi shes par 'dod pa 'jo ba'i 'byung gnas mchog gi gan mdzod kyi//khyab bdag dbang por dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyis legs bsngags tshe dang ye shes dbag tu med// tshe dpal yongs 'du'i smon pa dus su smin pa'i dngos grub 'bras bu bla na med pa stsol//

lha tshard dngar ba'i mkhyen pa'i ge sar gzhon nu'i lang tsho'i lcags kya //tha ra chos kun ri dwags mig can ma yi snying la bsnun pa'i rang dbang du//'du rjibral zlos gar ri mo'i snang brnyan chos nyid me long gtsang ma'i rjen pabye /'a/char ba'i byed po zur phud lnga pa mgrin pa'i rgyan du bzhuṭa//snang mdzod 'bum gyi dra bas 'khyud pa'i byu ru'i rdul brtsegs la//brtan /yo'i dngos kun dbang du byed pa'i yon tan yongs rdzogs zur /rdo /nya/ga phran tsam gyis dge ba'i gzugs can 'dus ma byas//'dar mdzad rig byed lha mos srid pa gsum la mnga' sgyur cig/yid 'ong bzhin ras zla gzhon 'khor lo gnyis skyes la//'khrul ba ster yang 'phyang mo sel byed mgo skyes kyi//be ḍūr mthing kha'i lan bu rab 'phyang dbyangs can ma//smra ba'i dbang phyug ngag gi rgyal po nyer grub mdzod//gangs can lha lam yangs pa'i khyon 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa bcu gnyis bdag po'i gur khang mchog mkhyen brtse nus pa'i nam mkha'i gru yis nye bar 'dren mdzad chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang //rgyal ba kun dngos mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i rtsa lag thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i//bka' drin gzugs can dbyig 'dzin sto 'dir shong 'gyur min na kun mkhyen srang las gang gis gzhal//

3—li khri'i lcag phran mkhyen pa'i snang ba can//'jam marshan blo yi lang tsho bzang po'i tshon//kha dog so sor bkra ba'i grags pa'i rgyan//phyogs bral rna lung 'god mkhas rtag tu rgyal/dpal ldan chos kyi rang bzhin ngos yangs par /gnas lnga'i bang mdzod 'byor par lhun grub pa'i//mnga' sgyur bgrod byed ba ji wa ka//rmad byung cod pan mchog tu rnam par bsngags//rgya hor lung dang rigs kyis mngon mtho zhing //bka' khrims gser 'khor mchog dman gnya' gnon pa'i//sa rgya'i 'jam mgon dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung //chos ldan sa skyong rgyal por su mi dad//smra ba'i 'bab stegs mdud pa'i rgyar bcings kyang //mthon po'i khri la dregs pas 'gying min pa'i//legs bshad gtam gyi 'byung gnas blo ldan can//gang du gnas kyang dang ba'i sgo ba 'phel//ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul pad dkar tshal//ches cher bdo ba snyigs ma'i bsil zer gyis//zum pa'i dus 'dir deb ther gtam rgyud sogs//brjod pa rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu ru zad//khyad par bcu phrag rig pa'i chu gter che//

6gsungs pas/ slad nas kyang lo rgyus la 'dris par 'dod pa'i blo ldan dag gis dpyad par bya'o/ /de yang ston pa 'di nyid kyi gdung la nyi ma'i gnyen dang bu ram shing pa shākya zhes brjod pa ni/ yul gru 'dzin du rgyal po brgya tham pa byung ba'i mtha' ma rna ba can gyi bu gi ta ma dang bha ra dhra dza gnyis las/ sngon mas rab tu byung ste lo ma'i spyil po yid du 'ong ba'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur gnas pa'i tshe/g.yo can padma'i rtsa lag dang bzang mo dga' mgur spyod pa'i dus las yol bas/ bzang mo bsad pa'i ral gri khrug can lo ma'i spyil po'i nye 'dabs su bor ba'i rkyen gyis gi ta ma bsal shing la bskyon pa'i dus/ drang srong mdog nag gi rdzu 'phrul gyis gru char gyi thigs pa dang / dri bzhon lus la reg pa'i rkyen gyis 'dod pa'i gnas rjes su dran pa'i yid kyi shing rtas drangs te/ khams kyi dwangs ma gnyis lhan cig tu lhang ba las sgo nga gnyis su gyur pa nyi 'od kyis bskyangs shing khye'u gnyis bu ramacu gyi shing gseb tu zhugs pas ming de ltar du grags la/ bu ram shing pa'i brgyud la rgyal po brgya byung ba'i mtha' ma 'phags skyes po/ 'phags skyes po la sras bzhi byung yang btsun mo 'das te slar stobs ldan gyi rgyal po gzhan zhig gi bu mo khab tu blangs par sras byung na rgyal srid du dbang bskur bar khas blangs pas dam bcas/ sras sngon ma rnams sprugs pa rang rang gi sring mo dang bcas te chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram du ming sring lhan cig tu 'dus pa las shākya'i brgyud ces grags pa yin no//de yang kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen 'di nyid 'khrungs lor mkhas grub rnams kyi bzhed tshul mang du mchis kyang don grub ces pa sa lug dbyar zla 'bring po'i chu stod kyi nya ba'i tshes bco lnga'i dus su/ yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lhums su glang po che'i phrug gu thal dkar gyi rnam par gyur nas zhugs/

7zla ba bcu phal cher lon pa legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad du ru dra zhes pa bsil ldan pa rnams drag por brjod pa/ rgya nag pa dbang thang dang bstan pa'i ming ging shing / bod yul du lcags pho spre'ur 'bod pa'i dpyid tha sa rshas nya ba me tog can gyi zla ba/ rgya nag pa si yol du brjod pa'i yar ngo'i tshe sa bdun gyi res gza' 'od zer bdun pa dang / las skar rgyal la babs pa na lu ni'i nags su sku bltams/ de nas lang tsho'i kun rnam par rgyas pa'i zil mngar gyi sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi'i yal 'dab kyi yon tan kun la rang gir bgyis shing /padmo'i snyems pa thogs pa'i ri dwags mig can gyi don yongs su tshang ba'i grags 'dzin ma dang sa mtsho ma sogs btsun mor dbang bskur te lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du nyi 'og gi rgyal phran gnyis 'thung gi spyi bor 'jigs pa med pa'i rgyal thabs kyi bya ba'i skad gsang mthon pos rang byan du 'gying bar dbang thob na'ang / mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad pha ston pa'i ched du/ dgung lo nyer dgu pa kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi ba la rang byung gi sgo nas/ rab byung gi dngos po yongs su rdzogs te/ lo drug tu dka' ba spyad pas lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa las gzhan du gyur pa na/ dga' mo dang dga' stobs mas ba stong gi 'o ma lan bcu drug gi bar du nying khur byas pa'i 'o thug bang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis sku su warṇa'i mchod sdong nyi gzhon 'bum gyis 'khyud pa ltar gyur te rdo rje gdan du byang chub kyi shing drung na 'chi med bdag pos rtswa 'tshong gi rnam par sprul te phul ba'i rtswa'i gdan la bzhugs nas/ chu srin rgyal mtshan can sde dang bcas pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsgrengs te/ dgung lo so lnga pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing rta'i sa gas nya ba'i bco lnga'i skya rengs shar ba na ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsi mngon du mdzad do/ /mdo las/ de'i nyin mo zla ba sgro gcan gyis bzung

8ba dang / sgra gcan 'dzin dang bdud rtsi zas kyi khye'u zhig kyang skyes par bshad pa'i gza' 'dzin gyi ri mo ni gza' gnas su gcig chu tshod so brgyad zla skar gyi skar gnas su bcu drug chu tshod stong pa sgra gcan gdong gi skar mar bcu drugachu tshod nyer dgu byung bas gza' 'dzin gyi ri mo ni tshad ma'i ā darsha gtsang ma'i ngos su gsal bar shar ba yin no/ /de nas zhag zhe dgu'i bar du dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo brgya ma phye ba'i tshul bstan pas/ 'jig rten gyi byed po gser mngal can gyis skal pa mchog gi bzang po'i dpal dang ldan pa'i don du gsol ba la brten nas/mchog dman gyi gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tsham par zab rgyas chos kyi sgo glegs rnam par bkral nas theg pa che chung gi rigs can gyi yol go/ rang 'dod pa'i tshogs mtha' dag gcig tu 'jo ba'i ro zad mi shes pa mkha' khyab tu bro ba'i 'khor lo bskor te/ mthar gyad kyi yul rtswa mchog gi grong du dgung lo gya gcig pa dpa' bo zhes pa lcags 'brug gi lor mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po chos kyi sku'i mkha' klong du sna tshogs pa'i sprul sku'i zlos gar gyis rol pa'i chu 'dzin gyi gzugs sku tha mi dad pa'i mdzad pa bstan to/ / de ltar bstan pa rin po che yul dbus 'gyur nas char dus kyi dal 'gro'i klung rang babs su 'gyur ba'i gshis lugs bzhin tha grur khyab pa las/'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge gya gcig pa chu 'brug slo nag nyar shrī bhā nu ka ṭa spur gsang ba kun gyi gan mdzod rnam par 'dzin pa'i mi'i dbang phyug zla ba bzang por ska lo ka stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid can gyi dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs pa shambha lar spyan drangs nas ma la ya'i skyed tshal du sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi snang brnyan ye shes kyi gzi byin mngon par 'bar ba'i sgyu ma'i gar gyis rtsen pa'i

0'dren byed kyi dga' ston gsar pa bskrun te/ rdo rje theg pa'i bgo skal ka lā pa'i grong khyer gyi skye rgar 'gyed pa'i mu mtha' bral ba'i mdzad pa nas bzung 'jigs pa med pa'i rshadong lnga'i khri la bgrod byed rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i ri mo mchog tu bkra ba'i chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gsum du byon pa mtha' dag gis phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor ba'i gsang chen nā da'i sgra dbyangs kyi nor bu'i 'phyang 'phrul las ldan gyi rna bar spud par mdzad pa'i tha ma/ drag po'i 'khor lo can gyis dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad par kla klo'i dpung tshogs mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar byas nas snga na med pas sa chen po'i khor yug kun tu khyab pas mdzad do/ /de yang rigs ldan drag po dgung lo lnga bcu'i steng du kla klo bcom par bzhed pa ltar na/ kla klo'i gnas tshad stong dang brgyad brgyar bshad pa las lo grangs bzhi bcu rtsa bdun tsam mi 'grig pa'i skyon yod cing / de dag rags rtsis su 'chad na zhib rtsis ni 'byang ba'i skabs med pas gzur gnas kyi shes ldan rnams soms shig de rmor sham bha las mtshon te/ o rgyan/bal yul/ rgya hor sogs su bstan pa byung tshul ni mtha' yas kyang mang gis dogs pas ma spros so/ /: skabs su babs pa rang cag gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa shar tshul ni/de yang zla gzhon lan brgyar bzhus pa'i khu bas byugs pa'i man shel gyi lhun po'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba lta bu'i gangs ri'i 'dab mas khor mo yug tu 'khrigs pa'i yul ljongs 'dir mi'i 'gro ba chags tshul la/ mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed tshul mtha' klas shing / 'ga' zhig ni rang nyid kyi lugs kho na la zhen pa'i lung rigs kyi dpyad pa med par lugs gzhan dag rnams tshad ldan ma yin pa kho nar smra ba'i gtam gyi 'brug sgras/ chos spong gi rma bya rang dbang

10med par dga' ba'i las kyi sgrib pa'i sgro gshog phyogs bcur skyong ba 'ga' mchis na'ang / ris su ma chad pa'i gsung rab kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jing las rnam dpyod gru gzings kyis rang dbang du spyod pa gzhon nu dpal ba'i gsung las/ bod kyi yul 'di yang rgya gar dang 'dra bar/ yul dang mi la sogs pa gnas pa'i bskal pa nas byung bar byas na yang / lung dang rig pa'i gnod pa med cing zhes spyi khyab tu gsungs nas/ lugs gzhan yang 'dren par mdzad pa'i gung 'grig mi 'grig gi brjod bya tsam las mtha' gcig tu gsal bar ma gsungs la/ lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel las bshad pa'i rgyal po ru pa ti dpung bcas/ ri kha ba can gyi khrod du zhugs pa las 'phel ba'i rigs kyang yod srid/ gtso bo ni phyag na padma'i thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyi 'od zer 'gog pa med par shar bas/ gangs khrod kyi 'gro ba'i pad tshal rnam par rgyas pa zhig ste/ de dag gi tshul gnas lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i pa ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī two nas ka ba shing lo can gyi byang ngos nas bzhes pa'i bka' 'khol ma dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs gangs can gyi ljongs na dar ro cog gi thugs rje chen po'i chos skor du ma zhig dgongs pa'i khog gcig pa las/spre'u dang brag srin mo lhan cig tu 'dus pa'i phrug gu gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs su bshad pa ltar/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i mngal khur las 'thon pa'i gsung gi snang ba stsal ba la brten nas/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams su 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon pos dri ma med pa'i 'dren byed kyis gzigs pa na/ stod mnga' ris kyi cha ni glang po che dang ri dwags kyi yul/ bar dbus gtsang gi cha ni ri dgas dang spre'u'i yul/ smad mdo khams kyi cha ni spre'u dang brag srin gyi yul/ de yang stod g.ya' ri dang gangs ri/ bar brag dang spang ljongs/ smad rtsi shing dang nags tshal gyi mal

11ga stag pos dbyig 'dzin gos su klubs pa lta bur rgyu gobo'i 'gro ba kun kyang srong gcod sogs ngan song gi rgyu la bag med du longs spyod pa'i rkyen gyis yul gru de dag gi 'og tu mi zad pa'i duḥkha'i 'byung gnas dmyal ba'i lcags kyi za ma tog 'dra ba'i nang du lhang bar ye shes kyi gzigs pas mkhyen nas 'phags pa rnam gsum bka'i bgro cub las thog mar 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'dul ba'i phul du byung ba'i dgongs pa la bzhugs te 'phags pa phyag stong spyan stong gi sku'i rnam pas lha sa'i thad kyi 'dzin ma'i ngos su byon pas dmyal ba'i gnas kyang yid du 'ong ba'i 'chi med bdag po'i dga' ba'i tshal la skyengs pa ster bar gyur pa lta bu'i snang ba dang bcas te der gnas pa'i sprin mgrin phal cher lha'i bde ba la spyod par dbugs dbyung nas/ bod kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad par yang dud 'gro ni glen zhing gti mug pa'i ngang tshul can la blang dor gyi gnas tshul bzhin ston pa'i mthu dman pas mi'i rigs spel bar dgongs/'phags pa'i thugs rjes rigs bsgyur ba'i spre'u zhig dang / 'phags ma sgrol ma'i byin rlabs kyis ri dgas gzugs brnyan blo'i zla gzhon dngas pa'i ngos su shar ba'i brag srin mo gnyis tshogs pa las rigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa'i spyod tshul mi 'dra ba'i phyug gu drug byung ba yang / pha rigs rnams 'char sgo myur zhing snying rje che ba khog grims pa/ ma rigs rnams gdong dmar sdig las la rngams shing ro gyong ba byung ba de dag las rim par 'phel bas bod mi'i rgyal khams su gyur te/ rus chen bzhi las gyes pa'i khams/ ye sang dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thag can dang gcig ye smon nag mo khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba dang gnyis/ spyang khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsum/ mon rdzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhir dbye ba byung ngo / /༈ de yang rgyal phran bsil ma mang du byung yang 'phags pa mchog gis byin

gyi/2brlabs pa ma mchis shing / khyad par 'gro ba yongs la mnga' sgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig med na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'byung dka' bar dgongs nas/mang pos bkur ba'i brgyud las byang ba'i rgyal po dmag brgya pa zhes bya ba las sras 'phags pas byin rlabs kyi khyod pos mi las 'das pa zhig bltams te/mig mas 'gribs su yod pa/ g.yu'i smin ma can/ so dung so 'khor mar yod pa/ lag pa 'khor lo'i yan lag can lta bur yod pa'i mtshan ldan zhig byung ba/ yab kyis lha 'dre'i sprul par dgongs nas sprugs pas/ pad dkar 'dzin pa'i me shes mchog gi 'od zer gyis snang ba bsgyur nas/ lha ri gyang tho'i rtse la byon nas gzigs pas/ yar klung gi yul ni mtho ris kyi yon tan sa la 'phos pa ltar bzang zhing / yar lha sham po'i gangs ri 'di lhun po'i mdzes sdug la chags pa'i chu shel gyi dbang po nya gang bas 'khyud pa ltar mkhyen nas/ lha ri rol po'i rtse la gshegs nas lha skas la babs te/ btsan thang sgo bzhir zhabs zung gi 'khor lo bskyod pas bon po sogs yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis phyugs skyong bas mthong ste gang nas 'ongs zhes gtam dris par/mkha' la mdzub mo ger bas lha las chad par go nas bod khams kyi rjer 'os so zhes gnya' bar khri byas bteg nas 'ongs pas rje gnya' khri btsan por grags la/ deb sngon du khri btsan po 'od lde zhes pa dang don gcig rje 'dis pho brang yum bu gla sgang brtsigs/ tshe mi gshen gyi rmu rgyal gyi don bsgyur/de dang gnam mug mug gi bras mu khri btsan po/ de dang sa ding ding gi sras ding khri btsan po/ de dang so tham tham gyi sras so khri btsan po/ de dang dog mer mer gyi sras mer khri btsan po/ de dang gdags kyi lha mo dkar mo'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de dang srib kyi lha mo'i sras srib khri btsan po/ 'di rnams rmu thag la byas nas mkha' la yal bas bang so med par grags shing /ri

13gnam gyi khri bdun no//srib khri btsan po dang / sa btsun rlung rje'i sras gri gum btsan po/de dang klu btsan mer lcam la sras gsum byung yang / blon po lo ngam dang 'thabs pas rgyal po bkrongs/ bod du khrab kyi thog ma 'di'i dus smar khams nas blangs/ sras rnams yab mes kyi dkor mdzod nas rte'u glang ru dkar zhes pa'i glang 'phur shes la zhon nas kong po'i phyogs su bros shing yug cig blon pos rgyal srid bzung / mi ring bar rgyal po'i btsun mo dang yar lha sham po'i sprul pa zhig 'dus pa las byung ba'i blon po ru las skyes kyis lo ngam bsad de/sras bya khri rgyal sar bskos/ rje gri gum nas rmu thag chad pas pu ra byung ba zangs kyi ga'ur bcug ste lcags gzer btab nas chu la bskyur ba kong chu rlag tu khyer ba chu srin bye ma lag ring gis brnyed nas jo mor phul ba mdzod du sbas pa las bton nas/ 'phying yul dar thang du bang so brtsigs de bang so'i thog ma yin zhing / yum gyis lha la dmod bor bas nam mkha' nas khyod kyi bu de kun las rgyal bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i sgra byung bas bya khri'i mtshan la thu de gung rgyal zer/ yab kyi ring la zhang zhung dang / bru sha'i gshen gyi dur bon byung zhing / sras kyi ring la sku mkhar phying ba stag rtse brtsigs/ sgrung dang lde'u gnam bon gshen po che byung / ru las skyes dang sras lha bu mgo dkar te blon po gnyis kyi ring / chu yur bar drangs/ spang zhing du rmos/ rdo bzhus pas dngul zangs lcags gsum bton/ chu la zam pa btsugs/ rgyal po de dag bar gyi steng gnyis yin/ bang so g.ya' dang rdza la btab bo/ /spu de gung rgyal dang bom thang ming mnya'i sras e sho legs/ de dang chu lcam bra ma na'i sras de sho legs/ de dang klu sman mer mo'i sras thi sho legs/de dang btsan mo gur sman gyi sras gu ru legs/ de dang mtsho sman 'brang ma'i

sra/'brong legs/ de dang sman bu mo'i sras i sho legs/ de rnams sa'i legs drug ste bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab bo//i sho legs dang rmu lcam smad legs kyi sras za nam zin lde/ di dang mtsho sman khri dkar gyi sras lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ de dang se snyan mang ma'i sras se sgol gnam lde/ de dang klu mo mer ma'i sras se rnol po lde/ de dang 'o ma ste mo mtsho'i sras lde snal nam/ de dang khri sman rje ma'i sras lde snal po/ de dang se btsan gnyan rje'i sras lde rgyal po/ de dang sman tsun lug sgong gi sras lde sprin btsan/ de dag lde brgyad de bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab bo//lde sprin btsan dang nyi btsun mang ma rje'i sras rgyal to ri long btsan/'di yan chad kyi rgyal po rnams lha klu'i bu mo 'ba' zhig btsun mor bsten pas yum rnams grongs pa'i tshe bur ma byung zhing / 'di man nas 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te/ rgyal to ri long btsan dang 'o ma lde bza' 'bri btsun byang ma'i zas su khri btsan nam/ de dang sman bza' khri dkar gyi sras la khri spa dpung btsan/ de dang sman bza' klu steng gi sras khri thog rje btsan te gdung rabs nyer bdun gyi ring chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs pa yin no/ /smras pa/phyag na padma'i gsang ba gsum gyi ngos//bsil ldan ljongs 'di'i rje 'bangs ri mo'i gar//blo gsal yid ngor bsgyur ba'i gtam gyi dpya//lo rgyus thong gis ba ba pa'i skal bar byin//stobs dang longs spyod 'khyog po'i yal ga de//

15blun rmongs tshang tsheng khrod na mang mchis kyang //phra ldem gnyen lhug dri bzang phon po can//shes ldan ma la ya dbus g.yur za ldem//myang na mngar ba'i dpal ster zhim pa'i ro//yig tshang sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi nying khu can//'chal gtam myos byed rdzas kyis ma bslad par//rkang drug mdzod kyi glegs bu rmad du byung //zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //༈ de yan chad du don gyi thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyi mthu phul du byung ba las bskrun pa'i rgyal rigs sha stag kyang gnas skabs su chos ldan gyi rgyal po ma byung zhing / 'di nas dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin pas/ khri rje thog btsan dang / ru yong bza' stong rgyal na mo tsho'i sras su dpal dge legs kun tu 'bar ba'i bzang po'i snang ba can gyi rnam 'phrul/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan 'khrungs te/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la pho brang yum bu gla sgang gi yang thog gi steng du dpang bkong phyag brgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa/ tsi ma ṇi'i skor phor rnams mkha' las babs te/ gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes pa 'byung ba'i lung bstan gyi sgra nam mkha' las bsgrags pas/ ngo mi shes pa ltar bcos kyang / ngo mtshar du bzung nas/ pho brang gi dkar khang du ming gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol ba'i mthus rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu pa slar na tshod dar la babs pa'i lang tsho ltar ya mtshan du gyur cing /

16yongs su bsgril bas lo brgya nyi shu'i bar du bzhugs so/ /deb sngon du rnal pa pasnyi ta'i lugs dang sba bzhed gtsang ma gung bsgrigs pa mkhas pa'i gsung yin kyang / nil pa pa tas nam mkha' las babs pa mi 'thad par smra ba ni blo chung gi gtam ste/ bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa'i rten 'brel du 'phags pa'i gang zag gi sprul pa dang thugs rje bsam las 'das pas so/ /de rnams la btsan lngar grags shing bang so snying lung dar thang du btab bo/ /btsad po de dang rno za mang po rje'i sras khri gnyan gzung btsan te bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs/ de dang 'brong bza' mo dur yangs gzhir la sras 'gro gnyan lde'u ste btsun mo mchims bza' klu rgyal ngan bu mtsho khab tu bzhes pas de klu'i rigs yin pas sngal pa'i ro mar khur btsos pa'i za ma'i rigs mdzod phugs su bzhag pa gzigs pas rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du gyur nas snyan du klu nad kyis thebs shing sras kyang dmus long zhig byung bas ming dmuzlo long dkon pa bkra zhes btags pa la zhal chems su/bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba ste//bzang po'i gros ni bdud rtsi yin zhes nyon/ ngan pa rnams kyang me dang 'dra bas gsos//mi chos rtog pa yin gyi rnam rtog skyungs//khyod yab mes kyi gnyan po gsang bar mchod pa gyis/ 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos la zig phye/ mig ma byung na sum pa'i yul na bon po zhig gi chung ma rgya mo rgya lcam bya ba la nub cig 'grogs pa'i shag mo tsam pa la skyes pa'i sum ri ring mo bya ba yod pas de bos la gcan chol rgyal sar chug gsungs nas bang so zhang mdar brtsigs par yab yum gson por bzhugs

17skad do/ /de nas sras kyis yab kyi gsung bzhin byas pas mig phye ste/ skyid shod stag mo ri la gnyan 'dug pa gzigs pas stag ri gnyan gzigs su grags/bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs so/ /rje de dang 'ol gong bza' stong btsun 'gro dkar gyi sras gnam ri srong btsan te 'di'i ring la rgya nas rtsis dang sman byung zhing / ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sbrus pa'i 'jim pa las brtsigs pa'i pho brang khri brtsegs 'bum gdugs zhes bya ba brtsigs/ brag gsum sding ma'i mtsho 'gram nas rta mdo wa cang shes brnyed par chibs nas/ phung g.yag thal dkar ru ring zhes bya ba'i 'brong bsad pa'i sha sga la btags pa sa la lhangs pa las tshwa rnyed/ bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs pa yin no//༄ smras pa/gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rgyal sras mchog gi legs par byas pa'i gru gzings kyis//thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi sgo 'phar las 'ongs gnyan po gsang ba'i yid bzhin gyi//nor bu dbang rgyal bod 'bangs yongs kyi rgyal mtshan rtse mor legs 'god pa'i//skal pa mchog gi dbyangs su len 'di dri za'i rgyud la rnam par 'khu//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //go༅/ /de ltar dam pa'i chos kyi 'chi med bdag po'i ba gam mngon par mtho ba dag gi sgo glegs grangs med dus gcig tu phye ba'i srol gyis dge legs kyi

18'dod rga rnam par bkra ba'i sde bzhi'i 'bras bu zad mi shes pa'i bdog pa ris su ma sdud pa'i 'gro ba kun la gtong ba'i phyag ring du brkyangs pa'i dge mtshan du che ba'i mi rje srong btsan sgam po ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/zu 'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du bde bar song / /bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ ces dang / thang yig tu/ 6 kha ba can du gnam ri zhes bya'i rgyud/ /srong btsan sgam po zhes bya rgyal bur skye/ zhes sogs dri ma med pa'i lung bstan gyis bsngags pa ltar/yab rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan dang / yum tshe spong bza' 'bri ma thod dkar gyi sras su/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen zhi ba chos dbyings su mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgya nyag ma brgyad 'das pa/ 'gal ba zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo la pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa na yab kyi 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri la stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por dbang bskur ro//de'i tshe rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs la/ ngas kha ba can pa'i 'gro don byed pa la dbang bskur ba po zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du dgongs pa'i tshe/ dpal kun tu bzang pos rin po che'i bum pa lha'i bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas sku khrus gsol zhing / a mi de was rgyal po'i dbu la reg nas dbang bskur bas brjod par dka' ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa dang gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma mtha' klas par gyur te/ po ta la'i ri 'di'i rtse la pho brang btab nas bzhugs na mtha' bzhi'i gus ldan gyi rgyal po thams cad kyis rang dbang med par gus pas 'dud pa'i dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mtha' dag lhan gyis grub par dgongs nas bshul du zhugs te gi re'i 'phred du phebs pa ston/yig drug rang byon zhal gzigs nas sku khrus gsol zhing gsol ba btab pas/

19de las dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i kha dog sna lnga 'phros pa pha ri brag la spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ rta mgrin gyi sku'i snang brnyan rang byon du shar ba la phog de las kyang yi ge drug pa la tshur phog pa'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba 'dren byed kyi yul du ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs mor gyar pa la 'ja' mdangs zhes skye bo rnams gleng ngo/ /de nas bal po'i lha zlozo dag gi sor mo'i sgru rtsal gyis sku dang gsung gi rten rnams ji ltar byon pa bzhin du gsal bar brkos/rim bzhin rgyal po 'khor bcas po ta lar phebs nas 'chi ba med pa'i pho brang sa la 'phos pa ltar yid du 'ong zhing kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram stegs ltar mtho btsan gyi pho brang bzhengs nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pas/ mtha'i rgyal po thams cad kyi rna bar da lta bod kyi yul na rgyal po mgo gnyis pa thogs pa med par sprul pa'i dmag 'gyed thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul yod pa thos pas 'jigs rngam gyi dbang gis dus gcig tu yong ba'i ched so yod pa ltar pho brang gsar du brtsigs pa la legs rdar bsnyad pa'i don zhu gsol gus 'dud lhur len gyi skyes bzang po'i yi ge dang bcas blon po mngags pa rnams la lan gyi chab shog so so'i yi gir btab cing / bzang po'i gsung dang spya dom pa'i dngos pos tshim par byas te brdzangs pas/ rgyal po kun yid rang dbang med par dga' bar mdzad do/ /rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug mi rje'i tshul gyis 'gro ba skyong bar shes bya thams cad la skog tu gyur pa'i mun pa mkhyen pa'i 'od stong gis cha tsam yang med par bsal na'ang / blo dman gyi 'gro ba'i snang ngo dang 'tsham pa'i phyir du/ rgyal srid lugs zung gi khrims rnam par dag pas 'dzin pa la yi ge 'di yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bur dgongs nas/ mgon po zur phud lnga pa'i byin rlabs kyi ga bur gsar pa'i thigs pa snying la 'phog pas/ rmongs rtul gyi

20tsha gdung lhag med du bcil ba'i mdun na 'don gnyal nas/ thon mi a nu'i bu sasto ṭa bran dang bcas par gser phye bre gang dang gser gyi pa ṭa sogs rig byed smra ba'i ston pa yid rang dbang du byed pa'i dngos po dang bcas nas 'phags yul du yi gi slob par bkas gnang ste/ bshul du 'tshe ba dang bral nas bgrod de bram ze le byin la yig rigs sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang /pa ta lha rig pa'i seng ge la sgra maṇi byā ka ra ṇa/ rtogs sla ba rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/ ga pa/ rtogs dka' ba parnyita lugs kyi bstan bcos/tsand+rapa rnams kyi sa ris/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang bcas pa bslabs nas/bdag cag blon po thon mi la//ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags//rgya gar yul du phyin pa yin//mkhas grub khyed dang mjal ba yin//zhes drin du gzo ba'i gsung bram ze la byon te bod du phebs nas/rgyal blon gnyis pho brang ma rur lo gsum mtshams bcad de yi ge dang sgra rnams slob pa'i tshul mdzad pas mkhas pa'i dpyid du gyur kyang de'i nang du bod skad la nye bar mkho ba'i sgra dang yig rigs mi 'dug par dgongs nas blon por gsungs pas/ thon mis 'jam dpal dbyangs la gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje'i char gyis yid kyi zhing sa brlan pa las/ bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs sdeb kyi rnam 'gyur gyi myu gu shar ba'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur tshul ni/ dbyangs bcu drug las i u e o bzhi dang gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi la sog pa lnga 'thug pa lnga ṣa kṣa rnams dor ba'i steng du a drangs pa'i rtsa bzhir/ gcig

21chos/ 'jig rten/ gzhon nu/ gzi brjed/ 'o ma sogs kyis mtshon par rgya skad la/ e ka/ dharma/ lo ku ku rmā ra/ te dzaza/ pa masra brjod pas/ ca cha ja zha za 'a rnams mi dgos pa 'dir bsnan te/ dbyangs bzhi gsal byed sum cur gtan la phab nas/ la la dpe byas nas dbu chen/wartu la dpe byas nas shar ma sogs yi ge'i gzugs dang brda gsal bar byed pa'i sum rtags sogs bod la nyer mkho'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad nas rgyal po la phul/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs chos du ma bsgyur ba ni smongs 'dir dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i thog ma yin no/ /rgyal pos bstan pa rin po che'i btsas su dgongs nas blon po la bkur sti rgya cher mdzad pas/ blon po gzhan phrag dog par/thon mis/ cho yul mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir// mi mkhas pas sleb pa'i sngon ma yin//nga mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin//rje rgyal po nyi zla'i tshul du bzhugs// grogs blon po'i khrod na nga tsam med//bod kha ba can pa'i mi rnams la// nga thon mi bka' drin mi che'am/ zhes gzhan gyi 'gran sems kyi brag ri dri ma med pa'i dpyod ldan gyi mdzad pa dang gsung gi gnam lcags kyi thog mdas sil bur btang ngo / /gsung 'di dag la dpags na dus skabs bzang po de dag tu yang blun pos shes ldan la gshe ba 'di yod tshod du 'dug go/ /

22de ltar yi ge 'dri klog gi srol legs par btod nas/ dge ba bcu'i khrims kyi steng du dkon cog la gus pa/ dam chos bsgrub pa/ pha ma la bkur ba/ yon tan can gong du bkur ba/ rigs mtho dang gon la phu dud/mdza' bshes la gzhung / yul mi la phan 'dogs pa/ yid drang ba/ mig ya rabs la lta ba/ zas nor la spyod shes pa/ drin can la phan lan/ bre grang la g.yo sgyu med pa/ spyi stoms shing phrag dog med pa/ bud med kyi kha la mi nyan pa/ ngag 'jam zhing smra mkhas pa/ theg pa che zhing blo khog yangs pa ste/mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims/ btsan pos phyag rgyas btab ste 'bras ldan dus kyi mkha' la rta ljang gi dbang po shar ba ltar gsal zhing / gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri ltar snyi bar mdzad pas/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams kyi khyon kun la gnas pa'i skye rga mtha' dag mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i dga' ston lan snyug min par myong bar mdzad do/ /smras pa/ 'gro ba'i bsod nams dpyid kyi mngal khur las//dpag bsam yongs 'du'i rgyal zas mtshar sdag can//'thon pa'i phyag na padma mi yi srid// dkubazung 'dis rdzogs ldan dri de ring nas 'gugs//mkha' me'i srad bur brgyus pa'i ka 'phreng la//rgya mtsho dbyangs kyis brgyan pa'i yi ge'i brda'i//rin cen phyang 'phrul rin du gser ldan sto//nor bu'i thong gis bkang yang khugs sam ci /

kroshugs drag mi dge'i mun pa sa 'dzin rkang //rnam dkar dge ba'i 'od stong zho 'thung rus /lag nyal grub pas bcom tshe khrims kyi gzi//legs byas sa spung steng na 'od du 'bar//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //de nas rgyal pos 'gro ba rnams thar pa bla na med pa la 'god par byed pa'i grogs su yi dam gyi lha zhig la brten dgos par mkhyen pa na/ lha'i bu mang pos nam mkha' las lung bstan pa ltar/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu las sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shrī la byon pa pho nyar mngags te/ rgyal po u ṭa ma ṭa ge sar zhes bya ba dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis btul te/nang pa'i bstan pa la bcug nas rgyal po'i dpung dang bcas nas 'phags pa'i mthus skad cig la rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi bye gling na byon nas sa brkos pa'i 'og tu tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i gar bu byang ba bcad pa'i nang nas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dang / po ta la na tsan dan gor shi sha'i dum bu/ rgya mtsho'i gling gi 'jag ma dang gnas chen brgyad kyi bye ma/ chu bo ni ra 'i bye ma rnams la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa gzigs nas bye ma'i thum bu dang / rtswa'i phon po/ mchod rten padma'i 'khor lo can nas/ 'khor ba 'jig 'od srungs/ shāka thub gsum gyi ring bsrel snyim pa re dang bcas pa bsnams te rgyal po la phul/ slar yang yi dam gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyi bdes bstan pa ltar sprul pa'i dge slong gis bal yul nas tsan dan ha ri'i sdong po las 'phags pa lo ke shā ra spyan drangs te/rgyal po'i smin mtshams su thim mo/ /

24de yang bka' gdams glegs bam las/ smyo rje dkon cog 'bangs ni bod du 'gro/ /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /bod mtha' 'khob yul rnams 'dul bar byed/ /nga rgya nag yul nas der drangs te/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgron ma zag med la/ /mi kho bo'i btsun mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ ces pa'i lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa lus can 'chi ba med pa'i dga' ston du spyod pa'i dus la babs te/ 'phags pa mchog gi 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa kun gsal gyi mtha' klas par 'char bar byed pa'i thabs su jo mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa lha gcig khri btsun bya ba lo bcu drug lon pa/ lang tsho'i zil mngar dar la babs pa'i mtshan bzang can/zhal nas ha ri tsan dan gyi dri bro ba zhig dang / rgya nag po'i grong khyer na jo mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa lha gcig kong jo bya ba lo bcu drug lon pa/ mtshan dpo'i mdzes sdug rnam par rgyas pa'i dpal yon can/ zhal nas utpa la'i dri bro ba zhig yod pa las/ rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa'i zlos gar bud med kyi srid bzung ba gnyis yod pa btsun mor spyan 'dren dgos pa'i lung bstan gyi sgra nam mkha' las byung ba dang / sprul pa'i rgyal po'i spyan gnyis las 'od zer 'phros pa shar nub tu song ba la/ dri ma med pa'i lha'i spyan gyis gzigs pas/ nub phyogs bal po'i yul gyi grong khyer ya 'bu ya 'gal bya ba na/ bal po'i rgyal po ni sa ma 'bri sho bya ba'i chos srid kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyag dam pa la yid du 'ong ba'i sras mo lha gcig rin po che'i dpor mdzod༄/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad gyi snang brnyan dang / rgya yul grong khyer bkra shis sgo khri na rgya kong rtse 'phrul chung bya ba/ stobs kyi 'khor los sa

25la rang dbang du spyod pa'i mi rje la sras mo mi las 'das pa'i lha gcig mig skya'i longs spyod la rnam par 'khu ba'i 'byor pa'i bang mdzod/ rgyal ba bu ram shing pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku brnyan sogs tshad ma'i yul du gyur pa las/lha gcig gnyis khab tu bzhes na/ rgya bal gyi phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan gyi dngos po thams cad khab len gyi rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul ltar 'byung bar dgongs nas 'jig rten mi'i chos lugs dang sgo bstan te/ gnas skabs su bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal por gyar pas/ pho nya dro tsam mngags pa la mi ster bar dgongs nas/ rgyal po nyirsha kyi spyan g.yas pa'i 'od zer las/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtshan dpe dang ldan zhing / rta/ glang po/ blon po/dmag dpon/ btsun mo/ 'khor lo/ nor bu ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i dpung tshogs yan lag rnam bzhi dang bcas pa'i sprul pa bal po'i rgyal po'i sgo drung du phyin te/ blon po rin po ches brda sbyar nas/ nged kha ba can gyi yul 'phags pa phyag na padmas byin gyis brlabs shing / 'phags pa nyid rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba yin pas/ rgyal po khyed kyi bu mo khro gnyer can ma'i sprul par 'dug pa nged kyi jo mor bsu bas/ rten skal shākya mu ni/ byams pa chos 'khor/tsan dan gyi sgrol ma rnams rdzongs su skur zhig de ltar mi byed na yul 'dir kha ba can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'debs so zhes bal skad du smras pas/ bal po'i rje 'bangs kun skrag nas rang dbang med par khas blangs te/ yab kyis lha gcig la 'gro bar gsungs pas/ lha gcig gis yab la zhu ba phul ba/kye ma yab gcig rgyal po lags//bod ces bya ba dmangs rigs gdol pa'i rigs//thun zhing mtha' 'khob ston pas zhabs ma bcags//

26mchod gnas med cing tshogs gsog rten ma mchis//rgyal ba'i 'khor bzhi grogs bzang dge 'dun med//chos dang chos min mi shes mun pa'i spag rum 'dra//zhe sdang gdug sems che ba gnod byed srin po'i rigs//'char la stom bag che ba byol song spre'u'i rigs//de 'dra'i mtha' 'khob gnas su bdag mchis na//bdag gi bsod nams gsog pa'i rten dang mchod gnas su//yab kyi mchod gnas shākya mu ni dang //byams pa sgrol ma bdag la gnang bar zhu//bod ces bya ba yi dwags grong khyer te//mi stogs rgyal khams yin par rgyal bas lung bstan pas//rin cen bang mdzod mang po bdag la zhu// rīkha ba can gyi rgyal khams bsil zhing grang //tshe gcig dros pa'i gos shig bdag la zhu//de ltar ma 'dris mi yi khrod nang du//bsam rgyud spyod pa bya ba ji ltar bgyi//yab gcig rgyal po bdag la bka' rtsol cig/ces zhus pas/ rgyal pos/ kye ma mig 'bras 'dra ba'i bu mo tshur gson cig/bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phag pa'i yul//ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul//bsil la dro ba lha gnas gas la yas khang //

27chu bo bzhi 'bab rgya mtsho bzhi yis mdzes//'bru sna sna tshogs rin cen sna tshogs 'byung / rkang 'gros sgur spyod rtsi thog mar la spyod//rje ni lha yin 'bangs ni mi yis byas//'khor bzhi med kyang byang chub sems dpa'i brgyud//dam chos med kyang rgyal po'i bka' khrims gnas/dge 'dun med kyang rgyal po sprul pa yin//zhes bod kyi rje 'bangs yul gru la bsngags pa mdzad nas/ lha gcig gi spro ba bsrings te/ bod kyi sprul pa'i blon po rin po che dang / lha gcig rgyu mtshan mthun pa'i mchod gnas dam pa 'chi ba med pa'i bdag po mchod sbyin brgya pas sbyin bdag byas te/ sprul pa'i bzo bo las sna tshogs pa'i sor mo'i 'du byed las bskrun pa'i shākya mu ni dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad can rgyal ba nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i byams pa chos 'khor/ tsan dan gyi sgrol ma rang byang / nor bu ratna de wa/ stag sha de wa/ bee shārya'i lhung bzed sogs/ ༄rin po che'i bang mdzod bdun gyis thog drangs ma/ dgu'i yo byad rnams skal rdzongs su mdzad de/ khri btsun la bslab bya 'di ltar/ sngon tshe bu mos pha yul bzung ba med/ de phyir bu mo khyod kyang bod yul song //bka' btags chos lugs bzang po dar bar gyis//rje yi sku mkhar pho brang btsan po 'chos/ chos bzhings dkon cog gsum gye rten yang tshugs//

28khyad par 'phags pa'i rten yang bzhengs su gsol//gtsug lag rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dam pa bzhings//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa yi//dge 'dun ston pa'i bstan pa dar bar mdzod// ces sogs 'phral yun du dgos pa'i bslab bya dang bcas te bod du brdzangs/de'i tshe skyes bu mchog dman bar pa gsum la snang ba mi 'dra ba gsum byung ste/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gzigs ngor/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang jo mo khro gnyer can mjal nas mkha' la 'od zer dang bcas te bod du byon nas bzhugs par gzigs/ bal po'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis/ khri btsun btsun mo rin po che'i chas su zhugs nas bod du bzhud par mthong / bod 'bangs rnams kyis bee 'arya'i khrub kyis rten dang bcas te bod blon rta pa lnga brgya bal yul du zengangs dro rnams kyis khri btsun rgyal po'i btsun mor spyan drangs pa mthong / de nas rgyal pos bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i bsu ba dang / dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad de lha gcig btsun mo rin po che'i khri la dbang bskur ro/ /shākya mu ni sogs skal rdzongs kyi rten khyad par can rnams dang / sngar sprul pa'i dge slong gis spyan drangs pa'i rten rnams lhan cig tu mchod pa'i khang bzang yid du 'ong bar bzhugs su gsol nas/kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod cing / btsan po yang sku rnams kyi thad ka nas 'ben tshad gang las ring du mi bzhud par bzhugs pas/ khri btsun gyi thugs la/ rgyal po 'di lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan mnga' ba zhig 'dug na'ang / pho brang gi phyi rol tu mi 'byon pa ni mtha'i dmag la 'jigs par gda' bas/ pho brang btsan po zhig rgyag par

29 —bzhed nas/ dmar po ri'i sa phyogs su lcags ri'i 'phreng ba gsum du bskor ba'i nang du mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu/ dmar po ri'i rtser gcig ste stong yod pa de dag rnams la dril bu dang rnga yab mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed kyis mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la 'gran pa/ rgyal po dang btsun mo'i pho brang gi bar du dngul dang zangs kyi zam ba sbrel ba/mkhar gyi rtsa bar shin tu no ba'i mdung la ba dan lhab lhab tu 'phyo ba stong btsugs pa/ phyogs bzhi na 'dod rga'i yo byad mtha' rdog rang dbang med par 'du ba'i sgo bzhi la ltog bzhis rnam ༄par brgyan pa/ phyi rol tu rta'i rgyag sa/zabs su 'dom do/ /zheng 'dom bco brgyad/ snyangs su 'dom sum brgya yod pa/ de la spang leb bsgrigs pa'i steng du so marsha bting ba/ rta gcig brgyugs kyang du ma brgyags pa'i sgra 'byung ba/ mdor na srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu'i grong khyor bsod nams kyi mthus gangs can gyi ljongs su 'phos pa lta bu zhig brtsigs nas/ rje blon 'bangs 'khor mtha' dag 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod pa'i skabs su/sprul pa'i rgyal pos shar phyogs nas rgya rje'i sras mo kong jo spyan 'dren pa'i nyer bsdogs su spyan g.yon pa'i 'od zer las 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sogs sngar ltar sprul nas/ rgya'i pho brang ke ru'i khri sgor phebs te blon po rin po ches/ nged bod kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa yin pas khyed kyi lha gcig 'di sgrol ma'i sprul pa yin pa btsun mor spyan 'dren pas skal rdzongs su shākya mu ni dang bcas pa gnang bar mdzod cig de las phyi rol du gyur na rgya yul 'byin cing / tshul bzhin bsgrubs na rgya bod kyi 'khrug pa phyis nas rgyan gcod do zhes rgya nag gi skad du brda sbyar bas/ rgyal blon rnams shin ༄tu 'jigs pas khas blangs te lha gcig la 'gro bar gsungs pas/ lha gcig

gi/snyomadza' gcugs kyis bcings pa'i gnyen 'khor dang mi 'phrad cing / chos dang srid kyi 'byor pa las gzhan du gyur pa'i yul der mi 'gro bar zhus kyang /bod kyi rgyal po'i bla na med pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal thabs kyi gzi byin rgya rjes ma bzod pa'i dbang gis bka' ma gnang bas/ lha gcig gis bdag kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su 'gro da sa na/ lha shākya mu ni/ bod lha srin ma rungs pa'i yul sa rgod rdo rgod la sogs pa'i dgra rnams 'dul ba'i gtsug lag gi gab rtse dang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dngos po zad mi shes pa'i rin po che'i gan mdzod gnang bar zhus pa bzhin brdzangs te/rgya rje'i zhal nas/kye ma bu mo bdag la tshur gson dang //bod ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul//yul la khyad du 'phags pa de yin te//gangs ri rang byung mchod rten ya mtshan can// lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa ni//mtsho bzhi g.yu yi ma la bkram pa 'dra//thang bzhi rang bzhin mchod pa bshams pa 'dra//chu bo bzhi yi mgo bzhi rang bzhin can//ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi ljongs//bkra shis nyams dga' g.yung drung bris pa 'dra//rgyal khams gzhan gyi mi rje mi yis ni// byas pa la ni ngo mtshar che rgyu med//bod yul mi rje lhas byas ngo mtshar che//mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po kun gyis legs par bkur /

31chos kyi rgyal po grong btsan rnam po ni//byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa mi drug ldan// yon tan dpag tu med pa'i rgyal po yin//zhes spro ba bsrings nas/bu tsha yig tshang sgrob cing dge ba dag la sbyar//dkon cog dbu 'phangs bstod cing dad dang gus pa skyed//chos 'khor gtsug lag bzhings shing gnas grar dge gnas tshugs//sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhing zhing dam chos gzhung yang bris//thos bsam sgom pa bya zhing dam chos nang du spyad//dge 'dun rnyed bkur bya zhing dam tshig sdom pa grungs//dam chos dus dran byas la de ring nyid nas 'bad//chos la long yod mi sems tshe 'dir chags mi bya//skyabs chen lha ru gzung la dkon cog skyabs 'gro bya//las dang 'bras bu sems la sdig spong dge la 'bad//'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam la nges 'byung blo gtad bya//'khor ba'i nyon mongs spangs shing de yi gnyen po sten//byams dang snying rje bsam la byang chub sems kyang skyed//byang chub spyod pa spyod cing theg chen lam bgrod bya//de ltar byas na bkra shes dge bar 'gyur//gtam gyi mtha' ma min no bu mo di ltar mdzod//ces sogs chos dang srid la mkho ba'i zhal gdams mang du gsungs nas bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo rin po cher brdzangs so/ /dus der mthong snang gsum byung ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs byang sems rnams kyi gzigs ngor/

32rje btsun phyag na padmo dang jo mo sgrol ma gnyis phan tshun du thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i mthus/ bod khams kyi don du gshegs par gzigs/ rgya nag pa rnams kong jo bod kyi sprul pa'i rgyal po'i btsun mor 'khyer bar mngon/bod 'bangs rnams kyis ni/ dpa' mdzangs 'phrul ldan gyi blon po mgar sogs rgya rje'i pho brang du lha gcig spyan 'dren pa'i rten tu bee ḍārya'i rmog dang bcas te mngags pa rgyal khab tu sleb pa dang / rgya rje yab yuzlo sras lha gcig dang bcas pa mtha' dag bod la ster ma 'dod pa'i bsnyad du/ rgyal po chen po gzhan zhig la ster bar gros mthun kyang / nang gses kyi yab chos la dgyes/yum longs spyod 'dod/ sras dmag la dga'/ lha gcig gzugs yid du 'ong ba la 'dod pa'i dbang gis pho nya so sor mngags pas/ rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po/ stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po/ ge gsar dmag gi rgyal po/ gzugs mdzes khrom gyi rgyal po bzhi'i blon po lnga brgya yang lha gcig spyan 'dren pa'i ched du/ rgya rje'i pho brang du sleb pa las/ rgya thams cad bod la mi dga' yang /khrims la nye ring mi btub pa'i dbang gis blon po rig pa su rno ba zhig la ster bar byas te/ btsan po'i bla g.yu phub tsam la mig gcig mtha' na yod cing mig gcig dkyil na yod pa nang gi mig kyang phub kyi spa rim ltar yod pa'i khyad 'phags zhig yod pa de gtad nas mig tu dar yug sus tshud la sbyin no zer bas/ blon po gzhan rnams kyis nyi ma mang po'i bar du thabs sna tshogs byas kyang ma tshud par/ mgar gyis rgya'i grog ma gzan gyis gsos pa'i mthe bong tsam zhig gi sked pa la dar skud dang / de'i sne la dar yug btags te dbus kyi mig tu bcug nas phus btab pa mthar 'thon te lha gcig gnang bar zhus kyang / bod la ster ma 'dod pa'i bsnyad kyis/ de tsam gyis bya ba ma rdzogs pa skad du/ bya ma brgya bu brgya/ shing thum po rtsa rtse/ snyin gcig mi res lug

33sha sbugs re za ba spags pa mnyes zin pa dang / chang ban re 'thung ba/ ma bzi ba sogs 'grub par dka' ba'i rig pa mang po 'gran bcug pas/ mgar gyis sbang ma gtor bas bya ma bu shes/ shing chur bskyur bas rtsa rtse shes/ lug rnams kyi sha thags so sor spungs nas sha nyung ngu re tshwa la bgres te zar bcug pas zos zin pa/ pags pa rnams gral 'go nas rim bzhin phur ba re byas pas thul/ chang sdod chung ngu rer 'thung bskor byas pas ma bzi bar btungs zin/ blon po gzhan rnams de las phyi rol tu gyur na'ang lha gcig ma byin par/nub gcig gi tshe rnga bo che brdungs byung bas/ rgyal po gzhan rnams kyi blon po pho brang du song ba dang / mgar gyis rnga de skyon can du go nas/ rang gi gnas kyi phyi sgo'i ya them la rdo rje dang / ma them la g.yung drung mtshal gyis bris/ sgo gzhan rnams la yang mtshan ma re btab ste pho brang du phyin pas/ rgya rjes do nub lam ma 'dzol bar rang khyim du sus sleb par ster zer bas/gzhan rnams lam nor/ mgar gyis sgron me brtag nas sngar brgyab pa'i rtags rnams dang bstan nas 'ongs pas rang khyim du bde bar sleb/ 'on kyang rgya rje'i zhal nas zhusang nyin thang la yid du 'ong ba'i na chung sum brgya tshogs pas/de dus sus ngo shes pa la ster zer bas/ mgar gyis sngar nas 'dris pa'i rgya mo zhig yod par gser gyi rngan pa byin/ rgya'i rtsis khog tu mi tshud pa'i thabs byas te dris pas/ kong jo'i sku dbyibs dang cha lugs rnams nges par byas nas/ nang par blon po gzhan rnams kyis chas dang gzugs la bltas te bu mo 'ga' zhig khrid pa'i rjes su/ bod blon rnams kyis lha gcig gi gos kyi gong ba nas mda'i stong gis bzung ste khrid pas/ lha gcig mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyar byed par/ mgar gyis spro ba bskyed pa'i ram thon mi dang 'bri se ru gung then gnyis kyis bteg nas/

34ma ma ngo mtshar che /lha gcig kong jo khyed//bdag gi tshig la gson// ribakra shis nyams su dga'//bod kyi rgyal khams na//rin cen sna las grub//rgyal po'i pho brang na//mi rje lha yis mdzad//grong btsan sgam po de//rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjod//mthong na sems yin 'phrog/thugs rje chen po lags//rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong //'bangs rnams bka' la nyan//rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams//dga' skyid thu ru len//chos kyi nyi ma shar//dpal gyi thon me bteg/ri la shing sna tshang //sa gzhi yangs pa la//'bru sna lnga yi tshogs//rgo mtshams med par skye//gser dngul zangs lcags sogs// rin cen du ma yod//gnag rta lug gsum rgyas//

36 skad kong jo dpon g.yog la springs so// de nas mgar gyis nad 'di bod kyi lha ma dga' bar 'dug pas lha gsol ba'i chas/ rta mog dro mgo dmar dang / tshwa chu byags pa'i sha skam sogs sta gon byas nas bod kyi ri mthong sar gyad mi bzhi dpe bcas te 'ongs pa dang / mgar gyis spyad mi bzhi la sha skam byin pas skom pa'i nad mi bzod pas gdungs te/ chang gi btung ba mang por longs spyod pas/ ra ro ba'i bar du mgar gyis spyad kyi rta'i sug po bregs/ mtshon cha rnams bcag rta mog dro mgo dmar de zhon nas 'di skad zer ro//dar zab me la bsregs pa'i thal ba de//rgyal po nye ring can de'i na bza' mdzod//snye ma 'bru med thal ba nag po de//btsun mo ser sna can de'i brgyags phye mdzod//nags la me rgyab sol ba'i mdung shing de//rgyal bu lus rtsal can de'i mdung shing mdzod//lug la mtsher khrug med par bsad pa de//lha yi drung du sdig bshags smon lam bya//lus la nad med mal du nyal ba la//sngas mgor sman pa bos nas ci zhig bya//kho bo mi sdod rang gi yul du 'gro//zhes zer nas 'ongs pas/ sgo gdong sgo mo'i rtsar kong jo dpon g.yog gi rjes zin skad do/ /de ltar thabs sna tshogs kyis rgya mo bza' kong jo bod rgyal po'i btsun mor thob pa mthong ngo //smras pa/

37legs lam mchog gi man shel gsar pa'i gos//klubs pa'i mi bdag thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis//rgya bal phun tshogs dngos kun bsdas pa na// gser mngal can yang 'dud snyamathi 'phyang mo nyug/ngal ba med par mkha' dbyings lus phra mas//bzhin ngos 'khor los sgyur thabs smin ma'i glog/kun gyi gzigs mor mtshar ba'i 'phreng ba 'dis//rgyal thabs rdo rje'i gzegs ma 'phros snyam byed//che ma ri dgas mig can 'bum phrag gi/ trībyed pos lang tsho'i tshogs kun bsdus pa'i dpyid//rin cen btsun mor grub pa'i phan bde'i nor//bod 'bangs yol go'i nang du 'phyur bur gtams//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //de nas kong jo 'khor bcas rnams lha sa'i phyogs so sor 'khod pa'i skye bo rnams la sprul pa'i dbang gis mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma byung yang / don du byang phyogs nas byon te lha gcig rtsis kyi gtsug lag la mkhas pas/ bod srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i dbyibs su gzigs/ klu'i pho brang gi steng du jo bo bzhugs na non par mkhyen nas/ de nyid du sku'i phyogs bzhir ka ba btsugs nas/ dar gyi yol bas mtha' bskor te/ jo bo shākya mu ni la mchod pa'i rol mo dri za'i rgyud mang lta bur dkrol bas/ bal mo bzas ci yin snyam nas pho brang gi rtse nas bltas pas/ kong jo dpon g.yog byon pa mthong nas/phrag dog ste/ rgyal po dang kong jo mjal ba'i gegs byas par/ blon po

38mgar gyis khri btsun la/ kong jo spor thang gi rtsis la mkhas pa'i dbang gis gtsug lag khang gi sa dpyad sogs 'dri dgos pas/ rgyal po dang mjal du bcug pa 'thad ces gros btab nas/ mjal 'phrad kyi dga' ston 'chi ba med pa'i dpal la 'gran pa byas pa'i dus su/ dzebal bzas/rgya mo 'un shing kong jo khyod/dka' las byas nas snye bos bkugabod kyi yul du byon na yang /nga ni snga bas chen ma yin/zhes sogs smras par/kong jos/'gran pa'i 'gran sems med mod kyang /khyod kyis 'gran no zhes smras pas/them pa snga brgal chen ma khyod/lha khang rgya mtsho'i stengs su bzhings/zhes sogs kyi lan brjod pa'i chen chun gyi gtam byang skad/ de nas lha gcig khri btsun gyis btsan po la lha khang rtsig pa'i gros zlos pas/ khyod rang gang legs su brtsigs shig gsungs pa ltar/ la gdong gi ni'u'i khar brtsigs par mtshan mo lha 'dres bshig pas/ g.yog mo zhig la gser phye bre gang bskur nas/ kong jo la rtsis byed par zhus pas/ spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi steng nas brtsis pas/ kha ba can gyi yul 'di srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba lta bur

wa wa 39'dug pa las/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrug dmar lcags kyi ri 'di snying gi rus pa'i rnam par 'dug na'ang / mtsho'i steng du shākya mu ni bzhugs pa dang / ri'i rtser rgyal po'i pho brang yod pas don cing / de dag gi mtha' skor na sa dpyad skyon yon gnyis las/ yon tan ni/ shar na mchod sdong btsugs pa 'dra ba/ sto na rin po che'i mchod rten 'dra ba/ nub na mañdzi'i steng na dung phor bzhag pa 'dra ba/ bang na padma kha phye ba 'dra ba ste/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i ri bzhi/ de'i nang bskor du nyang bran 'phan dkar gyi ri la gdugs/ mal grong gi ri la nya/ mdongs mkhar gyi brag la padma/ grib kyi 'khyags rum la dung / rdzong btsan gyi ri la bum pa/ yug pa'i ri la dpal be'u/ 'phan dkar gyi ri la rgyal mtshan/ brang phu'i brag la 'khor lo ste bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/ lcags kha ri/ shug pa gdong / ra kha brag jo mo ze rnams la gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter kha/ shar gyi stag dga' gdong 'og ma/ sto'i g.yu 'brug gtsang chab/ nub kyi bya rti bu gdong / byang gi rus sbal pha bong kha/ mdor na gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang / sa la padma 'dab brgyad de gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yod la/ 'on kyang skyon ni/ shar bye ma'i ri la srin mo 'doms bzed pa lta bu/sto na sdig pa gzan la rub pa 'bra ba/ nub shun gyi brag la bdud bya ra byed pa sta bu/ byang nyang dogs kyi bar na glang po che g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu'i ri/shar sto mtshams na btsan gyi rgyu sa/ sto nub mtshams na 'dre'i 'du phung /byang na ma mo'i nyal sa/ gzhan yang skum pa ri la chu zin dre'u khrid pa 'dra ba/gnam sgo phye ba gnam ral gri 'dra ba/ sa sgo phye ba phag pa'i sna 'dra ba sogs sa dpyad ngan pa rnams gnon par byed pa'i thabs su/ thog mar rgyal po yab yum gsum gyis skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar sgrub pa mdzad nas/ sgrub pa'i

40rtags thon pa dang / srin mo'i yan lag dang srin lag gnon par byed pa la/g.yon ru phra 'brug g.yas ru gtsang 'gram/ sbrus ru bka' tshal/ ru lag grum pa rgyang gi lha khang ste/ mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi/ kong po bu chu/ lho drag mkho mthing / byams sprin dge rgyas/ byang bra dum rtse ste/ yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi/ khams slong thang sgrol ma/ spa gro skye chu/ tshal rigs shes rab sgrol ma/ tshangs pa rlung gnon te/ ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang rnams brtsigs/ sngar bshad pa'i nye skor gyi sa'i dgra ngan pa rnams la mchod rten/rdo'i seng ge dbang phyug gi rten/ bya khyung / dung dkar sogs kyis bcos/de rjes mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du gtsug lag khang brtsigs te rgya bal gyi lha rnams bzhugs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / phyis dbon sras rnams kyi ring la'ang dge 'dun gyi sde dang mdo rgyud kyi bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas su 'byung bar 'dug gsung / g.yog mos 'phrin snga phyi rnams nor zhing 'ga' zhig 'tshib pas/ khri btsun gyis ra la sa bkal nas mtshor blugs pas rtog ma long du song nas zubs su ma 'dod pas/ rgya bzas ngan bslabs par go nas/rgyal po la zhus pas/ de ma thag tsan dan gyi sku la gsol ba btab pa dang /spyan g.yas las 'od zer byung nas mtsho thams cad khengs pa gzigs pas/ rgyal pos khri btsun dang lhan cig tu mtsho 'gram du byon nas gser gyi sor gdub mkha' la 'phangs pa gang babs su lha khang gi rmang 'ding bar dmod bor te bskyur bas/ mtsho nang du babs te 'od kyi dra bas gang bar/ rgyal po'i zhal nas lha gcig khri btsun/ bal po'i rdo bzo bas 'od kyi dra ba'i rjes su rdo rgyob cig gsungs pa ltar byas pas/ rdo'i spre'u mchod rten lta bu zhig byung bar/ me chu'i gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i ched du rdo rje'i 'jim pa byugs pa'i shing rnams kyi rtse gtad pa'i khar khro chu'i pha gu bkram/ srubs rnams mkhang ba'i

sgochus bsdams de'i steng du so phag dang sa bzang ba rim pas btab nas mtsho bsubs te/ chos rgyal dgung lo nyer lnga pa chu mo glang gi lo la 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi rmang btings nas brtsigs kyang / sngar kong jos brtsis pa'i bcos thabs rnams ma byung bar brten/ lha 'dres bshig pas slar kong jo'i rtsis rnams zhib par rgyal po'i snyan du gsan nas shin tu dgyes te skyid shod nyang bran pha bong kha'i brag steng du sa phag khro chu la sbyar nas mkhar dgu thog yod pa brtsigs nas phyogs bzhir lcags thag btags/ brtan par byas te sgrab pa mdzad pas zhag bdun na rigs gsum mgon po mkha' la byon nas/ 〉khyod kyis smon lam rgya chen po thob cig nged kyis smon lam mtha' dag 'bad med du 'grub pa'i dpang po byed pa yin gsungs nas rdo la thim pa'i rang byon bal po'i lha bzo bas ji bzhin brkos pa deng sang yang lus can kun gyi 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du gsal bar yod cing / de nas btsan pos sprul pa bkye ste/ mi 'gyur ba'i gzer gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis brtsigs/ lha ma srin gdug pa can rnams kyi dpung rnams bzlog pa'i phyir du rgyal po rang gi sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sku zhig bzhing bar dgongs te/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po bdar ba'i phye ma dang / gnas chen brgyad kyi sa/ chu bo rna ra na'i bye ma rnams ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sbrus pa'i 'jim pa rnams sta gon byas te/ bal po'i lha bzo khre ba zhes bya bar bzhing ba'i bka' gnang bar nang par spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi skur grub nas gda' bas/ rgyal pos lha bzo ba la sku 'di shin tu legs te tsan dan gyi sku dang mchod sdong thugs kur bzhugs rgyu yin pa la gsungs pas/ de ma thag zhabs g.yon pa'i sham thabs pyas mo'i gong du brjes te zhabs mthil las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis de rnams drangs te thugs kur thim mo//

42 de nas lha khang rtsig par mngon du phyogs pa na lho nub gla ba'i tshal na lha ma srin rnams 'tshogs te/ 'dre sgang po bdud mi zan bya ba gcig na re/ bu dharma saṃ snya zer ba rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba'i srog gcod/ sngar brtsigs pa'i lha khang bshig chos byed zer ba la rims nad dang / bod khams su lo nyes gtong ba'i mdun ma byed pa rgyal pos gzigs nas/ rang byon thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ jo bo bzhad pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba mer gyur/ khros pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil par gyur/ khro bo me dang bcas pa skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar song 'dre'i 'du phung bshig nas/ dus mtha'i rlung dang me'i shugs la 'god par nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis gdug pa can mtha' dag phyi'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu bskrad/ zla ba tshal gyi brag la snang ba mtha' yas/ kha sadru ṇi/ rta mgrin gsum rang byon du byon pa ji lta ba bzhin bal po'i lha bzos gsal bar brkos so/ /de nas rgyal pos sprul pa mtha' yas pa bstan te char zim bu 'bab pa'i na bun gyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i ngang du gtsug lag khang gi 'og khang rnams brtsigs nas/ nang par sprul pa rnams kyis shing bzo byed pa'i skabs/ khri btsun rang gis zhal skyem 'dren du byon pa la/ g.yog mos sgo spubs nas bltas pas/ dar thod can gzhan las che ba zhig la 'dren gyi 'dug pa mthong bas/ sprul pa kho nar 'dug ces bgad pas/ rgyal po spyan yengs nas ste'u kha thal bas nga gi brgya'i sna bcad/ gzong kha thal bas bug pa brgya phub/ sog le kha thal bas ka ba brgya'i zur nyams skad/ de'i mtshan 'og khang gi thog phub/ de nas khri btsun gyis bal yul nas bzo bo mkhas pa du ma bos nas/ steng khang rnams bzhengs pa dang dus mtshungs par kong jos rgya'i bzo bo mkhas pa rnams bkug nas ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ thags rje chen po 'jig rten

43dbang phyug yab yum gyi ye shes sgyu mas sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po rdzogs par grub nas/ ji srid rta bdun gyi dbang pos gdung byed kyi yul de srid skye rga kun la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa mdzad do//༄ de nas rgyal pos 'phrul snang gi gtsang khang byang ngos su rang byon thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor spyan 'dren pa'i sta gon mdzad pas/ mtshan phyed la pho brang gi mthongs khung nas gshegs te gtsang khang byang mar phebs/ nang par rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis lha rnams spyan 'dren pa'i bya ba la zhugs pa'i tshe sku rnams mi snang bas the tshom du gyur pa na/ sprul pa'i ni tso zhig gis sngar gyi rgyu mtshan rnams brjod pas don la gnas par gda' bas rgyal po dgyes te/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i chu 'dzin gyi 'phreng ba mtha' klas par 'khrigs pa las/ mchod pa'i gru char mi zad pa'i bdag nyid can gyi legs byas kyi myu gu skal bzang skye rgu'i dpyid du smin par mdzad do/ /de nas ra sa'i gtsug lag khang gi gtsang khang dbus mar de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa gtso 'khor dgu/ gtsang khang g.yas la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor dgu/ gtsang khang g.yon du byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo gdan drangs te 'khor du sgrol ma brgyad/ gtsang khang sto na jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje gdan drangs pa'i 'khor du khro bo dang gnod sbyin stobs ldan gyis bskor ba/ gtsang khang byang du rang byon thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi steng du yi ge drug pa/ don zhags/ kha sarlu ṇi/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi'i 'khyil pa rnams bzhings/ klu sbrul mgo nyi shu/ dga' bo/ 'jog po/ gnod sbyin nā ga ku be ra/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ dpal lha mo rnams so sos bskul ba bzhin bzhengs/ gzhan yang bon dang sgrung gi gtam rgyud las byung ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa yang bri bar

44mdzad/ ra mo cher shākya mu ni gtso 'khor rnams bzhugs su gsol te/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rmad du byung ba'i zhing khams dam par bde bar gshegs pa zhi ba dang khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram par rlung gi rgyal mtshan gyis 'khyud pa ltar rnam par bkra zhing / mdzes sdug rngam brjid kyi rnam 'gyur grangs med pa 'dren byed kyi yul du chog mi shes pa ston par mdzad pa'i mchog gsum dam pa'i sku brnyan gyis gang ba'i ra sa 'phrul gyi gtsug lag khang zung la rab tu gnas pa'i dga' ston gyis mchod pa'i yo byad bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa bshams nas/chos rgyal yab yum blon 'bangs rnams kyis phyag tu me tog gi 'phreng ba bzung ba dang bcas bden tshig gi smon lam rgya chen po'i rta bdun gyis drangs pas/bde stong gnyis med zung du 'jug pa'i 'gyur ba med pa mchog gi dbyings las/ rang snang lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal med khang chen po nas/ bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro rab 'byams kyi nyin byed dbang po 'gog pa med par rgyu bas/mtha' 'khob bsil ldan gyi sa gzhi kun la/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa padma dkar po'i 'dab brgya rnam par rgod pas bod 'bangs ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs kun dga'i gar dang snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro srid rtse'i bar du sgrogs par gyur to//smras pa/ma smad legs byas mngal gyis lci ba'i khur//ngo mtshar snying po ye shes sgyu ma'i gar//phan bde zla shel gsar pa'i ga pur thi sa//'bum phyag 'dzag pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i rgyan//gcig tu bsdoms pa'i ke la sha yi chus// cusrid 'dir 'khor ba'i ma rig dri ma'i tshogs//

45drungs nas phyung byed lha ldan yid bzhin dbang //bde legs snang ba'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar//de phyir rna ba brgyad pa pad dkar mig/mgrin sngon mig stong can sogs 'chi med rnams//snyim par rmad byung mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kun//thogs te lha lam khyon kun dog por 'god/ ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// // de nas rgya bza' dang bal bza' gnyis la sras ma byung bar/ ru yong bza' dang / zhang zhung bza'/ mong bza' khri lcam rnams khab tu bzhes par/sngon ma gnyis la zas ma byung bar/ brag lha dang / thim bu lkog gi lha khang bzhengs/ mong bza' la sras gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs/ yum sras gnyis kyi rten skal du 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dbyibs can gyi ri/ dpal gyi yer pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ lo bcu gsum lon tshe rgyal sar dbang bskur/ btsun mo 'a zha bza' kho 'jo mong rje khri dkar ti shags bya ba khab tu bzhes pas sras mang srong mang btsan 'khrungs/ gung ri gung btsan dgung lo bco brgyad lon nas gshegs/ bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs/ slar yab rgyal pos rgyal srid bzung ste/ mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rnams yang dag pa'i khrims la 'jug pa'i slad du/ mi 'ga' zhig gi mig bton pa dang / mgo lag bregs pa sogs lcags ri'i kha na rgyun mi chad par sprul pa'i dus/ thugs rje chen po bod kyi rgyal por yod pa'i lung bstan byung ba la brten nas/ ched du 'ongs pa'i li yul gyi dge tshul gyis/ khrims bcad pa'i mgo lag mthong bas/ log lta skyes pa bsal phyir a mi de wa bstan cing dam pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad nas/ skad cig la li yul du sleb pa'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa dang / khru 'brug

47thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi thugs ka las 'od zer ston ku'i zla ltar dkar ba shar nas/ gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang thams cad gsal bar byas pas bskul te rta mgrin/ sgrol ma/ sman bla/ byams pa chos 'khor/ jo bo mi bskyod pa/ rme ba brtsegs pa/ 'od dpag med/ mar me mdzad rnams kyi thugs ka las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros te/ 'phrul snang gi bar mtshams med par khyab pas 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad du grags so/ /dus der blon po sna chen po dang khri lcam gnyis ma gtogs med pas/ slar gzhan rnams 'phrul snang du 'tshogs te the tshom du gyur pa na/ sngar gyi byung tshul rnams bshad pa dang / thon mis li yul gyi dge tshul dang / khru 'brug gi sprang ban la rgyal pos sprul pa bstan pa'i lo rgyus bshad pas nges shes su gyur/ 'on kyang bod 'bangs byings kyi snang ngor bran mo zhig rims nad kyis btab pa bal mo bza' la 'gos/ de las chos rgyal dang kong jo gnyis la yang mched de/ yab yum gsum ka 'phan yul zal mo'i sgang du gshegs pa'i pur yar klung 'phyong rgyas su spyan drangs te bang so brtsigs so//chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi ring la rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang brten pa'i gtsug lag khang bzheng ba/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba dang /thos bsam sgom gsum sogs kyi srol legs par btod pas/ rang cag gangs can pa rnams kyis ni 'di nyid kyi bka' drin 'dzin ma'i khyon mtha' dag yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches bkang yang 'khor ba'i thabs rnyed pa ma yin no/ /chos rje bsod nams grags pas/ rgyal po 'di nyid kyi ring la bstan pa'i dbu brnyes par 'chad pa ni deb ther yig tshang sogs la zhib cha dman zhing /rtog ge'i rig pa tsam gyis rang bzo la thal ba'i skyon yin no/ /de yang rgyal po bka' chems dang lung bstan mdzad pa'i nang du/ bstan pa rin po che

‘ 'dzin pa dang / khyad par 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang 'di la phud dud mdzad pa'i dam pa rnams kyi lung bstan mtha' yas pa yod pa'i khrod nas/6 dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa'i/ gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pas ni/ zhal yang bsgyur zhing rnyed bkur dam pa mdzad/ mi ces pa'i don shar phyogs btsong kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs shing 'jam dpal snying po'i mtshan can gyis shākya mu ni sprul sku longs skur zhal bskyar zhing / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad tshul gyi rgyal ba btsong kha bee chen po'i lung bstan mngon sum gyi tshad mas grub pa la/dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bas/ smyo byang chub sems dpa' shar stor sku bltams pa/ zhes bcos byas nas/ dwags po sgam tshul gyi lung bstan du smra ba ni/rang nyid chos brgyad kyi chang gis bag med du myos shing / blang dor la blta ba'i mig phyogs lhung drag po'i rab rib kyis sdongs pas/ rang dang rjes su zhugs pa mtha' dag gtam ya mtshan can du 'dod kyang / don du mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam mgon sa skya pa ta'i gsung las/ 6 blo ngan las la spyod pa la//rang gi 'bad pas thob par sems/ /khyi rgan ya rkan phug pa'i khrug /rus pa'i bcud du bsgoms nas 'cha'/ mizhes pa ltar shes ldan rnams kyis brtags tshe bzhad gad kyi gnas te/ sgam po tshul khrims snying po gnyal bod snyir 'khrungs pas/ sto rgyud gnyal zhes kun la grags shing / mkhas pa kun gyis gleng ba'i lung bstan la bzo bcos byed pa ni byed pa po rang nyid thun por dngos su bstan pa'i phyir na tshig gzhan rnams la legs nyes kyi rtog dpyod bya ma dgos so/ /gzhan yang chos kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po'i thugs gar thim pa'i skor der gtam rgyad sngon ma 'ga' zhig gi lugs bskyar ba las/ rang lugs dang gzhan luṅgersha kyi dbye ba phyed pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes

49rab kyi dpyad pa med pa'i dgos med kyi tshig tshogs sogs kyis mtshon pa la rmongs pa rnams yang dag par 'dod srid na'ang / blo ldan dag ci'i phyir rjes su 'jug ste/ mi gtsang ba'i ngan skyugs kyi phung po la khyi phag sogs kyis longs spyod na'ang / mi'i 'gro ba su zhig gis za bar mi byed pa bzhin no//de nas dbon sras/ mang srong mang btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung / dus der rgya rnams kyis sprul pa'i rgyal po ma bzhugs par shes nas dmag 'ongs pa 'phrul snang du sleb pa dang / the brtsegs kyi sku las sprul pa'i dmag byung bas phyir bros/ de'i lan du mgar gyis bod dmag 'bum tsho khrid nas rgya rnams bcom/ mgar yang dmag thog tu grongs/ de nas slar rgya dmag gi skad chen po byung bas jo bo sto sgo me long can du bcug sgo la zhal ba byas nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bris/ mi ring bar rgya dmag rnams lhags te po ta la'i pho brang me la bsregs/ jo bo shākya mu ni 'khyer ma thub kyang mi bskyod rdo rje snga dro gcig gi sar gdan drangs so/ /mang srong dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la gtsang gi bar snang sgang du gshegs/ bang so gung srong gi g.yon du brtsigs/ rje de la 'bro bza' khru bo khri ma long khab tu bzhes pa'i sras 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po yab 'das nas zhag 'ga' zhig song ba dang 'khrungs/ 'di'i ring la rngog ring la nag pos glang po che'i phru gu theg pa/rngog gling gam gyis g.yag grus po che theg gnon rgyal mtshan gyis mda' ste'u kha mas bya khra'i sked pa gcad/ dbas rgod sdongs btsan gyis mig rgyang gsum la mda' rgyang gis sleb/ 'gos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i rlid bu bye mas bkang ba klad la bskor/ cog ro 'brong shor gyis 'brong 'thur du brgyags pa gyen la 'then/ gnon khri bdun g.yu sbyin gyis rta g.yang la mchongs rā gyen la 'then nus pa ste/ rtsal po che bdun byung / bang so mang srong g.yon du brtsigs/

50rje de dang mchims bza' btsan mo rtog ge'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshoms pho brang ldan mkhar du 'khrungs/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ da ste gdung rabs lnga na nga'i dbon sras rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i lung bstan zangs kyi byang bu la bris pa brnyed pas/ rang nyid du go ste/ gangs ti se nas pazlo ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gdan drangs kyang ma 'drongs/ 'on kyang pho nya bas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs pas/ glegs bam lnga po bzhengs te/bzhugs khang du brag dmar mgrin bzang / brag dmar ke ru/ gsang mkhar brag mchim po sna ral/ ma sa gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul ging shi nas gser 'od dam pa dang 'dul ba las rnam par 'byed pa dang / sman dpyad kyi rigs 'ga' zhig bskyar/ li yul nas rab tu byung ba spyan drangs nas gus par mdzad kyang bod rikyi mig rab tu byung ba ni ma byung / snying ba stag rtse nas nor khyad du 'phags pa g.yu zhig rnyed/ 'jang mo khri btsun khab tu bzhes par sras 'jang tsha lha dpon zhes pa lta bas chog mi shes pa'i mdzes sdog can zhig 'khrungs par bod na de'i btsun mor thos pa'i na chung ma rnyed pas/curgya rje yag 'jam li khri bzher lang ma'i sras mo kong jo bsu ba'i skyes kyi dngos po dang pho nya mngags par legs nyes ston pa'i me long zhig yod par bltas pas yar klungs kyi yul dge bcu'i yon tan yongs su tshang zhing / rgyal bu de lha'i khye'u ltar mdzes pa zhig tu mthong nas byon na'ang / gnyags kyi bu mo ma blangs pa'i 'khon gyis gnyags khri ba nga yang 'don gyis rgyal bu bkrongs/bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ dus der kong jos me long la bltas pas/ rgyal bu bzhin mi sdag pa zhig tu mthong ba bzhin bod nas gtam ngan pa skyel mi byung na'ang byon/ gyu jo bo rgyal rabs gsum du mun par bzhugs pa sto sgo me long

51can nas bton te gtsang khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa btsugs/ mchims phur mes ag tshoms kyi btsun mor mnga' gsol lo//smras pa/legs byas sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa'i 'phags mchog thugs rje'i chu gter las//mngon par thon pa'i srong btsan nyin byed nub phyogs chu lha'i stor gzims kyang // slar yang khri srong bsil sbyin mkhan po dbang phyogs ri po'i spror son pas//phan dang bde ba'i kun da bzhad do lus can gnyis skyes gar byos kye//bgrod dka'i yul kun ngal ba brgya phrag gis//dā ri dra bzhin myul bar ma phyin kyang //brtan g.yo'i chos kyi gnas tshul kun 'char ba//skyes thob shes rab me long gsar pa'i drin//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// // ༈ de yang mgon po zur phud lnga pa'i 'phrin las su la /'a 'khor lo'i lta ba lhan gyis grub pa'i mchod sdong chen po bod kyi rgyal po'i rigs kyi skyes bu misdu khyu mchog tu 'phags par sprul nas lugs zung gi rtsibs stong thogs pa med par 'khor ba'i ched du yab khri lde gtsug brtan dang / yum kong jo gnyis kyi sras su sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta'i lo pho brang brag dmar du rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams/ dus der rgyal po'i btsun mo rnam snang bzas kyang

62rgyal po'i sras shig mngal du chags pa skad zer nas kong jo'i sras phrogs te khong rang las skyes pa ltar byas pas/ rje blon rnams the tshom du gyur pas zhal lce gcod pa'i spobs pa ma byung zhing / kong jo yid ma rangs par bod kyi sa dpyad bzang ba 'ga' zhig nyams su bcug mi ring bar sras zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la btsun mo gnyis kyi pha ming dang blon 'bangs rnams 'tshogs pa'i dbus su/ rgyal pos 'bras chang gis bkang pa'i gser gyi phor pa sras kyi lag tu gtad de/sdod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di//bu khyod rang gi zhang po'i lag tu thod//ma gang yin gyi yid ches de la byed//gsungs pas/ sras kyis rin po che'i phor pa rgya rnams kyi lag tu gtad nas/nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin//rnam snang gang gi don mi 'tshal//gsungs pa dang / kong jo yid rab tu dga' ste/tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis//nga rgya nas 'ongs pa'i bu mo la//rje 'gran med rgyal po'i sras shig 'khrungs//zhes sogs kyi gtam smras nas/ sngar sa dbyad nyams su bcug pa rnams bsos skad/ dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bas/ chos rgyal 'khrungs lo la sba bzhed bu

53stonagyilugasasogasayib tshangamangapozhig gi 'dod pa bskyar zhing / sba bzhed kyi lugs de 'khrul par bshad ma thag tu/ sba bzhed kyi gtam rgyas tshang bar bris pa la/ rang lugs 'thad ldan du bzhag pa dang / gzhan lurshas mi 'thad par dgag pa'i rnam dbye med par mig gis mthong tshad dang rna bas thos tshad yi ger bri ba ni sos dus kyi nyi ma 'phul byed kyi thabs ni yin mchis/ mkhas pa chen po bu ston zhabs kyi gsung phal cher tshad mar gda' bas/ rgyal po sa rta la 'khrungs par gsungs pa 'di yig mkhan gyis nor ba'i rgyun 'byams pa zhig yin nam/ gang ltar chos rje bsod nams grags pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan sa rta la 'khrungs pa dang / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po me glang la 'khrungs par byed pa ni/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa shar ba zhig gis brtags tshe lo grangs bcu gnyis tsam mi 'grig pa'i mu cor gyi gtam du zad do/ /sras dgung lo chung ngu'i dus/ rgya yul du sang shi gtsug lag 'ga' zhig len du gtang bar lam du zhugs pa dang / rgya yul gyi ju zhag mkhas pa zhig gis/ da ste zla ba gsum na nub phyogs nas bod btsad po'i pho nya rtags dang sha tshugs 'di 'dra ba 'byung zhes gzugs brnyan bris nas rgyal por gsol ba bzhin byang bas/ rgya rje dgyes pa'i bka' stsal zhing / mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa'i glegs bam sogs bya dga' chen po gnang / dus skabs de dag na bod du yab rgyal po dgung lo drug cu re gsum la gshegs/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ sang shi slar bod du yong ba'i lam du ha shang mngon shes can zhig la bod kyi bde dog dris pas/ btsan po gshegs/ rgyal bu nar ma son/ bdud blon rnams kyis khrims bu chung bcas nas chos bsnub pa sogs kyi lung bstan/ 'on kyang rgyal bu nar son pa na glegs bam gsum po 'di rnams rim gyis snyan du gsol/ za

65sang shi bod da sleb nas gsal snang stod da song ba'i go rim mdzad pa 'di 'thad do// zhu gami ring bar rgyal bu sku nar son te/ mes rnams kyi yig tshang gzigs pas chos mdzad par dgongs pa'i gtam mdzad pas sang shis sngar ha shang gis lung bstan pa'i dus der go nas glegs bam rnams rdza khrod nas blangs te/ dge ba bcu'i mdo/ rdo gcod/ sa lu ljang pa rnams gzigs su phul bas lta spyod dag cing zung du 'brel bar go nas dad de/ rgya me mgo dang kha che a nartas skad 'gyur byas pas ma zhang sogs kyis bkag chos blon rnams kyis sang shi stod du brdzangs/ gsal snang gis byang chub chen po dang / na lend+rar mchod pa byas/ mkhan po rin po che dang mjal te mang yul du spyan drangs/ gsal snang gis btsad po'i drung du 'ongs nas mkhan po'i gsung dang rgyu mtshan rgyal por gsol/ ma zhang gi chad pa byung dogs nas gsal snang yibs su bcugabatsad pos lkog tu 'gos rgan sogs chos blon rnams dang bka' bgros nas/mo rtsis pa sogs lung bstan mkhan po rnams la bya dga' byin te/ rgyal po rgyal srid dang bcas pa la chags chen po bdog pas/ de'i rim gror blon po che ba zhig zla ba gsum gyi bar la dur du 'jug dgos par bsgrag tu bcug ste/'gos kyi rkang pa la bya rgod kyi lham gon pa sogs thabs 'phrul du mas ma zhing dang lhan cig par dur nang du phyin nas phyir bros pas ma zhang gis bsnyabs kyang rgod spa snyim pa gang las ma byang / de ma thag dong kha bcad de/ rje blon kun chos snyed pa'i chad so byas/stode nas rigs kyis mngon par mtho ba za hor rgyal po'i gdung las 'khrungs shing / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos kyi brgyud gnas lnga rig pa'i nyag phran gyis bkug pa'i mkhas pa mtha' dag gi bla na mtho ba rnam par dag

56pa'i tshul khrims dri ma med pa'i ma la ya'i rlung bzhon gyis sdom brtson gnyis 'thung gi tshogs la dga' mgur spyod pa'i dpal ster ba/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa'i grags snyan ga: ga'i cod pan phyogs kyi 'gram par 'god pa'i mkhan po rin po che bo dhi sa tā spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar gsal snang brdzangs pa bzhin rim gyis phebs te/ 'om bu tshal du mjal/mkhan pos rgyal po la dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad la sogs pa'i chos mang po bshad pas/ bod kyi lha srin rnams khros nas dmar po ri'i pho brang la thog brgyab/ lo nyes dang mi phyugs la nad chen po byung bas/ sdig blon rnams kyis 'go byas pa'i bod 'bangs phal cher gyis chos byas pas lan zer nas mi dga' ba byas pas/ btsad pos rgya mtshan mkhan po'i snyan du gsol pa la/mkhan pos yab mes kyi ring la gtsursha lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzheng ba/ chos bsgyur ba sogs mdzad na'ang / lha srin rnams ma btul bas/btsan po 'ga' zhig gi sku tshe la bar chad dang / chos la sked nyag sogs skyon 'ga' zhig byung 'dug pas/ sa gzhi 'di dag drag pos 'dul ba'i ched du/yo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'dzam bu gling na che ba'i rigs sngags mkhan zhig yod pa de/ rgyal po nyid dang sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzheng ba'i dus su smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pas spyan drangs na/btsad po'i rnam par dkar ba'i thugs kyi bzhed pa mtha' dag 'grub par lung bstan nas/ mkhan pos bal por pyon/ de nas slar btsan pos thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pas 'bangs mtha' dag chos bya bar khas blangs/ mkhan pos lung bstan pa de rmi lam du byung ba ltar mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes mchog gi zlos gar las sin dhu rgya mtsho'i gling du sku 'khrungs shing 'chi med tshe'i rigs 'dzin dang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos

57grub brnyes pa/ dus gsum cig car du mkhyen pa'i slob dpon chen po mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya snga rting du brdzangs shing / slar sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs lam du bshad drag pos rin po che'i phyag rten dang bcas te mngags pas pho nya rnams ngal zhing dub pa slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis mang yul gung thang du phebs pa na mjal/ slob dpon gyis nyi zla thang la phabs pa/ chu bo gyen la bzlog pa sogs sku'i bkod pa'i rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan te pho nya rnams ldog tu med pa'i mos pa brtan po thob/ phyag rten gyi gser rnams mnga' ris phyogs su gtor te/ ma 'ongs par bod da gser gyi 'dod rga 'byang ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/ de nas rim gyis lam bye zhugs te phebs the na/༄ bod kyi lha 'dre stobs po che phal che bas go mtshams par/ gsang ba gsum gyi mtha' glas pa'i nus mthus srog gi snying po blangs nas dam la btags/ stod lung gzhong pa ma da' ru phebs pa na/lha bzang klu dpal soṭa blon po rnams kyis bsu ba dang mjal nas dro 'debs par chu med pa la slob dpon gyis phyag 'khar btab pas nyal 'gro'i rgyan babs pa/ zu gzhong pa lha chu grags/ de nas mnga' bdag rgyal po 'khor drocas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te mjal nas brag dmar mgrin bzang du bzhugs/ slar mkhan po gdan 'dren gyi pho nya ba mngags te phebs/ dus der rje blon gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i bka' bgros nas 'bangs rnams bsaṭa te/ zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba'i mkhar zhig rtsig gam/ shel gyi mchod rten shar ri dang mnyam pa zhig rtsig gam/ gtsang po sbubs su 'jug gam/ lha khang bre tshad tsam zhig rtsig gam/ zhes 'dam ka btang bas gzhan rnams blo'i yul las 'das te lha khang rtsig par kha 'cham/ shākya mu ni mang yul nas gdan drangs te 'phrul snang gtsugs lag khang du bzhugs su bcug slob dpon

58bod du yun ring bzhugs ma bzhugs kyi lo rgyus du ma snang ba/ mchog dman gyi blo rngor shar tshul yin yang / rgyu mtshan ma go bar so so'i lugs la zhen te gtam sna tshogs smra ba ni/ rje sa pa'i gyis/ 6 mkhas pa rang gis dpyod shes kyi/ thun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / khyi rgan ku co 'don pa na/rgya mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyag ces gsung ba'i rnam thar 'dzin pa yin snang / bya ba sprul pa'i sku padma stodakar por grags pa'i snyigs dus kyi mkhas pa chen po de'i gsung las/ de ni dus gcig la sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul can yin pas/ de dag la go rim mi dgos kyi gtan tshigs su bsgrub dka' 'o/ /zhes pa ni rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i legs bshad kyi gsung yin no//de nas slob dpon gyis sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags te lha 'dre rnams dga' ba'i mthun rdzas dang bcas/ dregs pa zil gnon gyi mgur gsungs nas nam mkha' la rdo rje'i gar mdzad cing sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/rgyal pos dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol/ gser gyi sta re thogs nas ming brkos pas khru gang tsam gyis 'og nas sa zhag dkar ser dmar gsum ro phun sum tshogs pa bro ba byung bas btsan po thugs dgyes so/ / de nas mkhan pos gtsug lag khang gi bzo dbyibs kyi bkod pa mdzad par bzhed de/ sngon mu stegs kyi rigs 'dzin zhig gis ro bsgrabs pas dngos grub len par nye ba na/ grogs rtags mtshan dang ldan pa zhig stodagos pas/ dbus 'gyar 'chang gi dge slong sgrab pa po'i dge tshul la ldan par shes nas/ gser sgro maṇḍal dge slong la ri/ du phul nas/ dge tshul dang lhan du sgrab khang du phyin te/ dge tshul la ro'i lce gcod tshul bslabs te/ lce ga the gyi ral grir 'gro ba bzung nas yid la gang yod sar 'gro nus pas nged la thod/ ro gser du 'gro ba
