114gis si tu chang gu'i las ka blangs/ sras phyi tshar zla ba rgyal mtshan/ 'khon ston bsod nams pa'i yum rnams 'khrungs/ gcung 'jam dbyangs pa rje btsun sa paṇa gyi dus su 'khor du skyes pa dran/ shes bya'i gnas la blo gros kyi 'jug pa mchog tu yangs shing / kwa ding gu sri'i las ka bzung / yab dang gcen gyi bka' bzhin rab byung gi bslab pa phul/ sras lcam sring gsum 'khrungs/gu'i gung chos grags pa'i sras che ba bdag chen rnam rgyal grags bzang gis ta'i si tu'i las ka dang / gcung dkon cog legs pas sri'i zi'i dre hos kyi las ka bzung ste srid kyi 'byor ba shin tu che/ khyad par gcen gyi lo chen byang chub rtse mo sogs dam pa du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi myang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po shu ri pu tra dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal ba la zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsan/ khyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pas/ mkhas pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / mi nyag chos grags bzang po sogs kyis/ chos rgyal 'di nyid kyi zhabs la gtugs nas/ dus 'khor gyi rgyad 'grel gsan/ rtses thang pa sangs rgyas lhan grub kyis rigs ldan 'di nyid skyo drung du dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'thel mthang phyin par gsan nas/slar dbus su paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i drung du rig gnas kyi thugs sbyong mdzad pa'i skabs/ bdag chen 'di nyid kyis legs par bshad pa'i dus 'khor gyi gsung gleng byung bas thugs ha las te/ nyid kyi gsung 'di ltar na nged kyis sngar brtsams pa rnams la yang bcos byed dgos par 'dug gsungs skad/ mdor na dbus gtsang mtha' dag tu zur gnas rnams/ rigs ldan padma dkar po slar byon pa yin zhes gling zhing / gzhan yang theg pa che chung gi gsung rab mtha' dag la mkhyen spyan yangs pas/ skabs shig dus bzhi cig car ba dang rim gyis pa'i skor la bdag chen nyid kyis na bza' ber gyi phu dung

115brjes te thal 'gyur 'phen pa sogs mkhas pa rnams spa bkong bar mdzad/dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs 'grel dang / 'jig rten mes po'i gtsug lag mi mthun pa'i nad kyi rtsa ba drungs nas dbyung bar byed pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun gyi yang snying rje btsun g.yu thog pa chen po'i ring lugs gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos/ log smra tshar gcod pa sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos kyi nying khu ka lā pa'i mdo rgyan/ bzo rig pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad/ bstan pa'i gnas tshad/ gsang bsngags kyi lha'i sgrab thabs kyi rim pa/ ma 'ongs mngon sum gsal bar ston pa gtsug lag rtsis༄ kyi skor/ mkhas grub chos rje'i rtsod lan sogs legs par bshad pa'i rtsom pa'i rigs ji snyed cig mchis shing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos slangs sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng mang du mdzad/ mnal lam du slob dpon chen po zhal gzigs pa dang rje sa chen la thugs dad shugs drag po 'khrungs pas sa chen dbu gtsug nas thim pa'i snang ba sogs rtogs pa'i yon tan kyang mtha' yas shing rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pas rgyal po pa ta zhes snyan pa'i rgyud kyis rgya gar mkhas pa'i khengs dregs kyi gzhu yongs su 'gugs shing / rin po che'i rgyan sogs mi chen gyi cha lugs dang ldan bzhin dus dge'i mtshan nyid kyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams la gsung rab mtha' dag brgal brtag gis gtan la 'bebs pa'i bgro gleng mdzad pa sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom pas dus 'da' bas spyir yang ngo mtshar che/ khyad par 'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom pa'i dregs ldan chos smra ba'i lce mdud pa brgya phrag gis bcings pa rnams kyi snang tshul la dpags na rjes su yi rang ngo//de rjes nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje/ de'i sras nam mkha' rin cen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' legs pa gsum las 'bring po rab tu

116byang / chung ba lho byang yongs la mnga' sgyur/ dpa' gtum gyi grags che/pached gsum gyi rigs las nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan kun dga' rin cen/ bkra shis stobs rgyas dbang po'i sde sogs 'khrungs pa las/ 'di nyid slob dpon chen po'i zab chos kyi bdag por bka' babs so /smras pa/'od gsal 'chi med lam las babs pa'i 'khon gyi brgyud pa rin po che//shar phyogs gong ma'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod chen po'i las ka 'dod rga'i char//'dzam gling khyon kun mngo par snyil ba'i mu thi la yi kā ṇi ka/rin cen nyams 'gyur phra tshoms kyis mdzes ya rabs mdun sa'i rgyan du spel//g.yung po'i lugs min rigs rus cho 'brang ldan//gong ma'i lung 'dzin srid kyis mngon mtho'i mkhar// rnam dkar zla shel dri med zil mngar can//bde skyid kun dga' ba'i grogs su 'dzag/ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//༄4/ /kha bas bskor ba'i ljongasachen po 'di nyid bye ༄pal dwags po'i bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa nags klung stag po'i dbus su dpag bsam yongs 'du'i smon pa lta bu ni dpal phag spro gru pa rdo rje rgyal bo zhes dbang po

117tha mal pa rtsod dus kyi gdul bya'i snang ngor rim gyis sbyangs pa'i sar gnas kyi sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin cing / dbang po yang rab la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas yin par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i stan grags lha yi rdza rnga sgrub rgyad rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi rtse mor brdungs pas me tog mda' can rnye min gyi tshoṭa mtha' dag ba ga nus las 'das te phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas kyi bdud rtsir spyod pa la nyer 'tshe'i bsam pa ring du gtong ba'i byed po theg pa chen po'i glang chen sa la rab brtan gyi steng du rnam par 'gying zhing / ye shes 'dren byed stong gis ji lta ji snyed kyi chos mtha' dag rjen par 'char ba kun stong chen phyag rgya gcig gi rgyas thebs pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas bdag 'dzin ri bo'i bgrod pa ming gi lhag mar btang ba'i skyes mchog mchod sbyin brgya pa 'di nyid kyi bka' brgyud yin la/de yang chos srid kyi 'byor pa bla na med pa'i sgo nas yar ldan du spel ba ni rje spyan snga rin po che dang / gong ma ta'i si tu sogs dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung las rim par byon pa rnams yin pas/ rlangs kyi po ti bse ru las/tsa lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye brgyud ma shes na nags khung gi spre'u dang 'dra/mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na g.yu 'brug thol ma dang 'dra/ yab mes kyi che ge'i yig tshang ma shes na/ mon phyug yal bor dang 'dra zhes dang / sna skyes pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/ byas pa'i chos la grub pa'i mtha' dgos/che ba'i mi la mtho ba'i rtags dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod gsil bur ma song ba'i snga rabs kyi dus rje 'bangs mtha' dag rigs rus 'chol bar mi spyod pas khungs dang yig tshang la nan tan du byed pa'i srol 'dug cing / deng sang ni 'di rigs kyi rgyu mtshan mang du smra ba/ che sprel rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/ /mjug ma med ces bzhad gad byed/ ces pa'i tshul lta bur 'gro bar

118 gda' na'ang gong gi 'phros las 'di nyid cung zad brjod na/po ti bse ru las/ 6 'bangs kyi mi rabs la/ 'byang ba sna lngalisnying po la/ sgo nga chen po gcig yongs pa/ phyi'i sgong shun la hūṃ brag dkar po chags/ nang gi sgong chu la dung mtsho dkar mer 'khyil/ rgyabar gyi sgo nga'i dar cha la/ rigs drug sems can kun tu grol/ /sgo nga 'phrum gyi bco brgyad chags/ sgo nga bco brgyad 'bring po de/ dung sgong gcig tu yar nas byung // zhes bshad pa ltar/ dung gi sgo nga de la dbang po lnga dang yan lag rnams so sor dod de mtshar sdug gi khye'u yid la smon pa lta bu zhig byung bas ming ye smon rgyal por btags/ de'i jo mo chu lcag rgyal mo la/ 'phrul sras dbang ldan 'khrungs/ des dung bza' dngul mo blangs pa la/ kwa sras skyes gcig 'khrungs/ de'i sras mi rabs mched gsum las/ chung ba stag tshal 'al 'ol gyi jo mo 'tshams bza' khyad khyud la sras mgur lha mched bzhi byung / chung ba'i sras yab lha sde drug gi chung ba 'o de gung rgyal gyi jo mo lha mo la/ lha tsha mched dgu byung / jo mo gnyan mo la gnyan tsha mched dgu/ jo mo tshus mo la/ skyi tsha mched dgu/ jo mo klu bza' la klu tsha mched brgyad byung / kun bsgril bas sras sum cu rtsa lnga byung / di rnams kyi chung ba sne khrom lag khru'i jo mo lha lcam la/ la kha rgyal po 'khrubs/ de'i jo mo lung kha hril mo la sras gsum gyi che ba mthing gi/ de'i jo mo lha lcam dkar mo la sras bod 'jongs la brang gi rmu bza' mthing bsgril khab tu bzhes par rgya khri la zhang 'khrungs/ de la sras rgyal po che chung gsum/ brgyud brgyad yod pa las/chung ba'i jo mo mthing mo la sras gsum byung ba'i khri rje gnyan thang gi sras dpal lha/ de'i sras a mi mu zi khri do'i jo mo gnyan bza' sha mig la sras gsum dang / rmu bza' la sras gcig zen bza' la bras gnyis te drug byung

119la/ 'di dag las mched pa rus chen bco brgyad/ 'bras la dkar nag khru gsum sogs dang / bod mi'u gdung drug byung tshul shin tu mang zhing / 66stod kyi 'bras dkar mched dgu la/ /bal po dang bal yo bal srid gsum/ /ma stong bal stong con stong drug /mar ba dang zhang chung pu rangs dgu/ mi zhes sogs dbye ba zhin tu mang zhing / bse khyung 'bras kyi jo mo btsan bza' dge ldan ma'i sras/ 'bras khru bo/ de'i jo mo srun bza' khru mo la sras bzhi byung ba'i sa ches hor bza' 'bum mo khab tu bzhes pa la khyung ru dkar po/ de'i sras 'bram re shel mig de'i gras ar rje gtsug gsum/ de la gnam lha mched brgyad kyi lnga pas sras su sprul pa'i ming mang sdom stag btsan/ de'i jo mo rong bza' khye lcam la sras ma byung bas thugs ma bde bar lha yul du byon te rang gi gcen rnams la dris par/ rang re lha mas mched brgyad kyi//khyed ni mi yi sras su sprul//bu dang sras med thugs chad na//zla ba bcu gsum sgrub pa mdzod//yi dam sgoms la gsang sngags bgrongs//lo gsar zla ba bcu gsum la//lta ri gnyan po can du byon//bsangs dang mchod pa gsol ba thob//lha tshangs sras mo 'grub ste 'ong //lha tshangs sras mo 'grub pa na//lha yi sras la mi yi brgyud// rigs brgyud khyad du 'phags pa 'ong //

120mi rabs bdun cu rtsa gsum par//bla ma mi dpon rgyun mi chad//sems can kun gyi 'dren pa dang //dpa' bos rgyal khams 'dul ba dang //grags pa sa steng khebs pa 'ong /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par mi yul du byon te sgrub pa mdzad/ lo gsar gyi zla ba la lha ri'i rtser byon te mchod pa mdzad pas nam mkha' las 'ja' tshon sna lnga pa byung zhing bar snang la rol mo'i sgra sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung bas/ tshangs sras lha mo 'khor brgyad dang bcas pa byon par gzigs te/ chung ma mdzad par gsol ba bzhin 'khor rnams 'od du yal/lha mos zhal gyis bzhes/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus chus jo mo'i sku lus bkrus nas yul du byon/ yun ring du song kyang sras ma byung / skabs zhig nam mkha' nas sgra zhig la/ lha mang ldom stag btsan dmag la byon/ /rgya dmag bod du lhags dogs yod/ rgya dmag bod du lhags pa na/ /khyod min gang gis thub mi 'gyur/ zhes byung bas mang sdom gyis chibs ngang dkar g.yu gshog la chibs/ dngul dkar gyi dung khrub dang shel dkar gyi rmog de gyon/ 'od 'bar gyi mtshon btags nas/ nam mkha' la lha dmag dang chu rgyud la klu dmag rnams 'grim du bcug ste byon pas/ rgya rnams bros te g.yul las rgyal/ skabs der sman btsun gyis lha yul nas khrid pa'i dung gi mdzo mo bros pa mang sdom gyis bkag sman btsun gyis mdzo mo 'tshol du 'ongs pa gzigs nas/ mdzo mo mi 'gro ba'i phyag rgyas bcings te pha bong gur 'dra'i nang du byon/ sgo bsdams te zur gcig nas gzigs pas/ sman btsun gyis mdzo mo la 'o ma bzhos pa'i phud kyis dkon cog dang / mang sdom gyi skyabs

122 rlangs kyi gdung brgyad ces ming de nas chags/ 'ga' zhig tu ga gla btags su snang ba ni yig /khan gyis ma dag pa'i rgyan 'byams par nges so/ /de'i jo mo ldong bza' khri sgron la sursha dpa' bo/ de'i jo mo lcog ro bza' lha gnam gyi sras stong tho/ de'i sras che che/ de'i sras rgod sding /gcen po'i steng du rgod lding ba ltar 'phur bas ming de ltar chags/ de'i sras stong dge/ de'i sras stong khri/ de'i sras phag tshang / de'i sras ldang ra/ de'i sras gtsug gnyen rdzong khong / de'i sras btsan pa 'dab zhong / de'i sras snang gnyan khong sleb/ de'i sras mang po che sgro kha/ de'i sras stag po che dar dpal/'dis ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du gser gyi shākya mu ni bzhengs/ g.yu snang ba 'od ldan yon du phul/ byu ru bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi mchod rdzas byas/grub thob seng ge rab gnas su gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ sgang bza' lha mo la sras gcig 'khrungs pa/ grub thob kyis mtsho ni bzang zhing bras 'di lha'i spyan gyis gzigs pa zhig byung bas/ mtsho bzang lha gzigs su thogs gsung /'di nas bzung ste rlangs lha gzigs su grags/'di'i sras a mi byang chub 'dre 'khol te/ dgung lo brgyad la o rgyan du byon pa dang / srin po btul nas phyir byon pa'i tshe yi dam gyi lha zhal gzigs pa dang / ge sar gyis gling yul du lan gnyis gdan drangs pa'i phyi ma'i tshe/ pha bong gra ba rta 'dra ba la chibs nas phyogs bzhir gdon chen po bzhi btul ba sogs rdzu 'phrul ni mtha' yas shing / sngar byang chub rdo rje zer yang / phyis lha srin bran du 'khol bas 'dre 'khol du mtshan chags/ slob dpon chen po padmas kyang / che byang dang chub ces bya ba yi/ mi bu khyad du 'phags pa 'ong / de ni nga yi thugs kyi sras/ zhes gsungs shing / byang chub 'dre 'khol nyid kyi gsung du yang / zu da nas mi rabs bcu gsum na/

123bod khams yongs kyi bdag po 'ong / zhes lung bstan pa/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i pho brang tshun gyi mchog dman gyi skye bo mtha' dag gi mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du gyur pa de ltar yin la/ 'di'i jo mo skal ldan ma la bras dpal gyi seṅge/ gnyan thog a khrom/ stag tshab gsum las/ 'bring po gnyan thog a khrom gyi sras gnyan po nya sog khri/ de'i sras rlangs ston bya zhu nag po/de'i sras a seng / de'i sras a ser/ de'i sras skyabs bdun dpal dang brgyad/ btsan dang dgu zhes pa'i che ba yon chen rgyal ba skyabs yin la/ de yang rlangs stod tho yi spyi dpon mdzad/ mgo rum seng ges rgya bcom/ rtse 'thon gyis drag po spun bzhi btul/ ldong sras kyis 'dan yul dbang du bsdus pa sogs 'jig rten mi chos nas mngon par mtho ba shin tu mang zhing / dam pa'i lha chos kyi sgo nas/ byang chub 'dre 'khol ni gong du smos zin pa dang /de'i sras gsum gyis dpag par dka' ba'i sprul sgyur mdzad pa dang / rlangs khams pa go chas rab tu byung ba'i sang mi mi bdun gyi bar mar grags/rlangs dpal gyi seṅges slob dpon chen po'i thugs sras mdzad de grub pa brnyes/ye shes rdo rjes nyi ma stong la mnan/ ye shes seṅges dpal thang du jag pa btul/ dpal gyi 'byung gnas kyis lha 'dre dam la btags/ dar ma seṅges dur khrod bsil ba tshal du byon/ dpal gyi rdo rjes nyi zer la chos gos bkal ba sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dpag par dka' ba sha stag tu byon pa yin no// smras pa/'chi ba mid pa'i lam las legs 'ongs lha rigs rlangs kyi pad dkar tshal//

124khams grub ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs 'du ngo mtshar 'phur sding rol gar can//thosang chen theg pa'i ze'u 'bru rab ldem dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i za ma tog/lo rgyas myangs na zhim pa'i ro bcud skabs gsum stobadag po'i bdud rtsi bzhin//mdo khams yul gyi zla ba'i ma ma las//lha gzigs gdung gi mngon mtho'i bsil zer can//gangs can legs bris lam du 'phags pa'i tshe//skal ba nga skye rgu'i sa smos 'dod pa 'jo//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //de yang yon chen rgyal ba skyabs la jo mo 'bro ldog bza' dang / de gu ma/ 'bro bza' ye shes mtsho dang gsum las/ dang po'i sras rje spyan snga rin po che dpon sangs rgyas bskyabs/ dpon shes rab rgyal/ gnyis pa'i sras dpon mgon po rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa'i sras rgyal ba rin po che/ bcu gnyis pa gter rgyal ba rin cen rdo rje rnams las/rje spyan snga rin po che ni yab mes dang bka' brgyud kyi chos kyis gtso mdzad/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam lhur blangs pas/sgrab ris yongs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ shar rgyal po'i lung gis ཿthong tshad bsad na thos tshad skrag pa'i las rngam po che gsog pa'i byed po dor rta nag po yang rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul bar mdzad pas/ kha ba ri pa rnams la gcig tu bka' drin che/

126de rjes rgyal ba rin po che rab tu byung ba'i mtshan grags pa brtson 'grus te/ dbus su phebs nas rje spyan snga rin po ches byin gyis brlabs pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rtogs pa 'khrungs/ mkhas grub kyi yon tan phul du byon zhing / nam mkha' las thog babs pa sku chos su gtums pas rgyal sras thog rdugs pa zhes nus mthu'i snyan pa che/ gdan sar phebs nas sing snya gling ti ra ha ti ya rtse rgyal po rnams kyis rnam thos kyi bu la 'gran par nus pa'i mkho /gu'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul zhing / khyad par sog po rbad 'gyel du grags pa'i nor bu sogs nor sna'i rigs kyi mchod rdzas bod yul du gdan sa thel bzang bar grags pa yang 'di'i dus byung / spyan snga rin po che yan chad du gong ma'i 'ja' sa sogs med 'dug na'ang / 'di nyid kyi dus ha la har gtogs pa rnams gong ma'i lung gi 'ja' sa dang bcas ldan ma sgom rshartson ༄gyis spyi dpon byas na'ang lugs dang 'brel bar ma byang bas/dpon rdo rje dpal rkang bzhi'i dpon byed kyin yod pa rgyal ba rin po༄ ches tshur bkug ste khri dpon du bskos/ gong sar lan gsum byon/ pho brang sgang /tshong 'dus brag kha/ sne'u gdong / sna mo/ ha la sgang / thang po che gling smad/ 'phyos gzhis ka/ mon mkhar bkra shis gdong / rgyal thang / lcags rtse gri khu/ mchod rten gling / chad dkar te gzhis ka bcu gnyis brtsigs/mnga' thang zhin tu mtho zhing / dpon rang yang mgo la sgom zhwa dang / lus la chos gos rnam gsum gyon/ btsun tshugs ma dor bas lugs gnyis thad nas kun gyis mtho bzos che/ 'khor rnams kyang 'chun che ba'i stabs kyis drag zhan mtha' dag gis dpon gyis gzigs sar bag yangs kyi spyod pa byed mi nus skad/chos rje bsod grags pas/ bcu gnyis rin po che'i dus ging ma'i 'ja' sa byung ba dang / tshes bzhi pa'i dus dpon rdo rje rin cen gyis khri dpon byas

126par smra ba sogs ni yig tshang khungs thub rnams ma gzigs par tshod 'jog tu bris pa'i skyon kho na ste/ lo rgyas rnams ma nges bzhin du 'bri dgos pa mo rtsis pa bzhin gyis lung bstan byung stob yin na thugs bden par mchis so//'gro mgon rin po che'i sprul pa bcu gnyis rin po che rdo rje ni lung rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' yas shing / gdan sar phebs nas pu rangs lo chung gi thugs dam dgra nag la gsol ba btab pas sto rgyud kyi 'khrug pa zhi ba dang mngon par mkhyen pa thogs pa med pa sogs rnam thar ya mtshan can mang zhing /'di'i dus khri dpon rdo rje dpal grongs nas khong gi gcung gzhon nu rgyal mtshan khri dpon gyi go sar bskos kyang / mgo la sgyug zhwa/ lus la hor gos/ rkang pa la hor lham gyon/ mtshan phyed kyi ring glu len zhing bro brdung / nyin phyed kyi bar nyal ba sogs bag med kyi spyod pa kho nas dus 'da' bas phag mo gru pa'i sde tshugs la shin tu gnod pa byung / khong 'das rjes sto brag gshong sde mkhan po rin rgyal gong sar btang ste 'ja' sa zhus/ de rjes yar 'brog pa byang gzhon khri dpon du bskos na'ang sngon ma'i mig stos kyis bag med kyi spyod pa kho na'i dbang du song //dpon mgon po rgyal la sras rin cen shes rab/ grags pa ye shes/grags pa rin cen/ rin cen skyabs dang bzhi las/ grags pa ye shes ni sa skyar 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i drung du 'byon dus mdo sdad pa'i tshod tsam gyi phyag dpe thogs re la bzung bas mkhyen rab kyis gragadro pa che/ gdan sar bzhugs ring 'gro phan gyi sgo mchog tu yangs/ khri dpon byang gzhon gyi rjes su gzhon nu yon tan gyis khri dbon lo drug byas na'ang / chang nag kho na don du gnyer bas sde'i 'dzin tshugs ma byung /gcung grags pa rin cen thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin zhing gdan sar

127bzhugs thog ti sri grags 'od dang / rgyal po the mur bog gnyis kyi 'ja' sa stag mgo phul/ khri dpon zur du ma bskos par bla dpon sbrags nas mdzad/do sngon/ rgyal thang / smon mkhar/ sa 'thon/ byi chung / za ra tho thang /sding gsum/ g.yu sring / mon mkhar sogs gzhon rgyal 'od du dben sha/dpon chen legs pa dpal/ slob dpon a tsa ra/ dpon chen a blon/ sa skya pa sogs la shor ba rnams phyag rdzas kyis bslu bar mdzad pas/ phag gru khri bskos la bka' drin shin tu che zhing / de'i don gyis si tu rin po che'i bka' chems su/ zu sne'u gdong gi thab mgo 'dzin pa'i gzhis ka ming can 'di rnams zhi bar gshegs pas/ phyag rdzas kyis bslus pa'i gzhis kyang yin cing / sku drin che ba'i don gyis da lta nyi shu gnyis mchod 'di rang re nang so dang bza' pa mi sde dang bcas pas bdag rkyen byed pa'i don de yin mizhes gsung /dpon rin cen skyabs la jo mo zhang lcam ma dang khru smon 'bum skyid gnyis las/ dang po'i sras rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / grags pa rgyal mtshan/grags pa bzang po dang gsum/ 'bum skyid kyi sras gong ma ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan/ grags pa shes rab/ bsod nams bzang po ste yum mi gcig pa'i sku mched drug las/ grags pa rgyal mtshan thos bsam sgom pa mang du mdzad cing / khyad par mgon po'i bka' babs byung zhing gdan sa yun ring du mdzad/ 'di'i dus slob dpon rgyal mtshan bzang pos gong ma'i drung du phyin te lung dang lag rtags sbrel nas khri dpon byas na'ang / bag yangs kyi dbang du song nas lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin bkod tshar ma byung zhing / de'i rjes su rgyal mtshan skyabs kyis khri dpon gyi go sar bsdad kyang 'khos ka chung bas kun gyis brnyas pa byas te/ phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyi 'dzinagatsugs nyag phra ba byung /

12 de rjes ta'i si tu khri dpon gyi go sar phebs pa yin la/ 'di nyid ni/thang yig las/ zu yar klungs mthil nas rnam smin bskyed rgyal 'byung / / phag gis sa rlog dbus khams sa hor za/ /btsan rdzong brgya dang rtsa brgyad phyogs su 'byung /mi zhes pa'i lung bstan thog tu babs pa ste/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed po gser mngal can gyis gnam ka ba med pa'i sgo phye nas/ rin po che sna bdun sngon du 'gro ba can gyi gdong lnga'i dbang po'i gad rgyangs zad mi shes par sgrogs pa'i khri chen por snying stobs dpa' rtags kyi lus stobs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa srung dbang po'i snar rigs pa dang mi rigs pa'i sde bzhi'i spyod tshul la rmongs pa'i dra ba mtha' dag gcod pa'i shes rab kyi spu gri non po rang byan du 'khor yang ngo tsha dang khrel gzhung sogs ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul gyi 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi rgyan bzang pos mdzes par spud pas skye rga mtha' dag gi ra pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mor 'gying pa la skye bas thob pa'i skal༄ ba mchog gi legs byas kyi zhags pa ring po stong spyi phud kyi rgyal khams su khrims kyi thig drang por 'debs pa'i sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal po ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo la sku bltams/dgung lo gsum la 'bri klog mkhyen pa dang / drug la chos skyong bya rog gdong can gyi rjes gnang gsan pas shin tu 'go ba byung / dgung lo bdun pa la spyan snga chos bzhi pa'i drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mdos/ mtshan byang chub rgyal mtshan du btags/ dgu pa la mkhan chen tshul dar ba dang / slob dpon pu rangs pa la rab tu byung / bde mgon gyi bsnyen pa mdzad pas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes/ dgung lo bcu bzhi lon pa'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun la sa skyar 'byon pa'i grabs mdzad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i zla stod la sne'u gdong nas thon te glur bzhugs pa'i dgongs 'khor rnams kyis chang

12 mang du blangs te bag med kyi spyod pa byed par brtsams pas/ bdag chen rin po cher 'bul rgyu'i rta la chibs te ma bzhugs par byon pas gzhan rnams kyang phyi la yong dgos pa byung zhing / skabs 'gar gung gi dro 'phyis pas ma gsol ba sogs rab tu byung ba'i bla mar khas 'che ba 'ga' zhig las 'di nyid bslab pa la gus shing / gong dkar bas mi khal la gnod pa byas par ngos kyis byon te bablo ha bstan nas 6 nga'i 'go khag khyed rnams la yod do zhes sogs kyi na phra mo napa gsung sgam po byon pas 'jigs te gtong len dang bzod gsol byas/ gan pa phur lcang gong gi rgyal pos bar chad brtsam pa sgom bzlas mdzad pas ma tshugs/ de nas rim gyis sa skyar phebs te/ dpon chen 'od zer seng gis ban rtsa byas nas bdag chen rin po cher phag gru'i dpon po 'di slob gnyer byung na rab/ ma byung na bzhi thog pa'i drung 'khor las tshan zhig zhus 'dug pa ltar dam gnyer la bskos nas/ bdag chen pa thugs gtum bas gsol gzims dam gnyer sogs la bka' bkyon 'phral 'phral yong ba zhig 'dug pas/ dgongs pa zhus te rang bzhin las tshan med par bzhugs/ sbrul lo'i dpyid chos la chu mig tu phebs skabs zhabs phyir mtshan nyid kyi bla ma 'jam dpal dang / sngags kyi bla ma kun dbang sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rim pa dang / dpon chen dbang phyug dpal/ sang ye dpon po/ ba de lung pa'i dpon po/ stag lung dpon po rnams kyi sdebs khar/ si tu la 6 phag gru dpon por 'bod cing / dpon po rnams kyi nang nas mthong bzos che bar mdzad/ chag chag la khar/ bdag chen rin po che chibs bshol skabs si tu'i chibs 'dzin pa sngon la song nas med pas/ chibs 'brogs te rgyang ring por khyer bas/ rgyal tsha rin dbang gis rta nas babs te rogs byas 'dug pa yar klungs pa'i zhen yin 'dug cing / bka' chems su/ 6 nga rta

130thog nas ma lhungs pa kho'i drin yin gsung / sa skyar phebs skabs drung 'khor rnams chang gi dga' ston byed par/ brang khang shar na si tu bad yod par bdag chen pa'i sku gzhogs nas 'bod mkhan bstan mar gnang byung ba la byon pas/ gsol ras gser gyi theb rtse'i nang dugyu gnang ches med par phyag rjen pas bzung chog pa'i dgyes pa'i bka' stsal zhabs gom 'khyor ba tsam yod na'ang thugs rus mdzad de gsol/ bdag chen rin po che mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga' bas/ si tu la/ 6 khyed la khri dpon yong g.yul rgyal slobs gsungs pa sogs ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i gsung mang du mdzad/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bka' chems su/ lha bla ma bdag chen pa'i drung du thugs la dpe med btags pa de nga'i bsod nams chen po yod pa 'di mkhyen par 'dug bsam pa'i dag snang dang mos gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod migasung / ston chos thog bla ma mnyam med pa'i drung du brtag gnyis kyi gsan sbyong mdzad skabs/ slob dpon nam blo dang ma 'cham pa'i tshig rtsod kyi gtam bla mas gsan pas/ 66khyed tsho rlung gis bdas pa'i bye ri yin/ phag gru dpon po srid pas bskos pa'i gangs 3 yin gsungs skad/ de nas rta lo'i lo gsar la rin cen sgang du dpon chen rin cen seṅge'i rtsar byon pas 'brum pas bsnang de grag pa dang / 'jad du zla ba gsum bzhi skor bzhugs/ de nas dbusaca su 'byon khar bdag chen rin po che'i drung du phyag 'bul la byon pas/ bla ma mkhas btsun pa dang / si tu gnyis phyag sprel nas mkhas btsun pas si tu ba'i mgo gnyer dang / si tus mkhas btsun pa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byed dgos pa'i gsung nan che ba byon/ de nas dbus su byon te mi ring bar gong ma rgyal pos stag mgo nor bu gsum pa dang bcas khri dpon gyi las ka gnang /khyi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nang tshun du rgyal mtshan skyabs kyis khri dpon byas na'ang /

4lugs gnyis kyi byed pa mthu dman zhing khyad par khong rang gis las ka len par gong ma'i gser zhal lan gsum mthong ba'i rgyal dpal sgrol ma skyid 'phrog 'dod pa'i ched du bsad cing / si tu la tshig ngan bskur ba sogs kyis/ si tus bla chen kun blo gong ma'i gam nas sa skyar bsnyen rdzogs la byon pa'i sdebs gar si tu rin cen grags/ dpal ldan ju dben han dpon gyi dam kha khrims ra dang bcas 'byor 'dug pa'i dus su gtug gshedro byas/ rgyal mtshan skyabs las ka las phab/ khyi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes dgu'i nyin bka' shog bcwa ha rnams bsgrags/ bcu bzhi la sne'u gdong rtsis blangs/ gzhon nu 'od gnye( par bskos kyang phyi nang gi zhib tshags tshul dang mthun pa ma byung yang gnyer rtsis len pa las gzhan pa'i ca ra ma mdzad/ 'brug lo la a tu la yar klungs su byon/ yun ring bzhugs/ nyin gcig a tu las/ si tu rta rar khrid nas rta bres kyi kha shing gog la khad cig 'dug pa de bstan nas/ phakhri dpon blo zhib dgos pa yin/ 'di las phag gsum bzhag na 'grig pas/ rta la snad yar mi yong ba yin/ rta rab la dngul bre ri/ dngul bre do gser srang brgyad yin gsung ba sogs 'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bslab bya che phra du ma mdzad/ de nas sbrul lo si tu'i rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po tshul dar ba'i dpon po 'phyong rgyas pa hor gzhon nu bzang po gnyer du bskos/ de rjes gzhis ka rnams kyi gso phran dang / yul gru so sor skye shing 'dzugs pa/ gsham chu la zam mo che 'dzugs pa/ sne'u gdong rtse'i pho brang rgya bskyed de rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang sa la 'phos pa lta bu mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar g.ya' bzang pa dang kha mchu mang du byung zhing / g.ya' bzang pa 'di chos phyogs nas phagatagru'i slob brgyud dang / 'jig rten nas ha la har gtogs pa'i phag gru'i 'og tu yong dgos rgyu yin na'ang / 6 las skyo shugarā kyis bdas pa na/

132blo chen log pa'i lam la 'gro/ / mu stegs byed kyi ston pa mchog /dbang phyug spyon pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin mi zhes pa'i dpe ltar g.ya' bzang pas phag mo gru pa'i steng du dmag gis tshur 'gebs lan 'ga' byas shing / tshal pa rgyab phugs su yod pa dang / dpon chen rnams kyang yo bas kha mchu yang g.ya' bzang pa rgyal ba 'ga' re byung na'ang / kha mchu'i rtsa ba ma chod pas g.ya' phag bar thang du g.yul 'khrugs pas phag gru pham ste/ ston pa gzhon 'od kyis 'go byas mi gces bcu gsum tsam bsad/ si tu dang mnyam du gzhon nu bzang pos 'go byas mi bco lnga tsam ma gtogs phal cher bros/ de nas dpon chen dbang phyug dpal ba'i drung du g.ya' phag gtug gsher byas pas phag gru bden pa che ba tsam byung yang / dpon kun rdor gyis gyog byas par brten g.ya' bzang pa rgyal/ de nas mi ring bar dpon chen dbang brtson gyis dog lum par si tu ston mo la bos thog lab bslus kyi rnam par stag mgo gtong dgos pa'i tsha 'jam ci yang byas shing / zhag bcu dgu tsam gyi ring gung thang du btson la 'jug pa sogs byas kyang / 6 shes rab ldan pa mgo bskor yang / / bya ba'i cha la thongs mi 'gyur/ /srog chags grog ma mig med kyang / /mig ldan gzhan las lhag par mgyogs mi zhes pa ltar mkhyen rab dang snying stobs phul du byung bas/ dpon chen gyis glags ma rnyed par phyir phebs/ de nas si tu dar ma rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris phyin gyi 'jags byed pa dang / bod chol kha gsum gyi phye gsal byed par byon dus/ 'dam dang tshong 'dus 'gur mo gnyis su gtug gsher byed mi thub kyang / mnga' ris 'khor nas yar klungs su se chen rgyal po'i 'ja' pa li ji bcu ha sogs yig ris rnams bstan pas si tu dar rgyal ba ha las/ g.ya' theg gi kha mchu'i bcad mtshams legs pa byas na'ang / g.ya' bzang tshul 'bum 'od

133kyis/ e gnyal gyi dmag rnams bskul te rdog po rgyud du 'khrugs pas phag gru rgyal te/ ma dga' dgra dgas 'go byas mi nyi shu tsam bsad kyang / g.ya' bzang pas 'bras mo'i nang du gzhon nu bzang po dpon g.yog gi steng du bkab par/ si tu dpon g.yog gis 'go dmangs 'byor te/ g.ya' bzang pa'i dmag rnams phyir bros/ g.ya' bzang dgon pa dang gzhis ka rnams rtsis blangs/de nas sa skyar bla ma kun spangs pa dang / dpon chen rgyal bzang ba gnyis kyis si tu gsod/ sne'u gdong rtsis len pa'i gros ngan bshams pa rim gyis mched na'ang / sngar nas sa phag gnyis 'brel zab cing / khyad par si tu rang bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba'i drung 'khor yin pa'i stabs kyis/ dpon chen la dgra dpang mchongs byed pha'i rtsis yod skabs/ dpon chen rgyal bzang pa dbus phyogs su byon te rim gyis yar klungs su phebs/sang g.ya' phag gnyis gtug gsher byed rgyu'i nyin/ mi tu bas gzhon nu bzang pos 'gos byas blon po rnams la/ zu sang nged dang g.ya' bzang pa gnyis khri dpon gyi mdun du gtug gsher byed rgyu yin pas/ ma nges pa'i dpon chen gyis nged bzung ba bzhin byung na nged kyi spags pa dmar bshus byed kyin 'dug zer ba byung yang / sne'u gdong ma gtong sogs kyi bslab ston rnams mdzad/ sang dpon chen gyis si tu bzung kyang thel rtse me la bsregs pas yi ge len rgyu ma byung / de nas dpon chen gyis sne'u gdong du bskor g.yang byas par blon po rnams kyis zhal ngo las sde srid gal che zer nas ma gtad/ de nas dpon chen gyis si tu la ko sha brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga tsam brgyab/ zhwa rnga ma can gcig dbu la bskon pa sogs btson chag kyi rnam bas yar khrid skyi nag bar du tshal pa'i dmag gis bskyal bas kha ngan gtong ba dang

135bskor ba'i zol gyis rgyu bar byas so/ /sngar dpon chen rgyal bzang gis si tu bzung ba'i skabs pho brang chen por 'khru phur tshugs shing / nye lam dbang brtson gyis khri skor bcu gsum gyi dpung bshams pa btul ba sogs gzhan sde rnam par 'joms pa'i dgra thabs kyis sde srid phag mo gru pa'i bstan jus tshugs pa'i rtsa ba lta bu hor gzhon nu bzang po yin pas/ bka' chems su/ 8 sne'u gdong dgra lag tu ma shor ba byung bas nga'i srog thon/ de la brten nas sde 'di zug chags byung bas kho drin che ba yod pa'i don de yin zhing / da dung tshun bcad du nga la sngas gtod pa 'di yin pas shi gson gang byung yang nang nas bsdar dgos/ da lta'ang gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis 'go byas spun skya ser kun la sdu thub dang / nang mi 'chel ba'i don de yin gsungs la/ de nas si tu rang yang dpung thog tu phebs/gra phyi 'phyong rgyas sogs sto rgyud kyi sa cha rdzong gzhis phal cher blangs/ 'thab rtsod snga phyir byung yang gzhan dag rnams theg med par bcom/ de nas dpon chen dbang brtson gyis dmag bsags par bla ma dam pas bka' phebs dang /de rjes kha mchu bsdam mkhan mang du byung yang / dpon chen gzhan gyis bskyod stabs su song bas༄ ma 'grig pa'i zir bun gyi ngang la si tus gong dkar blangs/de la dpon chen gyi dpung bcug par bsad bzung tshul chubs pa sogs mang du byung nas si tu ba rgyal te/ kha rag phyin gtsang la yar gtogs lha 'brug rnams rta rmig 'og nas blangs/ dben pa dang mjal te gong ma'i drung du khyed rang 'gro'am mi gtong ba gang ris 'thad gsungs pa bzhin dbang phyug dang shes rab rdo rje gnyis btang ba nyes med du 'khor te khri bskor la dgos ba'i dngul gyi dam kha dang bcwa ha sogs 'grub/de nas 'bri dung sgom pa kun rdor gyis snga phyir byed spyod ma mkhas pa la

13 brten/ phag gru dang 'bri gung pa 'gal te sde 'khrug lan mang du byung zhing /khyad par 'bri gung pa/ nam grags pa/ g.ya' bzang pa gsum gyis gros bshams nas/ phag gru'i steng du bkab par gzhon nu bzang pos 'go byas yar stod kyi dmag rogs 'bras mo bsrung ba la bzhag si tu rang gis gtsos dpung chen byang khar bton nas 'bri gung par chus nyes btang bas/ g.ya' bzang pa yang phyir bros/ tshal pa dang / nam grags pa gnyis kyi khron pa ri dang g.yu rtse brag la rdzong rtsig pa sogs kyi byed par brten/ phag gru'i dmag rnams gsang mdar yongs thog g.ya' bzang pa 'bum phrag 'od kyis gnyal dmag rnams khrid nas lhun po rtser sleb pa'i 'phrod byung ba dang phyir log ste 'khrugs pas 'bum phrag 'od kyis 'go byas dgu brgya tsam lhun po rtse'i nang la bcur/ de rjes gnyal dmag yongs pa rnams kyang mang du bsad cing go mtshon rnams thob/ 'bum grags 'od dpon g.yog rnams kyis 'bab kha blangs/gnyal shel mkhar sogs gzhis ka rnams su rdzong dpon btang zhing zug pa btsugs/de nas skabs shig chos rje bla ma dam pas bar mdzad nas/ si tu dang dpon chen rgyal bzang pa gong dkar du mjal 'phrad mdzad/ dpon chen gyis si tu la bzod gsol byas te mthun skabs/ nam grags kyis shangs mthong smon la brgyab pas/ dpon chen gyi rogs su phag gru'i dmag rnams chen pos 'go byas phyin pa shab chu'i sto khar 'khrugs te/ nang pa'i dpung rnams bcom/ de nas phag gru'i dmag rnams sa skyar 'gro bar thag bcad kyang / dpon chen gzhan gyis mgo bskor gyi dbang du song ste dmag rnams phyir slog de nas dpon chen sa skyar byon pas bla ma ti ma'i sras po gnyis kyis btson du bcug pas/si tus dpung chen gtsang du btegs/ zhi drag gi thabs du ma'i sgo nas dpon

137chen btson nas bton/ gtsang gi sa cha phal cher chab 'og tu bcug ste/ phyir 'byon pa'i lam thor du gzhis ka rin spungs rtsig pa'i zhal bkod mdzad/de yang dus skabs 'di dag tu sa skya pa zhal ngo mang bas bla brang go bzhir gyes nas nang mi mthun pa sogs kyis bstan jus mtha' dag phag gru pa'i 'og tu shor ba ni/ 6 sa nang grums nas phag gis sa rlog 'jig /yar klungs nang nas phyag rdor sprul pa 'byung zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi don dang mthun par/gong ma ta'i si tu 'di nyid ni gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bka'i bsda ba po rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum gyi rmad du byung ba'i zlos gadro las/ chos kyi rgyal po mes dpon gsum gyi mdzad pa'i snang brnyan dri mas cung zad sbags pa bsal ba'i slad du dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams la stobs kyis mnga' sgyur bar gnam gyi lung gis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gor ma chag de nas gong ma rgyal pos/ da ra kha che sogs gser yig pa mngags te ta'i si tu'i ming dang dam kha gnang /de nas 'bri gung pas phag gru'i steng du dmag tshan cher bsags par brten/ si tus gong dkar gyi dmag rnams btang ste brag dkar phab/ de skabs sa skyar bla ma kun spangs pa bkrongs pa sogs nang 'khrug byung bas/kha mchu lab bar si tu gtsang du byon/ dpon chen rgyal bzang 'bod par gtang ba khong lha rtser bka' gros la byon thog dpon chen dbang brtson dang mkhan po nam mkha' ye shes kyis dug btang yang zer/ a rag mang bas lan kyang zer/ gang ltar dpon chen grongs/ de nas si tus ga skyas gtsos pa'i che gnyan rnams kyi bcwa tshe blangs mjug bsdoms su sa skyar byon/ ban tshe'i nang dang 'gal ba byang na rtsa ra gtong ba'i khrims bsgrags/ lha khang chen mor rin cen 'od kyis zlogo byas brgya skor zhig zug par bzhag sa skya'i lo rgyus na 'di

138skabs rdzong chung pa gzungs kyi dpal bas si tu la mngon spyod kyi las mdzad pas mtshan ma khyad par can byung skad/ de nas si tu dbus su byon rjes lha rtse pa dang byang pa 'khrugs/ de la bcu tshe dang mthun pa'i rtsa ra gtong bar chen pos gtsos pa'i dmag brdzangs pa snyi tshar sleb dus lha rtse nas dpon chen dbang brtson gyi dpung gis sa skya lha khang chen mor bskor ba thos pas dpung rnams snyi tshar nas sa skyar phyin te 'khrugs pas mang du bsad/ dpon chen bzung / bzhi brgya skor la khrims lugs byas/ de nas ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams blo gros/ g.ya' bzang khri dpon/ tshal pa khri dpon sogs kyis gong sar/ si tus sa skya dmag gis bcom/ khri dpon gzhan rnams la mthar 'ded byas sogs kyi zhu log rim par phul bar brten/gong ma thugs tshom pa sel ba'i ched du/ drung chen shes rab bkra shis kyis seng ge dkar mo'i pags pa sder bzhi ma nyams pas gtsos pa'i 'bul ba dang bcas gong ma'i sku gzhogs su btang bas/ gdung rabs nas gdung rabs su phan pa'i 'ja' sa dang lung bzang po 'grub/ de ltar 'bri tshal g.ya' bzang sa skya'i dpon chen sogs stobs sbyor dregs pas myos pa'i rgol ba'i klan ka can rnams la/ ce spyang dus min du nga ro'i skad 'byin par/ gdong lnga'i dbang po dgra zlar mi sems pa'i ngang tshul bzhin mdzad kyang / tshur 'a bas kyi byed pa dug sbrul sgong 'khyer gyi snang tshul la brten nas gzhan sde'i mnga' thang thams cad dpung shed kyis bcad nas nub phyogs chu lha'i mthar thug gi bar du bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya btsan pos gser gyi gnya' shing lta bur lci ba'i rgyal khrims kyi 'og tu bcug ste/ nyi 'og gi rgyal phran mtha' dag gis yul srol dang mthun pa'i nor gyi dpya 'bul ba sogs mdor na bsil ldan gangs kyi ri ba dar dkar gyi yol bas bres pa'i khongs su 'khod pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag mi

bde ba'i rtsa rkyen gyi byed po gan nga rgyal ba'i gdongapadamadanasagating/sdud gtsang bar tshar bcad/ go/ dkar/ brag dkar/ sne'u/ 'ol kha stag rtse/bsam 'grub rtse/ lhan grub rtse/ rin spungs sogs dbus gtsang 'dzin ma'i lte ba'i sa mdud rnazlos la rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs/ pho brang chen po sne gdong rtser rgyal sgo phyi nang gsum du byas pa'i nang ma la nag chang gi khrims bsdams shing / si tu nyid chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas sbong ba sogs rab byang gi tshul la gnas pas lha sde dang mi sde kun gyi spyi bo'i cod pan da nor bu darāng gi rgyal po ltar bstan/ zhu gde yang sngar dpal ldan sa skya pas bod tsam du ma zad bod chen po'i rgyal khams la mnga' sgyur na'ang / gdung brgyud zhal ngo rnams thugs 'dod kyi 'then phyogs so sor song zhing / dpon chen rnams kyang tig mi chags par spro len mang ba gong ma'i khrims kyang hor gyi shan shor ba'i hang zom sogs la brten/ thang lhod dang mtho dma' ci rigs dang / khyad par hor khrims la mi bsad na srog tshab tu srog gtong bas mtshon pa'i khrims rnams sdig pa'i las shas che bar brten/ bod chos rgyal gong ma'i lugs srol bzang po dge ba bcus gzhi bzung ba 'di nyid/ ta'i si tus gtso bor mdzad par bzhed de/tshul de nyid sgrub par byed pa la khas zhan rnams yal bar dor zhing / dregs po rengs su bcug pa ma yin pa'i bden rdzun thang mar brdal nas/ dkar nag shan phyed pa'i khrims kyis rgyal khams rgan mo gser khur lta bur bde ba'i ched du/ dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce/ sdar ma wa'i zhal lce/ sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/ zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi zhal lce/ bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce/ nag can khrug bcor gyi zhal lce/ dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce/ hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/ bsad pa stong gi zhal sne/ mas pa khrug gi zhal sne/

140smyon nyam mna' dag gi zhal lce/ bkas pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/ nye 'brel 'bral bzlums kyi zhal lce/ byi byas byi ༄rin gyi zhal lce/ nam bar tshur gyi zhal lce ste bco lnga'i sgo nas gtan la phab/ de yang mi bsrun log par 'khu ba'i dgra sde tshar bcad nas/ jus don bzhed thog tu 'khyol ba'i thabs su drag po dpung gi sbyor ba bshams tshul/ tshur 'gebs la btsan po'i rdzong la 'khru 'phur byed tshul/ sne mor mngags sleb rnams kyis rnam dkar gyi las la spyod cing nye 'gyang spangs pa'i gzhung don gtso bor byed tshul/ mi bsad la lan 'jal gyi gnyis phung sdig las byed du mi 'jug par stong sprod len sogs phra zhib mdzangs pa'i blos khrims kyi 'jam dar yug gcig tu brkyangs pa'i 'dzum gyis rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron ring nas 'gugs par mdzad do//smras pa/'jigs bral za brtan g.yul ngor dpa' ba'i ru mtshon rtse la dgra sde'i srog dbugs blangs pa na//gser ldan rus dkar khyab pa'i mdangs kyis zla gzhon skrag ste byang gling ngos kyi mkha' la bros//khrug gi rba rlabs 'phyur ba'i 'od da /ra gzi yis rgod ma kha de rgya mtsho'i 'gram du yibs//rnam par rgyal ba'i rdza rnga sdir bas sum rtsen bdag po 'dud par gros pa'i ca co gleng //ma ma rtsod pa'i dus 'dir su wa ṇi'i//'khor lo nam mkhar 'phags pa'i rgyal thabs kyis//grags snyan du klu la yi ba dan dkar//srid pa'i rtse mor khyab ces lha rnams sgrog/

141gong ma'i lung gis gtsug na zla ba'i mchog/thob pas stobs ldan 'gro skyabs gser can 'ga'//dpa' mdzangs seng ge'i sder mos bsad pa na//pad dkar mig cig gnyis pa sa 'dir snang //zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //de nas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi phyogs su mdo phyogs kyi bshad gra'i srol med pa gsar du btod pa'i ched du chos grwa chen po rtses thang btab/phar tshad sogs bka' po ti du ma la rig lam nas drangs pa'i bshad nyan btsugs/ de dang thel gyi sgom grwa gnyis ka la phun sum tshogs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku brnyan du ma dang / gser gyi bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa/ ra sa 'phrul snang dang bsam yas kyis mtshon pa'i gnas chen khyad 'phags rnams la mchod 'bul sogs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bla na med pa bsgrubs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi chu gter chen po dbyar mtsho ltar gyur pa'i mthus dkar nag gi las kyi 'bras bu chos thams cad rjen par 'char ba'i tshad ma'i srang la gzhal bas/ nag po'i 'bras bus cha tsam du yang ma gyur pas/ dge legs chu zla'i 'od dkar grangs med pa spros pas mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i gang bu yongs su smin pas nor 'dzin gyi bu mo mngal khur gyis snyi bar 'dzad/'di nyid gshegs rjes 'jam dbyangs gu sri chen po ni dpon bsod nams bzang po'i jo mo nyi ru ma dang mang nyam gnyis las snga ma la nyid dang bdag po shāka rin pa gnyis/ gyi ma la dpon rin dor 'khrungs pa las/'jam dbyangs pa bla ma klu lung grags pa la klog yig bslabs/ chos bzhi grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos/ slob dpon

142gzhon brtson la rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shākya rgyal mtshan du gsol/ gdan sar brtag gnyis dang / rtses thang du bka' po ti bzhi la bshad pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ bu ston rin po che'i drung du rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud bshad dbang lung mang du gsan pas/ mgon po gdong gi ri man gyi yar klungs kyi zhing re'i khar dkyil 'khor rigs mi 'dra ba re bzhengs kyang kheb par yod ces bu ston chos rjes zhal pho gsungs/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs te lha sar chos 'khor dang / rtses thang gi tshogs pa lo bcu gsum gyi bar du skyong bar mdzad/ mi ring bar pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i khri thog tu phebs te hor gong ma rgyal pos/ ta'i si tu dang chang gu'i lung /kwa din gu sri las ka dang dam kha gnang / bod chol kha gsum brgyud pa dang bcas pa shes su 'jug pa'i 'ja' gas spur rgyal bod gyi rgyal khams na mngon par mtho/ gtsang phyogs su log par 'khu ba'i kun dkris kyis brnag pa'i sems ldan 'ga' zhig gi steng du dpung gi sbyor ba bshams dus/ chos skyong bya rog gdong can gyi nus pas dmag rnams gtsang po la thogs med du phyin/phyir phebs nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag mang po la zhag bcu sbrel du gya nom pa'i bkur sti mdzad nas chos 'khor btsugs/ mnga' 'bangs thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la 'khod par mdzad/dpon rin cen rdo rjes zin bkra shis skyid dang / do brag ma rin cen 'tsho gnyis khab tu bzhes pa'i snga ma la rgyal sras grags pa rin cen dang /chos rje chos bzhi pa gnyis las/ chos bzhi pa chung ngu'i dus su mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan gdan drangs pas/ sman bla'i pho brang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa sku lus la thim pa gzigs pa'i lung bstan mdzad/ rgyal sras grags rin pa la brtag gnyis kyi lung zhus te thugs sbyong dang / spyan snga grags

144rnam par sprul pa de nyid khab tu bzhes pa'i sras mi'i dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ drung byang chub rdo rje/ spyan snga bsod nams bzang po/ spyan snga dpal ldan bzang po/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ drung sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams sku bltams pa las/mi'i dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ 'jam dbyangs chen po'i sku'i skye ba gsal bar dran zhing / mkhyen rab mchog tu yangs pas klog yig sogs ched gnyer du bslab sbyangs ma dgos par 'bad med du mkhyen/ mkhan po gzhon dbang ba'i drung du rab tu byung / spyan snga grags pa byang chub la chos khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan/ mtshan grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ chos grwa chen po rtses thang gi gdan sar phebs nas rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gsungs pas shin tu phra ba rtog ge'i rig pa la mngon par nga rgyal ba'i mkhas rlom sa srung rnams kyi spobs pa phrogs/ de nas pho brang chen po'i seṅge'i khri'i dga' tshal du zhabs zung tsā la chen po'i ljon pa rnam par bkod pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dri bsung ma la ya'i rlung bzhon gyis bod chen por 'khod pa'i skye rga kun gyi du ༷ kha'i tsha ga dung gi 'jigs pa ming gi lhag mar mdzad nas/ jon pa dang bde ba'i char chen po tha gru kun tu phab/ bkra shis sgo mang gsum gyis thog drangs pa'i thugs dang sku'i rten/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa bod du 'gyur ba'i glegs bam mtha' dag sa le sbram gyi snying po las grub pa tshar gnyis/ gser dngul 'dres ma gcig ba shog dkar po la bris pa tshar gsum gyis thog drangs gsung rten mtha' yas shing / de dag kyang rgyal mkhar rtse'i sde dgon du bka' 'gyur shin tu mang ba char rtsis nas bris pa snang ba lta bu ma yin par rgyu phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du/ bod kyi yi ge mtha' dag

145 gangs khrod pa rnams la bka' drin 'gran zla ma mchis pa thon mi sa ṭas mdzad pa'i sum rtags dang / de dag la brten nas bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi yi ge'i bde dag gi bstan bcos mang du snang ba rnams la brten nas sdeb kyi sbyor lugs mtha' dag la zhib mor dpyad/ rgyud 'bum sogs su legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad kyi sngags mtha' dag byā ka ra ṇa'i don khong du chud pa'i skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis rang bzhin/ rkyen/ rnam 'gyur gsum la brten nas gtan la phabs pas/ bka' 'gyur de rnams gcig tu bstan pa'i rtsa lag lta bur gyur/ gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs gser gyis bzhengs pa'i snying po can gyi rten 'bum ther grangs mang ba dang / 'bum ther dgung lo'i grangs lo re bzhin bzhengs pa/ spyan snga rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis chos 'byung mig 'byed 'od stong mdzad pa'i lo sa khyi yan la lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis star chags su byung bar gsungs 'dug pas de nas kyang sa phag nas lcags phag gi bar lo bcu gsum gyi ring rgyun mi chad par mngon/ gzhan yang ris su ma chad pa'i grub pa'i mtha' mtha' dag la bsnyen bkur dang /yongs 'dzin rnams la chos kyi gsan pa mdzad pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rgyun 'dzin tshogs sde 'ga' zhig la bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i thugs dam bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam 'bum phrag mang du bskul ba/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos srid 'di'i legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i nam mkha'i glang po yongs su 'khrigs pa las byung ba'i 'phral yun kun tu dge legs kyi 'jug pa rgyun mi chad pa'i gru char gyis/ ye shes mchog gi myu gu zad mi shes pa'i zong du bskrun pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba'i kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras pos cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus khyad par can chu shel dbang po rta chen dga' ma'i khyim du rtse

146dgar spyod pa'i zla bar/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du smon lam gyi dus ston khyad par can 'dzugs pa mdzad pa'i mthun rkyen yang dag par bsgrubs/ ring mo nyid nas bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che bsags pa'i rten 'brel gyis khri thog tu phebs pa nas bzung ste/ 'jig rten kun tu mu gi dang yams nad sogs med cing mkho dgu'i yo byad la longs spyod pa'i 'dod rga rmugs 'dzin gyi bang mdzod la rang dbang du spyod pa lta bur gyur/ de yang zlodi'i yab sa skyong chen po shākya rin cen la tho gan thi mur gyis lung gnang nas pho brang chen por khri dpon du phebs shing / tho gan thi mur gyi dus gru tha la gru rgya nag gi yul gru chen po 'ga' zhig tu khrul len par btang bas/ de dang rgya'i mi dpon 'ga' zhig gros mthun te shing rta 'khor lo mang du byas pa'i 'og tu dmag dang / steng du rin po che dang gos dar gyi tshogs bzhag ste khrul skyel ba ltar byas nas pho brang gi nye logs su 'ongs te dmag gis bskor bas/ rgyal po gsang sgo zhig la bros/ gru tha la rgyas mnga' 'bangs thams cad chab 'og tu bcug pa'i sras kyen 'un/ de'i sras yung lo ta ming rgyal po'i dus gser gyi dam kha dang / slar yang shel gyi dam kha/dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang bas mtshan dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes snyan pa'i rdza rnga skabs gsum pa'i lam du brdungs pas 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pas gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi mthongs nas rin po che'i bum pa dri bzang gi chus gang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rdzong chen rnams kyi rdzong sdod so so la mi brgyud dang bcas par 'ja' sa'i shel dam gnang / mchog dman gyi skye rgu mtha' dag gong ma chos rgyal chen po zhes gleng ngo/ /nyang stod shar kha ba rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pas gong ma 'di gnyis kyi gzims dpon gyi las ka bzung zhing / sde srid 'di nyid kyi

147bka' drin las mnga' thang che bar yod kyang / cung zad byed ma mkhas pas gong ma'i thugs la phog ste/ nyang stod du dpung gi 'jug sgo lan gnyis tsam mdzad pas/ yar klungs pa rnams dgra nyang stod shar kha ba zer ba'i skabs byung zhing / 'on kyang dran 'dzin tsam las rgyal mkhar rtse rtsis len pa sogs ma mdzad/ de tsam ma gtogs dbus gtsang mtha' dag bde 'jags las/dpung gi 'jug sgo sogs sdig pa'i las kyi sbyor ba la mi re bar chos ldan rgyal po'i khrims nyin byed dbang po shar ba na/ mi bsrun pa'i skye bo zhe sdang gi 'dab ma rnam par rgyas pa'i ka mu ta'i tshal mtha' dag rang shags kyis zum par gyur to/ / ༄ ༄gong ma 'di'i dus dpa' 'dzangs rtal phod pa'i rgyal po'i bya ba la mkhas pa'i blon po rin spungs nam mkha' rshal mtshan rin spungs kyi rdzong dpon dang / sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i dpon chen gyi khrir bskos/ 'phyong rgyas pa hor dpal 'byor bzang por bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon dang dmag dpon gyi las ka gnang / gzhan yang sne'u pa nam mkha' bzang po/ brag dkar ba rin cen dpal rnams grags che/ rigs rus yon tan mnga' thang sogs lugs gnyis kyi go rim dang mthun pa'i drung 'khor shin tu mang zhing / de dag kyang chen po'i las tshan gyi sgo dang bstan pa'i rgyan gos kyi rim pa dang / khyad par gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i da 'a ston dus rin cen rgyan char grags pa'i bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyan sprod dang / rgyan mar yang rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis rnam par mdzes pa'i kārnyi ka rna ba'i rgya du spud pa sogs mdzad la/ mdor na lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa bzang po gzhan dag lta ci smos/gnas skabs kyi spyod lam yang ya rabs bzang po che btsun gyi ngang tshul las/lung ma bstan gyi zhwa gos gyon pa/ sgrigs kun spyod kyi srang la bcur ba med

148pa'i yid la shar tshad lag tu mi len pa'i mig stos mchog tu bzang / chos rje bsod grags pas/ chos rgyal chen po 'di nyid kyi blon po'i khrod du brag dkar ba shes rab bkra shis 'dren pa ni/ sher bkras pas gong ma ta'i si tu'i skabs hor rgyal po'i drung du 'ja' sa zhu bar byon pa'i dus dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bdun gyi khar sleb cing / si tu rin po che nas gong ma 'di'i ring la gdan rabs kyang 'ga' zhig song bas/ drung chen sher bkras pa 'ong ba'i don med cing / rin spungs nam mkha' rgyal po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sras yin kyang / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sngon la 'dren pa sogs dmus long gcig pur rgyu ba lta bur kun dang mi mthun pa'i gtam mang ngo /smras pa/ phul byung bsod nams shing rtas legs drangs pas//dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan 'bar ba'i gzis//sde gsum cig car gsal ba'i grags pa'i gzugs//rlung gi rgyal mtshan lta bur tshar du dngar//tha gu'i sto can 'jug pa bcu pa'i sgyus//kun las rnam par rgyal la mtshar du ci//g.yo med drang po'i tshul gyis ltar bcas 'gro'i//gtsug na zhabs sen u dum lha ra 'dzum//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / //gcung sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis rin spungs nas bdag mo zhig khab tu bzhes par grags pa 'byung gnas dang / kun dga' legs gnyis 'khyungs/

— 149grags pa 'byung gnas sku na phra mo nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas la mkhas par sbyangs/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa la thugs rab kyi rtsal shin tu che bas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po 'gos lo ye bzang rtse ba'i zhal nas/ 6 de rjes mi'i dbang po grags pa 'byung gnas pa thugs rab shin tu che zhing gsang sngags kyi mkhyen pa shin tu rgyas par gyur kyang / gdan sa'i bzhuṭa khri rin po che shin tu gnyan par dgongs nas gdan sar ma bzhugs kyang /gnas chen du 'gro ba'i ri pa rnams la mgyogs khrid gsungs zhes deb sngon du gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang chos rgyal chen po gshegs rjes/ 'di nyid sku na phra bas pho brang chen po'i khrir yab sras gnyis su bsko la bka' blon rnams gros ma mthun par spyan snga rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan la zhus pas/ sras bsko bar bka' gnang ba bzhin mdzad kyang spyan snga gshegs rjes/yab kyis khri thog yong ba'i ched du gnang sgo ma legs par brten/ yar klungs su sde gzar langs te yab che sa dpon blon yar rgyab tu 'byon dgos byung /de nas gong ma dbus kyi gzhis bskor la phebs skabs sne'u rdzong du mkhas grub chos rje dge legs dpal bzang dang / gsang ni'u thog gi chos rje rnam gnyis/drung chen slob dpon sogs mjal bar phebs/ gong ma'i sku gzhogs su bzhugs gral gyi thog gsung rab kyi 'bel gtam mdzad khar/ mkhas grub chos rje dang gsang phu'i chen po rnams so so nas bshad pa mdzad rgyu 'ong du re yang / gong ma'i zhabs phyir 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal ba yod pas khong gis rtses thang pa'i brtul zhugs kyi thog mar gzhung len pa mdzad skad/ de nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po kyen tha'i yis dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang ba nas bzung / dbang grags pa 'byung gnas su grags/ thel dang rtses thang gnyis su gdan sa zur du med na'ang / gsung chos 'gangs che ba rnams rtse

150 6nas gnang zhing / zur 'chad slob dpon rnams la bka'i 'khor los khyab pa dang / gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzheng ba sogs lugs zung gi mdzad pa mtha' dag gong ma na rim gyi srol bzang po ma nyams par bzung / yar rgyab nas che sa rtses thang du gdan drangs/ zhal ngo nang mtshams kyi 'khon zhi nas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ byang phyogs kyi bso kha bsrung bar 'u yug gling dkar gyi rdzong brtsigs/ rin spungs nor bu bzang po/ 'phyong rgyas pa hor dkon cog rin cen ni chos rgyal chen po'i zhabs la gtugs kyang gong ma 'di'i dus su khrims kyi kha lo sgyur ba'i blon po mdzad/gcung kun dga' legs pas gsung rab la sbyangs pa ma smad pa mdzad de rtses thang gi gdan sar phebs/ rin spungs nas bdag mo khab tu bzhes par sras rin cen rdo rje dbang gi rgyal po 'khrungs/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen hang rgyal pos dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang / 'di nyid rtogs pa'i yon tan phul du byung ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhig yin par 'dug na'ang gnas skabs su skye bo rnams kyi snang ngor mdzad sgo legs rgyu med tsam yod 'dug par dpags/ gtsang gi gzhis bskor la phebs dus rin spungs nor bzang pas gus 'dud bla na med pa mdzad kyang gnang sgo'i khog la ma mgu skad/ de nas gong ma ka bzhi pa sku mched kyis gang zhus la gsan pas/ yab yum nang mtshams su sel chen po zhugs te/ yar gong bya ba bsam sde ba sogs bdag mo phyogs dang / sne'u rgol dga' rnams gong ma'i phyogs su chad nas dus mi bde ba mang du byung / thon kyang 'phyong rgyas pa rdo rje tshe brtan phan tshun gnyis rka'i phyogs su ma lhangs pas sde gzar bzlums shing / zhal ngo nang mtshams kyi legs spel mdzad rngus sde srid kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byung / de nas yum gshegs rjes rin spungs pa mtsho skyes rdo rjes mkhar thog bzung / de yang deb

161ther sngon po las/ de rjes bdag po kun dga' legs pa dang / che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan bka' bgros mdzad de༄/ shing pho khyi'i lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la chos kyi rje rin po che dpal ngag gi dbang po dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa zhig rin po che'i gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs su gsol zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bar skabs su thel gyi gdan sa stongs na'ang / slar spyan snga ngag gi dbang po 'di nyid bzhugs pa yin la/'di'i yab/ la la dag tshes lnga rin po che grags pa 'byang gnas yin par 'chad/ 'ga' zhig tshes lnga rin po che sku tshe'i stod smang mtha' dag tu rab tu byung ba yin pas/ ma yin par smra ba yang yod la/ 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phur pa'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mdzad byang du/ jo sras kun bzang rol pa'i rdo rje zhes gsungs pa la dpags na yab yin nam snyam/ gang ltar 4 shes ldan rnams kyis dpyad par bya'o/ / de yang spyan snga ngag gi dbang po gzhon nu nas dpal ye bzang rtse ba sogs yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas gsung rab la thos bsam bsgom pa mang du mdzad/ bstan pa la zhugs te yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa mdos te gdan sa chen po'i spyan sngar phebs/bar skabs su gong ma'i gnang bkod la brten nang mtshams su mi mthun pa byung yang / slar rim pas 'jags skabs/ rin spungs don yod rdo rjes gtsang dpung rnams dbus su bcug ste gzhis ka sne'u pa'i lag nas rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig blangs/ de nas spyan snga rin po che/ rin spungs mtsho skyes pa dang don yod rdo rje gnyis/ 'phyong rgyas pa hor tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang / hor rin cen rgyal mchog sku mched kyis gtsos pa'i sne'u pa dpal 'byor rgyal po/ yar rgyab pa rin cen rgyal po/ byar pa bkra shis dar rgyas sogs blon po rnams kyis gros thog nas pho brang chen por spyir spyan drangs/ mi ring bar zhal ngo gong ma

162rnams gshegs pas lha rigs rlangs kyi gdung 'dzin pa spyan snga nyid ma gtogs med par brten/ 6 ji ltar grong khyer ser skya'i mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud//de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams bskyed la phan zhes pa'i don ltar/ bod kha ba can 'dir kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che dang / skye rga rnams kyi phan bde ni gnam bskos kyi rgyal po phag mo gru pa'i sde srid la rag cu lus pas/ gong du smos pa'i blon po rnams kyis gong ma spyan snga rin po cher nan gyis zhus te/ rdzong kha pa'i sras mo zhig bdag mor phul/ yab mes kyi lugs srol bzang po rnams dkar phyogs kyi zla tshes lta bur ches cher gsal bar mdzad/ sras ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa sku bltams nas ring por ma lon par spyan snga zhi bar gshegs khar sras sku ha cang phra bas de la thugs chags pa'i tshul gyis sku ngal ba chen por gyur skabs/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pas gdung brgyud rin po che nar ma son pa'i ring khong rang gis thel gyi spyan snga'i khur bzhes dang / thel rtses thang gi chen po gros dbang pa blon po rnams dang bcas par gnang bkod bka' nan sogs kyis khyab pa'i sde srid kyi lar rgya mi 'phyug pa'i zhal len mdzad/ de yang dpon tshab thel gtong byed par rin spungs mtsho skyes rdo rjes/ blon po gzhan rnams la gros med par 'ga' zhig gi 'dod pa ltar mdzad pas/ sde dpon gzhan rnams ma 'dod pa'i dbang gis sdo gzar langs/ 'on kyang 'phyong rgyas nas sde srid kyi lar rgya la dgongs te thugs khog che bar mdzad pas yo 'khyoms cher ma byang / de nas 'jam dbyangs gong mas spyan snga rin po cher dbang gi 'dro' sa gnang yang spyan snga /rsha brjes pas gnang sbyin rnams phyag mdzod du bzhag nas gser yig pa phyir

153de rjes rin spungs pa dang 'phyong rgyas pa gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i blon po rnams bka' bgros thog nas gdung brgyud rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa pho brang chen po'i khri thog tu spyan drangs/ gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas rol rtsed sogs skye bo phal pa dag gi spyod yul las rnam par 'das pas 'jig rten gyi mes po rnams kyis kyang blos 'khyud par dka' zhing / chos dang srid kyi yon tan ma lus cig car du shong ba'i za ma tog sto ba rab tu yangs pha/ chen po'i rnam par thar pa'i kha rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i gzi brjod kyi rgyal po nyin mor byed pa la skyengs pa ster bas rigs stobs su ma zad/ blo stobs kyis kyang bod chen po'i rgyal khams su 'khod pa'i gong/ma'i mdun na 'don blo can shel gyi me long lta bu rnams kyang zil gyis gnon pa'i bka' khrims bzang pos bod 'bangs thams cad bde ba nas bde bar spyod pa'i bde skyed kyi glu dbyangs snyan pos dri za'i rgyal po gan bsnye kha ba rir gnas sam snyam du skabs gsum pa rnams la 'phyang mo ster bar byed do/ /'on kyang 'di nyid kyi dus/ smyo grags 'byung ming can sne yi gdong po 'dzin/ bdud sprul mi dgus phag tshang yos ltar rngod/ ces pa'i lung bstan ltar/ rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis e gnyal gyi phyogs su dmag gi dpung khyer byad pa sogs gong ma'i dgongs par phog pa mdzad par brten/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pas/ 6 phag mo gru pa'i sde srid 'di/ spyir rgyal khams yongs/sgos sde dpon rnams/ yang sgos khyed rin spungs pa la gces pas dgongs bsams mdzad dgos tshul gsungs kyang bzhed pa zhig ma byung / de yang lung bstan du grags 'byung zhes pa ni gong ma grags 'byung ba'i skabs dus mi bde ba 'ga' zhig byung bas 'go zin pa la dgongs kyi/ / dngos gzhi gong ma 'di'i dus so/ /de skabs 'jam dbyangs gong mas dbang gi mtshan dang 'ja'

164sa gnang / zhabs drung gong ma chen po dpal ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba kwa den gu sri ho wang gi mtshan gyi zlos gar srid pa gsum gyi me long gi ngos su gsal bar shar ro/ /mi ring bar rin spungs pas me tog mda' can gyi las dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i sdig sems kyis sde gzar bslangs pas/ lha ma yin lha'i mnga' thang la phrag dog gi bsam pas g.yul bkye ba na legs bris pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthus lha min mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar 'gyur ba de bzhin du sde srid mtshan jus rgyal/ 'on kyang zhwa dmar chos grags pas bar mdzad nas lo gsum gyi chings bsdams na'ang / rin spungs pas slar sde gzar bslangs te rgyal mkhar rtser bteg skabs/ 'phyong rgyas pa rin cen rgyal mchog gis gtsos gong ma'i dpung chen rnams nyang stod bar du byon/ dga' ldan pa dmag dpon bsod nams rgyal pos skyid 'phan gyi dpung rnams khrid de shangs kyi bar du bteg pas ri la spyi bos bsrung ba'i rnam thar 'dzin pa cher rlom gyi dregs ldan gzhis ka rin spungs pa 'drongs gyen log gi rgya mi zad pa bsags pa'i 'bras bu dus gcig tu smin pas ci bya gtol med bye gyur na'ang /rgyal rtse dang pa snams pa'i sa cha bshor ba rnams phyir sprod pa dang / gong sar dgongs bsangs/ rdzong dpon gyi las ka zhu ba/ phyin chad ma rungs pa'i sems 'dor ba sogs kyi dan kha las mtha' med du gtong ba ma mdzad/ de lta na'ang dus kyi bskal pas 'gro ba'i bsod nams mthu dman zhing / nag po'i phyogs kyis yid bsgyur bas bdud kyi las 'grub pa'i 'a bras bu'i shugs gang gis kyang dgag dka' bar brten/ rin spungs pa dpon blon gyis sde gzar tshan che bar bslangs kyang / sde srid kyi mtshan jus la skyon ma byung /gong ma 'di nyid kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying po gser zhun ma'i

168smras pa/rmad byung rlangs kyi gser skyogs kyis bcus lha rigs bdud rtsi'i zil dngar can//mtho ris yon tan bdun gyi mnga' 'byor yul dbus sman ljongs yol go'i nang //'phyur bur gtam pa'i rin cen gdung brgyud chos srid bla na dngar ba'i ro//gangs can ljongs 'di'i skye rga me zhal yongs kyi dga' ston e ma mtshar ༄skye bas thob pa'i rigs gzugs chu dang zla'i//sde gsum gcig tu dkar ba'i bsil zes gyis//nam mkha'i ri bong can de pham mo zhes// chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs pas sgrib snyam byed// gnam bskos rgyal srid sā la'i sdong po la//las gas mngon mtho'i stobs ldan yal ga'i tshogs//srid 'byor lo ma'i phang phung g.yo bzhin du//legs byas 'bras bu'i 'dod 'jo dpyid du dar//zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //de ltar gong ma sde srid kyi bka' khrims kyi shing rta chen po'i kha lo pa rnams las/: rin spungs ni/ sngon bod rje sha khri btsan po'i dus ma sangs la

159khar khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung bar sger dpal legs 'od nas bzung /phyi sger/ nang sger/ grub thob kyi sger dang gsum las/ rim bzhin mi rabs nyer lnga pa na nang sger ral pa 'dzin gyis gru gu'i yul nas gzings bdun gyis rin po che g.yu'i zong drangs/ khrug gi lus la mgo lnga pa 'brug gi skad 'byin pa zhig rig sngags kyis btul bas nus mthu che bar grags shing / phyag na padma mi rje'i tshul bzung ba srong btsan sgam po'i nang blon mdzad/de nyid kyi brgyad las blo gros kyi rtsal ldan zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u drotsan gyi chos blon du gyur pa nas bzung mi rabs nyi shu'i mthar/ sger shākya 'bum gyi sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis gong ma sde srid dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la gtugs/ gzhis ka rin spungs kyi rdzong dpon/ chu mig gi khri dpon/ dpal ldan sa skya'i lha khang che mo'i dpon chen du bskos/ de'i sras nam mkha' rgyal po na tshod phra mo nas lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa'i spyan mchog tu yangs/ de'i sras nor bu bzang pos gong ma'i zhabs la gtugs shing / yab mes dus kyi rdzong sdod khri dpon rnams kyi 'ja' sa gnang / dpung gi sbyor bas rta g.yag gi rdzong dang / lcags thag mgo sbrel du grags pa'i rgyal phran mang po'i mnga' 'bangs rnams blangs/ nyang smad bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon mdzad/ gter ston kun skyong gling pas/ 6 bstan ma gsol zhing rje yi mgur lha mchod/ mi rabs bcu gsum bar du mi rabs brtan/ mizhes pa'i lung bstan bzang po mdzad/ de nas rong byams chen gyi chos sde btab/ dge 'dun rnams la dbyar dgun dbyid chos kyi phogs sogs mthun rkyen gya nom pa sbyar/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang du bzhengs par pa'o chen nags kyi rin cen gyis me tog gcor brag dmar chos sde rnying pa'i 'dabs su spyil po brgya lhag tsam brtsigs te thos bsam sgom pa tshul bzhin du

160byed pa'i 'dus grwa btsugs/ mdor na ris med pa'i grub pa'i mtha' thams cad la bsnyen bkur bla na med pa mdzad pas mngon par mtho/ chos rje bsod grags pas/ chos rje ngor chen pas rin spungs nor bzang pa la/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis dgon pa 'debs pa 'gog dgos tshul gsungs pa ni ngag rgyun ma dag pa'i 'chal gtam zhig bris par snang ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis bkra shes lhun po 'debs skabs/ bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon 'phyong rgyas pa hor dpal 'byor bzang po yin zhing / 'di nyid kyis rje dge 'dun grub kyi sbyin bdag gi mthil mdzad par ming tsam gyi mkhas pa ma yin pa'i grags pa don dang mthun pa'i paṇa chen byams pa gling pa bsod nams /ma par rgyal bas mdzad pa'i yang rgyab kyi gdung rabs na gsal bar gsungs rin spungs nor bzang pa'i bras u pa si / kun tu bzang po/ don grub rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ shākya rgyal mtshan dang lnga las/ dpon chung ngu nas grongs/ kun bzang pas dbang grags pa 'byung gnas sku mched kyi zhabs la gtugs/ yab mes kyi 'ja' sa las ka gnang ste rin spungs kyi rdzong dpon mdzad/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rang lugs pa kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel dang go rams bsod nams seng ge dang mchod yon du 'brel te /bras yul skyed mos tshal gyi bshad grwa btsugs shing / rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi dgon pa 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen mdzad/ don grub rdo rjes gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon gyi las ka bzung / ma sangs mtsho skyes rdo rjes yar glangs mkhar thog gi rdzong bzung zhing spyan snga dpal ngag gi dbang phyug gshegs rje gdung brgyud sku na ches phra bas/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtser dpon tshab kyi thel gtong mdzad/ shākya rgyal mtshan gyis nyang khog gi rdzong gzhis cu bzhugs nas

161bdag po rgyal mkhar rtse pa gtser ba sogs dgra thabs kyi bya ba la mkhas par grags/kun bzang pa la sras rdo rje tshe brtan dang / don yod rdo rje gnyis las/ don yod rdo rjes rdzong chen gnyis kyi las gas mtho ba dang bcas dbus phyogs nor 'dzin gyi char dpung gi 'jug sgos gzhis ka brag dkar dang chu shul lhan po rtse sogs snel pa'i lag nas blangs/ mi ring bar 'phyong rgyas pa blon tho gzhan rnams dang gros khog bstan pa'i spyan snga ngag gi dbang phyag pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i khrir mnga' gsozlo ba'i byed po mdzad/ la stod dang sto rgyud phyogs su dmag lan kha yar mdzad pa rnams rgyal zhing / de rjes spyan snga gong ma sku gshegs/ gdung brgyud rin po che nar ma son pa'i bar du bag yangs pa dang / khyad par lta grub kyi kun slong drag po snying la gzir ba'i 'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom pa me tog mda' can gyi zhags pas bcings pa 'ga' zhig gis yid rnam par bskyod pa la brten nas skyed shod phyogs su dpung 'jug byas par gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen smon lam dpal bas mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chen gyi las sbyor mdzad par brten/ dmag lan gnyis rkyen gzhan gyi dbang gis phyir bzlog dgos pa byung / slar kun mkhyen smon lam dpal ba sku gshegs pa'i gtam byung rjes dmag gi 'jug sgo byas pa dang / dga' ldan pa nam mkha' rgyal po ngo bltas pa sogs kyis sde gzar chabs su brgyugs te gzhis ka sne'u rtsis len pa sogs mdzad/ 'on kyang gong ma chen po sne'u gdong rtse'i khri thog tu gdan 'dren par blon po gzhan rnams kyi grogs su 'gyur ba'i mdzad pas ngo tsha khrel yod kyi gos dang ldan/ zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa dang mchod yon bka' bgros nas yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang sde dang bcas

102pa 'dzugs pa'i mthun rkyen mdzad/ rje drung chos grags rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa ltar lha ldan nye 'dabs su dgon pa btab na'ang / las 'bras kyi shugs 'di gang gis kyang dgag par ma nus pas yun du ma gnas/ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal gong ma spyan snga'i zhabs la gtugs nas rdzong dpon gyi las ka blangs/ rig gnas chung ba lnga dang / sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa gsal bar shar/ e gnyal gyi phyogs su dmag gi mdzad sgo sogs la brten/ gong ma chen po'i thugs la phog par rje 'bangs go rim ma log pa'i dgongs bsangs khengs dregs kyi dbang gis ma mdzad par brten/dbus phyogs kyi sne'u sogs rdzong gzhis rnams shor te mnga' thang cung zad nyams/ 'on kyang gtsang phyogs su seng ge rtse pa dang / la stod sto sogs 'og tu bcug byams chen gyis gtsos pa'i gtsang rong gi chos sde rnams la 'tsho rkyen sogs dge rgyan bzang po sbyar/ rin spungs nyid du pho brang chen po'i mig ltos kyis gsang /sngags kyi dus rim gyi srol btsugs/de nyid la sras gsum las/ che ba chung ngu nas grongs/ de 'og don grub tshe brtan rdo rjes sngar yab mes kyi dus ma lon pa'i pa snams lhan grub rtse'i rdzong mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa cirang dbang du byas/ rje drung sna bskyod rdo rje'i gsung bzhin gsung rab gling gi dgon pa btab/ bkra shis dpal bzang bla mar bsten nas theg pa'i rtse mo nyams su blangs/ gcung ngag dbang 'jigs grags mkhyen rab kyi klong rnam par yangs pas rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga ste bcu phrag gcig la slob dpon mkhas pa bsten nas/ rgyal po parnyi ta'i rnam thar bzung / hor gos bzang po'i rgyu las grub pa'i rigs ldan yol bar grags pa'i bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa de nyid bzhengs/ rje kun dga' grol mchog pa rab gnas su spyan drangs/ da 'i dgongs rgyan 'jigs

163med seṅge'i rgyud kyi nga ros thog drangs pa'i tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i bstan bcos kyi com pa mang du mdzad/ lugs gnyis la rnam dpyod kyi sgo 'phar mchog tu yangs/ 'on kyang phag tshang yos ltar dkrug pa'i lung bstan thog tu bab pa'i mtshan rtags kyis zhing gzhag pas 'bangs gyen log byas skabs sras padma dkar po bkrongs pa'i gtam byung ba/ sna rin cen spungs par dme 'khrug dar ba 'byung / mizhes pa'i dus su mngon/ sku tshe'i mjug tu mnga' thang phal cher shor/ sras zla ba bzang po'i brgyud deng sang yang snang ngo// //hā gong ma'i blon po hor gzhon nu bzang po ni/ za hor gyi rgyal rigs te/ grong khyer shing thabs can na rgyal po shing rta bcu pa zhes bya ba byang ba'i sras chos rgyal mya ngan med ces bya ba bden tshig gi mthus mchod rten bye༄ ba bzhengs pa/ de'i sras rgyal po dza zhes pa smon lam gyi mthus rdo rje sems dpa'i glegs bam gyi char pho brang gi steng du babs pas mdo sde za ma tog rlang gis khyer te pho brang yom bu gla sgang gi steng du babs pa lha tho tho ri snyan sharsha gyi gnyan po gsang bar btags la/ de'i sras za hor rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti sngags la mos pas/ po ti gnyis phyag na rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyis rnyed kyang brda ma 'phrod pas grub thob ku ku rā dza spyan drangs te smin par mdzad/ de la sras mo go ma de wa dang / sras sha kra gnyis kyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa grub cing / de'i sras rgyalapo gtsug lag 'dzin bya ba slob dpon chen po'i zab mo'i chos dang lung gis dbugs dbyung ba/ de la sras dharma rā dza/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ lha lcam man dha ra ba gsum las/ bar pa gnas lnga rig pa'i pha rol tu byon zhing / gangs can bstan pa'i rtsa lag mdzad/ phyi ma ye shes mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mor gyur/ dang pos rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i sras dharma pā la/ shākya de wa/ ma hā de wa gsum byung la/ de yang gangs can gyi ljo ngas

164su mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i srung mar/ slob dpon chen pos klu zur phud lnga pa la bka' bsgos pas/ nged kyis mi 'ongs/ za hor gyi yul na dmu'i rigs la klu'i tsha bo rgyal po ha zhes bya ba nor rgya khab tsam gyi rjes la bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad 'gro rā zhig yod pas de bsko bar zhus pas/ rnam sras seng sngon can rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa bkug nas gzugs brnyan bris pa'i ru dar la bstims nas/ khams kyi g.yer ma thang du dmag sgar btab/ slob dpon chen pos ting nge 'dzin gyis pe dkar bkug nas lan cig bod du 'ongs kyang ha cang gdug rtsub che bar byung zhing / slar mkhan slob chos gsum gyis za hor du pho nya mngags nas/ rgyal po dharma pā la/ g.yu'i thub pa rang byon/ zhal brnyan bse 'bag chibs shel gyi seṅga dang bcas te sna drangs pas pe kur yang rin po ches spras pa'i shing bya la zhon nas lha mi rnams bod du byon/ slob dpon chen pos spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste dam tshig bsgrags/ deng sang yang rgyal po nges par brlams na spyi gtsug tu rdo rje'i rjes yong / rnam sras sprin gseb ma'i lo rgyus dang pe dkar mar gtad kyi lo rgyus gnyis 'di dang gung 'grig par mngon/ dharma pā las mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi bla ma mdzad/ dpal chu bo rir theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor zab mo'i grub pa'i rtags khyad par can brnyes/ des pho yong bza' bya ba mkha' 'gro'i rigs can zhig khab tu bzhes pa'i sras dpal gyi rdo rje dang rin cen rdo rje gnyis las/ gcung rgya gar du byon/ thos bsam sgom pa mang du mdzad/ si ta'i grong khyer du sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ dpal gyi rdo rjes pa tshab kyi rigs kyi jo mo zhig blangs par sras rdo rje grags pa/ rin cen grags pa/ chos kyi grags pa gsum las/ gcung ni rab tu byung / gcen gyis sgrub pa mdzad pas yi

165dam gyi lha mang po zhal gzigs/ zhing skyes kyi 'e tī zhig phyag rgyar bsten pas sras zla ba grags pa/ de'i sras rig pa seng ge/ de la sras shākya blo gros/yon tan blo gros/ grags pa ye shes gsum gyis g.yon ru sa'i lte ba yar klungs su phebs/ gcen gyi g.yon ru khru 'brug dang khad nye ba'i g.yu srid smon mkhar du bzhugs/ 'bring ba gnam lde 'od srungs kyi bla ma mdzad nas mkhar thog btab/ chung bas lha sman jo mos sa skyong ba'i phyogs su lha khang btab nas bzhugs/ 'ga' zhig bye sa lha khang yin zer/ yon tan blo gros kyi sras rdo rje gsal ba dang rdo rje rin cen gnyis/ 'di'i dus rgya dang shar ga bya dang rngog khu dang dpus dkar sogs rus chen gyi 'bangs mang du byung /gcen gyi sras ye shes rdo rje/ des g.yu ru nam mkha' ri khu mo skyed khab tu bzhes pa la sras mo zhig las ma 'khrungs par mkhar thog dang bcag gnas rgya la byin pas pho brang rgya'i mkhar thog tu ming chags/ rin cen rdo rje mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyis gdan drangs/ phu lung 'di ngan lam rgya mtsho dang gtsang pa mi bdun du grags pa'i rigs sngags pas kyang ma thul tshul zhus nas/ gser gyi phyags shing khru do pa zhig phul/ bla mchod du bkur bas phu lung gi lha 'dre rnams btul/ der dgon pa stegs kha mo btab/ jo mo mchil mo zhig khab tu bzhes par sras rdo rje grags pa dang rdo rje 'bar ba gnyis 'khrungs/ yab sras gsum gyis hor pa sar byon/ sgang kha spel zhes bya ba'i pho brang zhig btab/ rgya gar gyi srol bzhin sras che ba khang pa phyi mar phog pas sras khang phyi par grags/ rdo rje 'bar klu sdings su phog pas sras lcang ldur bar grags/ mched gnyis kyis g.yu srid kun dga' bar sa dpyad legs par mkhyen nas phyag phab/ yab bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan rdo rje rgyal por gsol/ rdo rje 'bar ba la sras hor da dar ba zhes bya ba sbas pa'i rnal 'byor

166nus mthu'i mnga' bdag chen po zhig byung bas/ hor se chen rgyal pos gsan nas gser yig pa mngags te spyan drangs kyang / thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas btul te ma phebs/ de'i sras hor bkra shis 'bum dang mkhan chen tshul dar ba gnyis las/ mkhan chen pa dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung las/ spyan snga bcu gnyis rin po cher so sor thar pa'i sdom pa mnos/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i zab chos mang du gsan zhing / spyan snga grags pa shes rab dang / ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi dbu skra'i phud bzhes te bla ma mdzad/ hor bkra shis 'bum la sras gzhon nu bzang po dang bkra shis bsam grub/ gnyis kus gong ma si tu'i zhabs la gtugs/ khyad par gcen gyi gsol ja ba nas bzung bka' blon gyi bar las tshan rim par mdzad/ dpon chen rgyal bzang pas si tu btson du bzung ba'i skabs/ dmag gis bsdigs pa'i bskor g.yang mang du byas kyang sne'u gdong rtser 'khru phur bzung zhing /dpon chen dbang brtson gyis khri bskor bcu gsum gyi dmag yar klungs su bteg pa dus kyi me lce'i 'phreng ba la phye ma leb mchongs pa'i ngang tshul bzhin bcom pas/ stobs 'byor gyi dregs pas myos pa'i sa skya'i dpon chen kyang spa bkong bar mdzad pa sogs kyis sde srid phag mo gru pa'i bstan jus tshugs pa'i rtsa ba lta bur byung bas/ si tus/ 6 gzhon nus snying bgyis/ gzhan rnams yan lag gi tshul bgyis zhes dang / gzhan yang ya gi gtsang sa skya nas/smad 'jang zhabs sto mon dang bcas pa mnga' 'og tu 'du ba gzhon nu bzang po'i drin yin migasungs/ gcung bkras bsam pa'i sras gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/kun dga' dpal bzang / nam mkha' rin cen/ dbang phyug rin cen dang bzhi byung ba rnams kyis spyan snga rin po che dang gong ma si tu'i zhabs la gtuṭa/rgyal srid skyong ba'i blon po'i bya ba rnams gong sa'i dgongs pa dang bstun par

167mdzad do//kun dga' dpal bzang gi sras dpal 'byor bzang po/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ sangs rgyas skyabs/ dkon cog rin cen bzhi 'khrungs/ dpal 'byor bzang pos tshes bzhi gsar ma ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ nyang smad bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon dang / gyis su dmag dpon la bskos pas dgra sha drod ma yal bar blangs pas srin po yang byin sha 'dar zhes dpa' rtags byung /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub dang mchod yon du 'brel bas/ rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa'i ring lugs la mos pa thob/ bsam rtse na kun mkhyen bu'i phyag bris dang phyag rtags 'byar ba'i bka' 'gyur bzhugs pa phying bar stag rtser gdan drangs/ gcung gsum gyis sa skyong grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la gtugs/ khyad par nang so dkon cog rin cen gong ma'i luṭa gnyis kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag spel ba'i nang blon mdzad/ bod kyi blon po rig pa can rgyan mar 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi ri po'i 'dabs rol tu snying bar stag rtse'i drotsan rdzong lha'i grong khyer mi yul du 'phos pa lta bur yid du 'ong ba brtsigs/de'i skabs sras nyag phra bar byung bas/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas chos rje zha lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan gdan drangs/ gshed dmar gyi sgo nas rigs bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pas hor rdo rje tshe brtan 'khrungs/ skabs shig lha mo 'od zer can ma'i las tshogs la brten nas/ rgya khab rtser brgyus dgra phyogs su bstan pas dmag dpung chen por mthong ba dang / rdzong la chu med par dbyangs 'char gyi sgo nas lu ma bton pa sogs bka' drin che bas dga' ldan dos skyel du grags pa zhal ngo rim par mdzad/hor rdo rje tshe brtan dbang grags pa 'byung gnas sku mched kyi zhabs la gtugs nas bka' khrims sgyur ba'i blon po mdzad/ phying bar stag rtse'i ri

168glang po che lta bu'i ngos su ri bo bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhings/ thon mi sa sto ṭa'i gdung las gnas lnga rig pa'i pasnyi ta chen po byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba mi pham dga' ba'i bshes gnyen spyan drangs nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gyur ba'i glegs bam rnams kyi steng du/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i gsung 'bum po ti bcu drug bsnan pa'i pusta ka mkha' mda' mig gi grangs ldan bzhugs shing / bstan 'gyur snga ma rnams la med pa'i skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po zha lu lo chen gyis bsgyur ba'i mngon pa'i 'grel ba gnam lcags thog gzer yang yod do/ /mched rnams kyi sras/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang rin cen rgyal mchog gnyis las gcen ni rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad dang sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la mkhas par byang zhing / hor rin cen rgyal mchog ni srid zhi'i yon tan nor bu'i 'phreng dro mgrin pa'i do shal du spud cing / dpal mdzangs rtul phod soṭa lugs gnyis kyi bla na mtho ba'i gong ma chen pos thugs shin tu 'jog pa'i blon po rnams kyi gtso bo lta bur gyur/ gong ma'i bka' shog hung rgya ma'i nang du/dbus gtsang gi chings kyi skor la gnas tshul dri bar btang 'dug pa/ ‘ 'di tshor che chung ji 'dra zhig byed kyang khyod rang la 'dri ba las 'os med pas sgo gang zab kyi thag de kha nas chod migasung ba sogs rgyal po las blon po gtso ba'i gtam phyag len du mdzad/ srong btsan gzhis kur zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa spyan drangs/ yangs pa can gyi chos sder mchod gzhis sogs kyi mthun rkyen gong sar zhu ba gnang / bde skyid gling du spyan snga bka' brgyud bris 'bur dang / bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs gser gyis 'ji ba gnang / jo mo la bsam yas rgyal po'i gnod pa byung bar/ gsol kha bshol nas ar la gtad
