169pas chos skyong gi tshur btud de/ dngos grub ster bar gsungs pa bzhin nyi ma gcig la rdzong bcu gsum blangs/ dbus gtsang gi chings bdag mdzad pas/gram pa shar/ stod lung rmad sogs sgyu gu mchu rin la bzhes/de'i sras bsod nams mgon po/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ rin cen tshe brtan rnams las/ gcen gong ma'i cu gas la btags pas dmag dpon gyi las ka bzung / skyid shod dpal 'byor lhun po thab skyong la gnang / 'bring po 'jigs pa med pa dpal bo'i dbang phyug ste/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa ltar dgra thabs la mkhas pas yan lag rnam bzhi'i khyu mchog yin la/ chung ba yang rnam dpyod zla ba gsar pa'i ngos su gtsug lag ri dwags kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba zhig go/ mched rnams la bya bkra shis dar rgyas kyi sras mo don yod sgrol ma jo mor bzhes par sras hor bsod nams dar rgyas dang / don grub rdo rje gnyis las/ gcen lugs gnyis kyi gtsug 'tshin mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i spyan dang ldan zhing / khyad par bka' brgyud dmi ka tshang gi ring lugs pa don dang mthun pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal khang lo tsā ba'i drung du thun mong ba'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la phul du byung ba'i sbyangs pa mdzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho gdan drangs te dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal stsal/ gcung 'khor ba'i phun tshogs mtha' dag chu shing gi snying po ltar gziṭa te/ sdom gsum rim gyis mnos pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/hor bsod pa'i jo sor dga' ldan pa sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan gyi lcam sring tshe dbang rgyal mo blangs par sras bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po/tshe dbang bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ rkarma ngag dbang grags pa gsum gyi che ba phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid kyis nam mkha'i nor bu la skyengs pa ster bar nus la/ g.yul ngor chas pa'i drag shul gyis thob rgyal lha rtse'i rdzong mnga'

170zhabs dang bcas pa chab 'og tu btsud/ dus gsum mkhyen pa mtsho skyes rdo rje'i ring lugs pa slob dpon bee ro tsa na'i thugs sprul gter ston shes rab 'od zer ti srir bsten nas/ sa 'dzin dpal gyi ri la theg mchog sgrab pa'i 'dus sde btab/ sher phyin sum brgya pa/ shel brag gi thang yig sems nyid ngal gso rnams par du bzhings/ 'brug nas sprul pa'i ska kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu sogs dam pa du ma la phu dud mdzad/ dkadro phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dga' ston spros bcas dang spros med kyi zlos gar le'u brgyad pa'i cho ga bsgrigs bzhin btsugs/ gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan gyi shar pa chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes rig pa'i gnas lnga la ma rmongs pa'i mkhas pa de spyan drangs nas ri bo bde chen ser khyim pa lta bur song ba slar gtsang dgon mdzad/ 'bring pos rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang /khyad par chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la rmad du byung ba'i bkur sti dang phud dud mdzad/ chung ba gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhung lugs la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs so// mched rnams la jo mo 'od gsal lha'i gdung brgyud mi dbang byams pa rab brtan gyi sras mo don grub blangs par sras ngag gi dbang po bsod rnams grags pa 'jig rten dga' ba'i rgyan dang / lha'i dbang phyug mched gnyis dang lcam gsum 'khrungs/ dang po ni/ lhams su zhugs pa'i skabs mtshan ma khyad par can mang du byung zhing / lugs rshanyis la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs/ 'chi med grub pa'i ring lugs pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi yon tan gyi sprul pa byang pa bdag chen ti srir bsten/ khyad par gsang chen rdo rje theg pa la rtsal du thon pas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad/ yi dam dang chos srung gi gnang ba thob pas lha srin bran du 'khol nus pa'i mthu stobs dbang phyug gi snyan pa che zhing /

172 la gtugs/ sa skya pa bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / tshal pa/ g.ya' bzang pa sogs kyis hor rgyal po la zhu log phul bas/ dgongs pa dag byed kyi rgyu mtshan 'bul bar sher bkras pas lus srog la bstos pa med par hor rgyal po tho gan thi —mur gyi drung du byon/ rgyu mtshan 'bul mkhas pas 'phral yun du phan pa'i 'ja' sa 'grub/ sde srid kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byung bar dpags/ gzhis ka brag dkar khyod shes rab bkra shis mi brgyud dang bcas pas shes su chug gi bka' shog gnang /de'i sras drung rin cen dpal dang / dge slong gnyis las/ che ba la gong ma chos rgyal chen pos rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i sbyin bdag gi mthil len mdzad nas/ ri bo dga' ldan gyi dgon pa 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen snga phyir bsgrubs/ de la 'phyong rgyas nas jo mo sangs rgyas ma blangs par sras rin cen lhan po/ lhan grub pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/dngos grub/ kun dga' 'dzom spro rnams larā/ che ba gong ma chen pos rdzong dpon du bsko bzhag gnang / ri bo dga' ldan gyi rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad/de 'og gong ma'i gsol dpon gyi las ka bzung / de 'og rab tu byung ste gsung rab la sbyangs nas se ra theg chen gling gi gdan sa mdzad/ de 'og chos sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsol dpon dang / de 'og gong ma kun dga' leṭa pas rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / mched rnams la gzhis ka rin spungs nas sras mo lha mo chos skyong jo mor blangs pa la/ nang so dkon cog pa dang sri chod rgyal po gnyis las/ che bas rab tu byung / chung ba la tshes gnyis rin po ches rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs dang /chos rje smon lam dpal ba sogs mkhas pa rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi gsan pa mang du mdzad/ de la rgya ma ba'i sras mo bu khrid khab tu bzhes pa la/ nang so

173'jam dpal tshe ring / bdud 'dul rgyal po/ ma zhig pa/ bsod nams rgyal po/ lcam gnyis dang drug las/ 'jam dpal ba'i jo sor yar rgyab nas tshe ring dpal 'dzom blangs par/ sras tshe brtan rdo rjes rdzong dpon gyi las ka bzung / chab srid bskyangs so//༈ gzhis ka snel ba ni/ chen po rin cen bzang pos gong ma si tu'i zhabs la gtugs/ sa skyar dmag la 'byon skabs/ sgo tus phag gru'i khri dmag rnams kyis chen po la phyag 'tshal dgos pa sogs gsungs nas dpon tshab tu bskos/ dus der dpon chen bzung ba sogs jus kyi 'gro khyab che ba byung / sa skya pa dang hor rgyal po mchod yon du 'brel ba'i dus kyi nor sna khyad 'phags rnams dbus su drangs/ dpon chen rnams kyis gtsos pa'i gzhan sde rnams la khrims ra nyi ma bcu gsum bsgyur cing bya khru ma'i steng du mi lnga brgya tsam khrims la sbyar ba'i drag shul gyis 'bod grogs kyang 'dar/ skam po grong du sger gzhis kyi mkhar las mdzad/ bya sar sger gru btsugs/ yon bdag blo bde'i sras mo bde skyid/ khams mo/ dpon mo dpal ldan 'bum gsum jo mor blangs pa las/ dang po la rgyal ba rin cen/ drung nam mkha' bzang po/gnyis pa la dpon shag pa/ gsum pa la dpal ldan chos skyong dang / bsod nams bzang po 'khrungs/dpal ldan chos skyong gi nyang smad bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon thog cig mdzad/ drung chen dpon grags pas gong ma'i zhabs la gtugs/ spyan snga grags pa byang chub dang / rdzong byi rgyal mtshan bzang po dpon blon bka' bgros thog sne'u'i rdzong dpon du bskos/ gong dkar nas sgom log chos rgyal gcung po rtses thang dge ba nyan dang / pa sde mkhan pos gtsos pa'i dmag gi sbyor ba bshams pa mtsho sna gdong du thebs skabs/ dpon grags pa rang gis

174dmag dpon mdzad nas 'khrugs pas rgyal te/ pa sde mkhan pos gtsos pa'i mi drug cu tsam lnga pa'i lam du btang / de rjes stong pa 'jam dpal gyi thog tu dpung bteg gnya' gnan du gzhis ka smon mkhar brtsigs/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi gyo thog rdo gcal gsar rjes khyams ra dang / bar bskor gyi thog 'bubs/ ldeb bris/ gong ma si tu'i dgongs rdzogs su/ chos rdzong /bkra shis sgang / brag nag dbus gling sogs skyid shod stod smad kyi sngags grwa rnams su dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod btsugs/ byams pa chos 'khor gyi drung du dge 'dun bzhi sdes byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs smon lam dang bcas pa'i rgyun/ dung mtshor sngar dung mtsho ras pas ngan slong la skyo tshul btsugs pa bar skabs su chad pa gser bre'i nas khal lnga bcu lnga bcus lo ltar du gsos/chen po rin bzang pa yab yum/ rgyal ba rin chen sku mched kyi sgrib sbyong la/jo bo rnam gnyis drung du sman bla 'don pa'i rgyun/ gsang de'u thog sogs dge ༵dun gyi sde rnams su mthun rkyen sbyor ba sogs rnam dkar gyi las gcig tu de —/ drung chen nam mkha' bzang shā gong ma'i lung gis sne'u'i rdzong dpon du byon/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa yab sras la rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad/ khyad par dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi chos sde chen po 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen phul du byung ba dang / rta chen gyi zla ba'i cho 'phrul gyi dus khyad par can la 'gro ba'i bsod nams ma smad par bskrun pa'i thabs dam pa lha sa smon lam chen mo 'dzugs pa'i mthil len mdzad/ 'di nyid kyis lcam rin cen sgrol ma jo mor blangs par/ drung chen nam mkha' dpal 'byor 'khrungs/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / gsor gyi bka' 'gyur bzheng ba dang / 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i zhabs tog

176grags pa brtson 'grus/ gzhon nu 'phags gsum las/ che bas snar thang du rab tu byung / chung bas ti ri grags 'od pa'i yig dpon mdzad/ bar pa la zas rgyal mtshan yig ris mang du mkhyen/ 'di nyid kyis brtsams pa'i bka' pota yang snang / 'di chos rje /rma pa dang thugs 'brel che bas/ mtshur phu'i byang chub chen po bzheng bar byon skabs/ bzo rgyus ldangs na kho bos mdun gyi nags ri 'di tsam blor shong zhus pas/ sprul sku nags ri par grags/ 'dis ma gcig lha sman jo sor blangs par bras dpal ldan bzang po/ dpal ldan rin cen/ ma zangs dar po gsum 'khrungs/ nyang stod 'dul chung chu nub kyi nang tshan/ lhan yul sngon mo lung rings su byon pa'i lam khar lcags pa'i gdung brgyud 'phags pa rgyal la dang mjal te ming zhus pas/ gcen gnyis la 'phaṭa pa dpal bzang dang / 'phags pa rin cen du btags/'phags pa dpal bzang gis dpal ldan sa skya pa'i las tshan bzung /gtam yig rtsis gsum/ mda' kha dpa' rtsal dang ldan pa'i shar dung sto dung 'dul ba'i rgan por sa skya nas bskon cha dang bcu tshe gnang / de nas bzhi thog nye gnas kyi go sa bzung / pha shi dar kha che shar phyogs gong ma'i drung du brdzangs pas/ 'dri mtshams gangs dkar po tshun shes su bcug pa'i 'ja' sa gnang / gong ma si tu'i drung du byon par/ slob dpon nam rgyal/ sher bzang /pa shi dkon cog rnams kyis rin spungs su bsgar nas/ grwa tshong 'dus su bskyal te ngam gcur byas pa las grol te yar byon skabs/ hor rgyal pos nang chen gyi 'ja' sa gnang / rtse chen dang phag ri rnam rgyal gyi rdzong brtsigs/ rgyal rtse/sna bo rdzong gnyis nyi ma gcig la 'gram btings/ khyung rtse sogs rdzong mang du brtsigs/ rtse chen gtsug lag khang btab/bdag chen 'phags pa dpal la sras mang du yod kyang / jo mo ma

177gcig dpal ma la nang chen kun dga' 'phags 'khrungs/ de la sras dpon mo mgon po sogs sras lcam sring mang du 'khrungs pa las/ bdag chen rab brtan kun bzang 'phags 'di nyid pho brang sne'u gdong rtser gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du byon/ gong mas sne'u gdong dga' ldan rtse'i rten gsum rnams kyi nang nas dpon rab brtan dang ji ltar 'dod pa zhig khyer gsungs pas/ thub dbang rdo rje gdan chung ma zhig zhus pas/ thugs nyams che ba'i grags pa byung / deng sang yang rgyal rtse'i li ma lha khang du bzhugs yod 'dug cing / gtsang du byon nas grogs po brgya rtsar rin spungs nam mkha' rgyal po'i dpung rnams spub ste mtshan jus legs pa byung / mkhas grub rin po che dang mchod yon du 'brel nas/ dpal 'khor bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang sde dang bcas pa btab/ sngags grwa pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor mang po'i zhal 'byed dang / mdo grwa pa rnams kyis dbyar chos thog bka' pota rnams la rab 'byams grwa bskor gyi rgyun srol btsugs/ sku 'bum bkra shis sgo mang dang gos sku chen mo/ bka' 'gyur rgyun 'jags su bzhing ba sogs dbus gtsang gi sde dpon zhig la rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa 'di nyid che bar mngon/ 'di'i sras rab brtan bkra shis 'phags/ de'i sras don grub 'phags nas bzung ste bdag po phun sum pa yan chad du mnga' thang rgyun gnas shing / bar skabs su dus mi bde ba 'ga' zhig byung yang / gong ma sde srid nas rgyab gnyer mdzad pas skyon du ma gyur to// //: sde pa 'ol kha ba ni/ drung chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan la sde srid gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / chos rje bzang skyong pas nyi ma gling gi dgon pa 'debs pa'i sbyin bdag gi mthil mdzad/ rin po che'i khu bas bris pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'i glegs bu kha bas bskor

178ba'i ljongs su 'gyur ro cog bzheng ba sogs sku tshe'i stod la rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs shing / rjes su rigs kyi sras nar son pa dang / chos rje rgyal tshab pa'i drung du bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa mnos/ 'ol kha dge sbyong chen por skye bo rnams gleng / de rjes nor bzang pa dang / rgya mtsho ba mched kyis srid bskyangs shing sde pa rgya mtsho ba la gong ma chen pos dmag dpon gyi las ka gnang bas/ gzhan sde 'joms pa la snying stobs kyi rtsal dang ldan skad/ de nas mkhan chen pas mchod khang dang / rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i sku'i snang brnyan bzheng ba sogs gong ma'i rgyun bzang po bzung de rjes don yod rnam rgyal rdo rjes/ mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun nor bzang rgya mtsho zhes dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung lugs sngon chad gangs can pa rnams kyis ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs pa'i the tshom gyi dra ba mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin pa'i shing rta chen po pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnams la gus mchod lhar len zhing / khyad par gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i sbas pa'i bsti gnas chos /khor rgyal gyi 'dus sde rten dang brten par bcas pa la 'tsho ba'i yo byad bzang po gong 'phel du sbyar ba sogs dge ba'i las kyi shugs zad pa med pa'i ral gris mu mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba nags klung stag po'i mtha' dbral te/ sras phun tshogs rab brtan gshegs par brten/ ga zhal ngo'i brgyud ring bar ma byang yang / gyis su 'od gsal lha las babs pa'i sa skyong ba dang khyon gcig pa1 spyar to// //༈ yar rgyab pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pojo blon po thon mi sa ṭa zhes bya ba 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa/ sngar bod du yi ge'i srol med pa la/ rgya yig lnga bcu tham pa bod yig sum cur gtan la 'bebs pa'i

17 shing rta chen po de nyid kyi gdung brgyud yin la kha cig sto ṭa zhes smra ba ni mi rigs par saṃ bha drar 'dod pa mchis na'ang sasto ṭa zhes gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad smra ba la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba chen po zha lu ba chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos za ma tog tu/ 6 gangs can khrod pa'i bla ma mchog /sa ṭa zhes rab grags pa'i/ zhes gsungs pas so/ //chos blon chen po 'di nyid kyi sras ma hā sa tā/ de'i sras ye nag de'i sras nyi ma klong gsal/ de'i sras ber nag can/ de'i sras mon mo/ de'i sras gtso bo lha sras/ 'di rnams dgung lo brgya lhag tsam bzhugs pa sha stag byung / de'i sras bsod nams rgyal po/ de'i sras rgyal po dga'/ de'i sras rta mgrin rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras rdo rje bkra shis/ 'dis dpal ldan sa skyar ti sri kun blo'i zhabs la gtugs/ de nyid kyi hor rgyal po'i drung du brdzangs pas/ du dben 'i bya las chen po gnang /de'i sras dpon bzhi 'dzom/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gzhis ka gong dkar gyi rdzong dpon la bskos/ de'i sras rgyal ba shes rab/ de'i sras dpon chen gral lnga/ 'di nyid kyis sku tshe'i stod la gong ma grags pa 'byang gnas kyis yar rgyab dbon chen dang gong dkar rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnangag /'on kyang sprul pa'i gang zag khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ sku tshe'i smad la rab tu byung ste gsang ba sngags kyi chos sde gong dkar rdo rje gdan du grags pa'i ngo mtshar can de btab/ 'di nyid kyi dbon sras nas bzung ste/ sde pa rnam rgyal ba sku mched kyi bar du mnga' thang yar rgyas su gnas so// //: bya pa khri dpon ni/ yul yar klungs kyi smad/ ma yul smongs kyi 'dabs su bya'i rgyal po gshog bzang dang 'dab bzang gi rigs las mched pa

——180mang du byung bas bya pa zhes grags la/ zu yar klungs mthil du rnam smin bskyed pa yi/ /glo bur rgyal po bya mig mas kyis 'gebs/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan du gleng / yul der bya chos kyi ka ba dang / gcung thod pa g.yu'i smin ma can mched gnyis las/ chung ba'i sras mkhan po yon tan mchog dang / bya sha ka gnyim 'khrungs pas/ gcen gyis 'bring sde la rab tu byang / e nas klogs/byar nas shar mda'/ dwags po nas grom mda'/ sngaganyal nas srin mo mig rnams bzung / bya sha ka la sras rdo rje legs pa dang rdo rje dbang phyug gnyis byung ba gnyal phyogs su byon/ rgya mtsho grong mkhar btab/ gcung gi sras bla ma bya nag chen po rin cen 'od 'khrungs/ kha che paṇa chen dang mjal nas spyod rgyad dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis zhus/ gzhan yang rgyal ba thog dogs pa/ skyo rtsod 'byung / 'jad rta mig pa sogs bla ma mang du bsnyen nas ༄thos bsam sgom pa lhar bzhes mdzad/ khyad par spu gri skor gsum sogs yi dam chos skyong la rtsa/ du thon pas yang rtse'i gtsug lag khang las kyang gnyan pa'i grags che/'di nyid kyis gtsug lag khang brtsigs dus stag spre'u/ sho mong gsum bong tshod shin tu che ba'i cho 'phrul byung bas/ stag dang zho mong gnyis bsad pa'i sob kyang rtse'i mgon khang spyan gzigs khrod du yod skad/ spre'u de gsod thub na dbugagatsang spyi dang khyad par sto rgyud kyi mi bde ba'i rtsa ba zhi ba zhig 'ong rgyu yin kyang / 'gro ba'i las kyi mthus spre'u shor bas phyis su sku rab tu byung /bla ma 'di la byar smad du tshal sgom chos la dga'/ lo rong rab dga' ba chen po/ dwags por ba tsho ras pa/ gtsang du 'u yug pa chen po ste chos kyi bu bzhi/ gnyal du chos grwa grong mkhar/ mar se po/ dgas su nags mo shod byar na rgya mtsho thug gang ste sde bzhi byung la/ rigs kyi sras bya jo sras/ de'i sras mnga' bdag de la sras dge slong ba/ bya rin cen/ chos rgyal dpa'i

lnge ———— bzang gsum las/ dang po'i sras rin cen dpal/ dbang phyug rig cen/rin cen bzang po/ dwags po ba bzhi byang / dwags gnyal lo ro rnams su gzhis ka mang du brtsigs/ bya rin cen ces e gnyal byar dwags lo ro rnams kyi sgo sdud mdzad nas hor dmag bzlog pas kun gyis dpon du bkur/'di'i sras kun dga' rin cen gyis sa skya'i dpon chen kun dga' bzang po la gtugs/ bya chos rgyal dpal bzang pos 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i drung du byon/ shar pa kun bsod la slob dpon bcol nas rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa sbyangs pa mdzad/ a mi bya nag gi dus la yang rtser mgon khang sogs yod pa'i stong du/ slar gtsug lag khang du grags pa'i mkhar las rgya bskyed/ rgya hor gyi nor sna mang po bsdas nas mdzod nag tu rgyas btab/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gser las grub pa rā ngas/ chos srid kyis mtho ba'i 'go tshugs/ 'di'i sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen spyil pu ba/mnga' bdag chos seng 'od/ bya thub pa dpal rnams las/ dang pos dpon chen 'od zer seng ge la 'dam du rdzongs zhu bar byon/ rte'u ra'i gya gnyer kyang 'di'i ring la byang / mnga' bdag chos seng 'od 'bri gung gi sku tsha yin par brten/ 'bri 'eng nas byar dwags kyi dpon du bskos/de'i sras mkhan chen tshul khrims bzang pos zangs mo che'i mkhan po mdzad/ slar yang rtser khri dpon gyi go sar byon/ de'i sras dkon cog bzang po de'i sras bkra shis dpal bzang gis rtses thang du slob gnyer mdzad/bshad ston bzang po btang / gong ma sde srid grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bya pa'i khri dpon la bskos/ de'i sras rgyal ba bkra shis/ shākya dpal mgon/thub pa rgyal mtshan rnams las/ dang pos sne'u gdong rtser byon/ gong ma sde srid kyi drung 'khor mdzad/ bya pa khri dpon gyi go sar bskos/ sras bya bkra

183blon po mgar gyi rigs las/ tre stos dga' bde bzang po zhes pa tshal pa khri dpon gyi go sar yod par de la gtugs/ dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis sde srid phag mo gru pa'i rdzong dpon gzhis ka snel pa'i phyag g.yog mdzad/ nyang bran dga' ldan gyi mi dpon du bskos pas dga' ldan pa'i ming thogs/ de la sras bsod nams rgyal po/ dbang dar/ rnam sras gsum gyi che ba snel pa dpal 'byor rgyal po'i thugs la btags pas/ dbyi nag bsod rgyal du grags shing /byang snyi chos lung dang yang dgon nang sor gtogs pa phud rjes/ glan ka gnyis gas gtsos/ lo sbrel sna gdong gyin gyi 'ja' sa gnang / 'bring pos snams bon grong gi bdag po mdzad/ chung ba 'brong ri sngon rdzong du yod thogarin spungs pa'i dpung gis bskor ba'i rgyogs nad la brten rdzong gtad nas/tshal du mkhar las mdzad nas bzhugs/ dbyi nag bsod rgyal ba mched kyi zas nang so canam mkha' rgyal pos bar skabs chu zhol lhan po rtse bzung / 'on kyang snel pa nang zlos dus rin spungs pa'i dpung snye tharā du 'byor thog chu shol gtad/nam mkha' rgyal po'i sras tshe brtan rgyal po dang / bsod nams gnyis las/ che ba rab tu byang / chung ba la snel pa sku mched kyi dgongs par mi bde ba mang du byung brjo brten/ rin spungs don yod rdo rjes dpung skyed shod du bcug skabs/ rin spungs par ngo gtad pa'i dmag gi sne bsu mdzad pas sne'u dang po ta la sogs rin spungs pa'i phyag tu 'byor ba'i lag rtags su rnying khung gi steng snye mda' chu so kha yan gyi 'ja' sa gnang / de nas mi ring bar sde srid gong ma chen po'i dpung gzhung po rar phebs skabs/ yar rgyab rin chen bkra shis kyis 'tshams sbyar nas/ dga' shag gnyis kyis gong ma'i zhabs sbyar 'brangs/ shag pa la skyor mo klung dang skyid shod g.yas ru'i ru dpon/

184dga' ldan par bde chen du gtogs pa'i chu sto byang rnams dang / mar rgyab par sne'u'i rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / gong ma'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur bas bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan 'phrul snang gis gtsos skyid shod lung pa'i khrims bdag tu lung bud/ gtan khru shel tham gyis chod/'di nyid kyi sras ra nu lha bsrung gis gong ma chen po chu shol du bzhugs skabs/ rin spungs pa'i dmag gis khang bcar bar ra nu lha bsrung gis gtsos pas kha spub che bar btang bas/ gong sa nas dmag dpon bsod nams rgyal po'i ming gnang / byi ri stag rtse'i mi brgyud rdzogs rjes dga' ldan pa dang khyon sgril bar sras lcam sring drug 'khrungs pas gnyis chung ngu la grongs/ lcam tshe dbang rgyal mo 'phyong rgyas hor bsod pa'i jo mo dang / lcam dung dkar sde srid kyi bdag mor bzhes/ de 'og nang so don grub rgyal pos gong sa nas rdzong dpon gyi las ka zhus/ mi ring bar sde srid zhal ngo nang du sel zhugs skabs dga' ldan pa'i dbang gis skyor mo klung rdzong dmar 'bebs su btang / stod lung dang 'phan yul gyi rdzong mnga' zhabs phal cher blangs/ gang sa nas chu shol mkhan chen por bka' bkron gnang ba'i dpung gi rkangs mdzad nas chu zhol 'bebs pa dang / gong dkar nas zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa rtse'i khrir phebs pa'i zhabs 'degs mdzad/gcung sde pa bkra shis rab brtan pas/ gong sar yar rgyab nas zhabs 'dren zhus skabs skyid shod kyi dpung rnams lho khar bton ba sogs sde srid kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur bar brten/ gzhis ka brag dkar gyi rdzong dpon gnang /skyid smad rnam rgyal sgang gi sgrub mchod gling mkhar du/ sne gdong yar rgyab soṭa sto rgyud kyi dpung rnams 'byor ba'i steng du/ sde ba bkra shis pa nyid kyis 'go mdzad nas mchongs pa dang / stod lung mtsho sna gdong du yar gong chu snag

183gnyal byar lor gsum/ sto brag dwags kong du rgyal bzang gi dpung byub sgril byung ba bzlog thub pa sogs dgra thog tu mngon par lci ba'i dpa' grags kyis srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu la skyengs pa ster nus/ dga' ldan dngul gdung rin po cher sgo rgyan/ 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi gser thog bzo ba/ rin cen sgang du rig pa'i dbang phyag chos kyi grags pa'i ring lugs kyi bshad grwa 'dzugs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi domadzad pa'i zla snang gis legs byas puṇḍa ri ku'i tshal ches cher rgyas par mdzad cing / rigs rus yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba'i lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po shar pa chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs ti ther bsten nas bkur sti bla lhag tu mdzad/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la rnam dpyod kyi rtsal rmad da byang ba'i yon tan daju snyi'i sgra ༄ ༄ ༄dbyangs skabs gsum bdag po'i gnas su bsgrogs so/ /'di nyid kyi sras sde pa g.yul rgyal nor bu lugs gnyis kyis mngon par mtho zhing sras bsod nams rnam rgyal/ yid bzhin nor bu chos rje gsum las/gcen gnyis kyis rtse nas gong ma'i lcam jo mor bsus pa'i zas mgon po rab brtan/ smra/ / rnam rgyal/ chos rje mtsho skyes rdo rje rnams byung ngo//sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor yongs 'du rlangs kyi smon// gnam bskos rgyal srid yal 'dab stag po las//bsod nams dpung gis spyod pa'i spro bdag 'bras//mnga' 'bangs dga' ba'i 'dod rgu char du phab//rigs rus bzang po'i nor 'dzin dbus//

186stobs 'byor gser gyi 'dzin mas bskor//ya rabs rnam thar lhan po'i rtser//rgyal phran nye dbang sdugs kyi 'dus//chos srid blang dor gnas kun la//ma 'dres gzigs pa'i spyan stong ldan//sde srid mchod sbyin brgya pa gang //srid 'dir mtho ba'i khri la 'gying //zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //de ltar gong ma ta'i si tu nas bzung ste/ bod gnyan zhan gyi go rim sil bur ma gyur gyi bar/ srid kyis mngon par mtho ba phal cher ni sde srid gong ma'i thugs la btags shing / lung dang las ka gnang ba shas che na'ang /sa skyong lha rgya ri ba ni/ gong sa nas lung dang 'ja' sa ched du ma blangs par/nyi 'og gi rgyal por gyur pa zhig ste/ de yang bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyad dri ma med pa gnam lde 'od srungs kyi sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan rū brgyud tsha ba khri bkra shis brtsegs pa'i sras gsum gyi 'od sde las rim par byung ba/ 'od skyed 'bar gyi sras gtsang tsha spun drug las brgyud de/ gdan sa thel gyi mdar bcad po tsha ba rong pa zhes mi dpon zhig dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po'i dus byang zhing / de nas rim par brgyad nang so mda' smad pas/e stod chu tshan ༄kha zhabs su ri la rtswa rgya bo skyes pa༄ zhig na gzhis ka brtsigs pas rgya ri zhes ming du chags/de nas lha chos kyi bshes gnyen sogs zhal ngo rim par byung ba las/lha dgra las rnam rgyal gyis rgya ri rdzong du bzhugs/ thams can mkhyen pa dge

187'dun rgya mtsho dang mchod yon du 'brel/ rgya ri ltog mkhar du lo gsar gtor chen gyis phyag srol btsugs/ lha dgra las pas mee chen ri sgo phyogs su phebs pas/ yul du bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan mang du byung bas/ yul mi rnams kyis nas phud khal re phul/ bla'i dpon du gyar te/ ri sge bkra shis chos rdzong du pho brang gi lte ba mdzad/ de nas lha 'jirsha rten dbang phyug khri thog tu phebs rjes/ lha byams pa rab brten dang / lha yul 'khor dbang phyug sku mched gnyis byung / 'di'i dus su sprul sku bde chen gling pas/ zu e yi nang du khrug mtsho lan gsum khol/ /rgyal po byams pa'i ming can bya ba 'byung / /rgyal po de yi bstan pa rgyas pa la zhes sogs kyi don dang mthun par mnga' thang gong du 'phel/ khyad par lha yul 'khor bas lang mi'i grong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i btsan rdzong 'ol kha stag rtse mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa rang dbang du mdzad/ de nas lha bsod nams rab brtan ska mched gsum las/ bsod nams rab brtan khri thog tu phebs/ chad dkar snang gi nye 'dabs su dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa sogs rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs/ de rjes/ lha dga' ldan dpal 'bar gyisari khrir phebs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la sri zhu bla lhag tu mdzad/ rog pa rtsar mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rang nyams gyi blo'i spyod yul can rnams ming gi lhag mar bcom pas mgo lag khrag gi ral pas spags pa blangs pa sogs 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i dbu rmog btsan po gyon/de rjes khri thog tu blo bzang mthu stobs chos rgyal byon nas snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis sde 'khrug stol ba gtso bor mdzad/ 'on kyang las ngan gyi rba klong drag pos bdas pa'i skye bo 'phar 'gro'i rigs can na kra'i mgrin par

188'jug 'dod kyis tshur rgol gyi sde gzar 'ga' zhig byung ba rnams bka' khrims sgyur ba'i byed po bsod nams rab brtan sogs kyis zhi drag gi sbyor ba du mas bzlog par byas/ khri chen 'di nyid ni rnam dkar dge ba'i las la mchog tu brtson zhing / khyad par gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor lhar mdzad do/ /de rjes lha ngag gi dbang phyug dga' ldan rab tu brtan pa mi /gyur rnam par rgyal ba khri thog tu byon te/ phun sum tshogs pa'i mnga' thang 'gog pa med pa'i snang ba rab tu rgyas so/ /smras pa/ mchod sbyin brgya yis 'chi med dbang po'i sar//skabs gsum rigs kyi bdag por dbang sgyur na// nor 'dzin chos bzhin skyong ba'i legs byas kyis//stong gsum kun kyang rang gir byas kyis dogs//e ma khyod kyis sde bzhi'i nor//bsod nams gser gyi 'khor lo yis//drangs pa'i 'dzad med gan mdzod 'di//re ba skong ba'i dpag bsam dbang //zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //wa༅༅/ /de yang gnam bskos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs gong ma se chen gan gyi lung gis kha ba'i rdal mang yongs su brtsegs pa'i bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams mtha' dag rshapal ldan sa skya pa la phul te/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sa la mchod yon rnam gnyis zhes grags shing / de nas ba'i 'greng ba bcu

189phrag bdun gyi phyogs su nye ba na/ gang gis kyang gzhom gzhig nus pa'i go skabs phra mo tsam yang ring da spangs pa'i bsod nams kyi dpung pa can/ sa'i tshangs pa ta'i si tu byang chu/ rgyal mtshan gyis gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i dpa' mdzangs rtal phod pa'i rnam dpyod kyis bod yangs pa'i sa kun la dbang sgyur ba nas brgyadro / dus yun ring po'i bar du dpal phag the gru pa'i sde srid kyi bka' khrims gdags dkar po gcig gis 'og ta khyab tshul sngon da brjod ma thag pa de lta nadrong / zhabs drung gong ma cherno po zhing khams (zhan du 'pho ba'i tshul bstan pa'i mjug tu/ phag gru'i mtshan don mi rgyug pa dang / glo bur gyi rgyal po zhig 'byung ba sogs dus 'grig pas/ 'phreng mgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi thugs rje chen po padma'i dbang phyug gi lung bstan du/smyo sgra snyan 'dra ba'i gnas sgo ru nga'ajig rten dbang phyug sprul pa nyid 4ar ba'i ming 'dzin byung gyur na byusto byang glo bur rgyal po byed 4sgrub pa snying po'i bstan pa 'dzugs 4mi lo lnga bcur bde la 'god geskye ba'i rten 'brel ma 'grig na ༄yul de rang 'pho gud pa dang sgomatha' ma rlung gis 'khyer du nye ོ zhes sde pa 'phreng mgo ba'i mi ngo zhig gis glo bur gyi rgyal po byed pa'i lung bstan dang / gnang rtse nas kyi gsang ba'i lung bstan du/ zu gtsang phyogs rgyal po padma'i ming can 'byung 4sku tshe mthar phyin bdud dbang ma gyur na dnghazhes pa lhad bcug pa min na rin spangs pa'i zas padma dkar pos bod spyi'i rgyal po byed par bshad pa sogs ni rten 'brel 'phyags pas thog tu ma phebs la/ pad ma'i rgyal tshab mnga' ris paṇa chenag dang rigs 'dzin legs ldan pa'i bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus kyi lung bstan du 'dzam gling shar sto'i —phyogs mtshams su stobadud mo no myur nag mo la 4bu dgu skyes nas 'dzam gling 'joms 4khyad par bod yul gangs can 'dir sgom 'ongs bzhi bcur

190nye dus su 4bdud sprul dgu dang de blon dgu 4btsan mo phyi nang las byed dgu stobang 'phrin dbu gtso dmag dpon dgunadagu dgu brgyad cu rtsa gcig gisanga'agro kun kha lo thur du 'khridangaces pa'i dus rtags thog tu khel te/ rin spangs pa'i blon po zhing gis bsam 'grab rtse'i rdzong dpon gyi thog snar thang pa/༄ nor khyung pa/ brgya tsho ba sogs rnye byang gi dpon rigs mang po dang 'brel btags byas pa'i sde pa rong par 'bangs gyen log gis/sde gzar lan snga snyi kha yar du byang ba'i mthar je 'phel du song ste/ gtsang stod rgyal po'i lung gis dbus gzhutsang mtha' dag rim gyis chab 'og tu bcug pa'i mnga' thang gi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dag ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor seng ge mo'i bu'i mgrin par chud pa ltar/ mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag cig car du rang gir 'dzin pa'i byed po ni/ rtsod das kyi 'khor los sgyur ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ste/ 'di nyid ni/ /ter ston dri med lhun po'i lung bstan las/ 6spyir yang mtha' dmag lan bdun mtha' ma la stobadzra pā ṇi'i sprul pa'i rgyal po zhig 4bod khams dar cig bde la sbyor ba 'byung4 zhes gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje mi'i srid pa'i zlos gar can yin par lung gis zin pas/ byang sems 'phags pa snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'gro ba'i don da bsams bzhin chos ldan rgyal por skye ba bzung nas phan bde'i 'od brgya phyogadro bcur 'gyed pa ste/ gang zhig tha mal gyi skye bo rang nyamasakyis spyod pa'i snang tshul gyi mun pa mtha' dag rgyang du bsrings pa ni gor ma chag la/ de yang byang phyogs hor sog gi rgyal khams na sde chen po grangs med pa yod pa'i ya gyal/ o rod tsho ba bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan/ ho shod kyi dpon po ha na'i la jo mo a ha'i ha thun blangs par sras lnga byung ba'i gsum pa

1 1rgyal po 'di nyid chu pho rta'i lo la 'khrungs/ mtshan tho rol pa'i har btags so/ /dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe/ mgo dkar gyi dmag kṣiṃ phrag tsam gyi steng du/ dmag rnams kyi sna drangs te mchongs pas pha rol gyi dpung tshogs mtha' dag 'jig brten snyi ma'i ltad mo dus gcig tu myong bar byas pa'i graṭa pas/ srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu mi'i yul du rgyu ba'i 'gran zla gnyis pa byas so/ /de skabs yul phyogs de dag mtha' 'khob las kyang ches mtha' 'khob tu gyur pa kla klo'i rgyal khams lta bur gnas pa las/ sog po'i yul gru gzhan dag tu/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang /gser gyi rgyal po mchod yon zung gcig la brten nas dam pa'i chos dar zhes pa'i choso kyi ming tsam thos 'dzin gyi rgyan du gyur pas yid dga' spro dang bcas te phyogs der phyag btsal bas dpul pa skrangs pa tsam du gyur cing / bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa ni/ lha tho ri gnyan shal la gnyan po gsang ba byung ba bzhin cino/ /me rta dgung lo nyer lngar slebs pa'i tshe/ yum grongs pa'i rkyen gyis mkho dgu'i 'byor pa mtha' dag mchog dman gyi skye bo rnams la sbyin par btang zhing / de yang tshe 'di'i snyan grags dang / rnam smin lan la re ba tsam ma yin par/ slob dpon zla grags kyis/ zu sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos gtong zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor gsum bden stong gi rtsis zin pa'i 'phaṭa chen dam pa'i rnam thar ro/ /byang 'phags rnams ni gzhan don du 'gyur tshe dmyal ba'i me 'obs kyang mtho ris kyi dga' ba'i tshal bzhin du 'jug par mdzad pa ni chos nyid de/ de skabs khar kha dang so rod phan tshun du g.yul rlabs po che bshams pa'i 'khrug long gis/ srog gcod pa'i sdig pa'i las rngam po ches/ ngan song mu mtha' med pa'i nags klung stag por bskyur ba'i sbyor ba la brtson pa dag la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje che/ po'i gzhan dbang

193khri zag bzhi dang bcas pa ming gi lhag mar btang / shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun mnga' 'og tu bsdus te chos srid gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas mnga' 'bangs rnams bde bar bskyangs/ rim gyis nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams su byon/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher spel ba'i dga' ston bsgrubs/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du/ rgyal phran kun gyi cod pan du bgrod byed zung nye bar 'god pa'i ngal sor mdzad pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i mtshan dang las ka sogs mngon par blangs te/ phyir lam gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs/ de dgongs nyer bedun yin na'ang / srod kyi dus rdo'u phra mo tsam yang mthong ba'i mun pa zhin tu dkar ba byung bas/ bstan srid mtha' dag dkar 'jam du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel 'grig de skabs bod dang bod chen po mtha' dag mnga' 'og tu chug pa'i mtshan ltas legs pa'ang 'ga' zhig byung 'dug glang lo'i dgun thog mtsho khar phyir byon/ de yang bar khams su be ri don yod kyis/ kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i rjes su zhugs pa mtha' dag la nye bar 'tshe zhing / bon kho na spel ba la brten/ sa yos hor zla lnga pa'i nang du be ri'i thog tu dpung tshogs rnams bteg mnga' 'bangs phal cher blangs/ lcags 'brug zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la/ be ri dpon po sogs mtha' btsan por bros pa rnams kyang / gang gis bsod nams kyi lcags kyu rnon pos/ khab len rdo ba dang lcags phye'i snang tshul ltar khrims kyi do ra chen por yongs su bcug bde ba'i rtsa rkyen mtha' dag gnas nas dbyung / sa dge/ kur 'brug stag lung pa sogs kyi bla dpon khrims dong du tshud pa rnams bton te rang gnas su bskyal/ 'jang rgyal po tshun chad kyi skye rga rnams kyis nor gyi dpya khrul phul zhing gus 'dud lhur blangs/ de nas cudabus gtsang gi phyogs su dpung gi

194tshogs bshams par mngon du phyogs pa ni/ mnga' ris sku mched kyi gter lung du/ 6 khyad par gdug pa sbrul gyi lo shar dus geganam rtags 'od dkar skya rengs yang yang sharangagaza' skor 'khrug cing byang du hor sog g.yo sgo'ol kha'i phyogs su rkyen byas 'khrug sgodabus gtsang sde 'khrug 'gro rnams nyam thag 'gyur ngas g.yos nad rims lo gsum lo nyes 'byung 4lo dgu'i bar du dbus gtsang dbu rur 'tshogs 4khrug gi char pa lo bdun bar du 'bab co ces dang / yol mo sprul sku'i gter gsar du/ 6 yos kyi lo la ngal so byed nga'abrug gi lo la 'brug ltar sdirangasbrul la sbrul shun bzhin du 'thor 4de phyir yos bu'i lo la long4 zhes pa'i dus rtags dang mtshungs par dpung tshogs bye ba phrag brgya'i g.yul bshams te/ sto phyogs gshin rje'i mthar thug pa tshun dbang du bsdus/ chu rta zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la/ bod shing sgo can yongs kyi rgyal blon rnams kyang nga rgyal gyi gdong pa smad de gus 'dud lhur len gyi sbyor ba la nye bar zhugs/ chu shel gyi dbang po nag pas nya ba/ dus 'khor ba'i lo'i thog ma'i das tshes nas bod chol ka gsum gyi rgyal por gyar te/ bka' khrims kyi gdabs dkar po srid rtse'i bar da 'khor/ ris༄ bralagyi grub pa'i mtha' rnams gal gus 'dud lhur len gyi lha'e pa'i bsam pa mnga' na'ang /spur srid rnams kyis byed spyod ma mkhas par brten/ shar phyogs kong po'i yul tshun dpung shed kyis spyod/ gter ston 'ja' tshon pas rang gter du slob dpon chen po'i sprul par bstan yod ces ngos bzung / rgya gar gyi rgyal po kho shing / bal yul yam bu'i rgyal po/ mnga' ris rgyal po sogs mtha'i rgyal po mang pos kyang / yul lugs kyi skyes mang du phul/ de yang ratna'i bstan pa spyi lung du/ lha 'bri yi rwa co phag gi mjug ma can 4gung gi tshang 'cha' sa yis zas za zhing snyo :zhes pa'i 'og tu/ 6 dbus gtsang thams cad sku yi mnga' 'og

195'du 4de lta'i bstan pa mi lo drug cu 'byung nga zhes pa 'bri gung pa dang phag gru'i bstan pa g.yag tsam las rwa co dang mjug ma lus pa'i tshod tsam gyi dus rtags dang gnas tshad bstan no/ /de yang rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i thugs rje'i bdud rtsi gang gi gsang ba gsum gye za ma tog tu bltams pas chos srid mtha' dag gser gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i dpal la 'gran pa 'di bzhin ༵/sapa/ dbyangs gsal sdeb kyis sra bar bcings pa'i lcags ri'i khor yug dbus na mngon mtho glegs bu'i rin cen rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ba gam na//'gal ba'i khur mang gya rgyu'i tshul spangs legs bshad khams kyi dngas ma kun bsdus tshar du dngar ba'i deb ther ri dwags mig can ma//nyams 'gyur 'jo sgeg gar gyi rnam rol bcad lhag spel ma'i dbyangs bdun lhur len tshig don ma 'dres zu/ mig dbang gzhu ltar 'khyug cing //mngon brjod spu dum lha ra'i 'phreng mdzes gtam rgyad mgo skyes g.yon 'phyang ma 'di blo ldan brgya byin dag larsha gzhan gyi spyod yul min// ka rardo ltar ya rabs mchog gi spyod tshul sgod du ca co'i ngag spangs khungs ldan lo rgyas dbus 'gyar ta la'i glegs bam ji bzhin rab gsal ba jo dzā yi pusta rsha//kha dog tshig don ma 'dres lang tsho rnam par bkra ba'i cha shas

196 yongs rdzogs snyan tshig bsil zer mdangs kyi tha gru kun khyab sgra 'dzin bdud rtsis pha rol shes ldan dga' ston che//ga dza lta bu'i dregs pa'i thun po legs bshad skyes las ja chang btung ba 'ba' zhig don du gnyer phyir da lta'i dus kyi snang tshul 'di la ba glang spyod las gzhan mi brin//nga zhes stobs nor snyems pas 'gying yang shes ldan rig pa'i nya gar gzhal tshe snyi dang yang ba'i mtha' bral na ra'i dbus na g.yung por mthong bas ma dmad 'gro ba shin tu dkon//tsa ko ra yi lus 'degs blo yis shes bya'i mkha' la bgrod tshe zha bo ji bzhin mthu dang bral yang ra gan gser gyi thol can 'ga' zhig gis/tsha zer la sogs grang dro'i 'jigs pa khyad bsad ba bas rnams gtan bde za bar byed pa gor ma chag mod la lar 'di snang rnam dpyod tshul dang bral//dza ṭa'i cod pan chos rgyal mes dbon 'khon rigs rlangs sogs grags snyan 'a 'ud srid pa'i rtse mo kun tu sha shi'i 'od 'dzin blo gsal tshogs rnams kyis//wa ler sgrog 'dod sems kyis bskul bas bsngags brjod rgyud mang thu blangs ya mtshan dpal gyis skabs gsum pa rnams sa la blta phyir rgya skar thol gyis lhags//ha cang sa che/ skyong ba'i chos ldan rgyal po a shā yi ljon pa'i dbang po dar ba'i mchog/ha ri tsan dan dpung pa skyes kyi dbus mtho a ga ru yi rgyal phran kun gyis zla bral ba/ ha ri ka yi mgrin dbyangs khrims gnyis nga ros a ma'i yongs

'ad mnga' 'bangasayongasakyi'adabamatāzlo ———————07ha ༄har bzhad pa'i phul byang dga' ston bzang pos a phri ta yi snying po'i zil dngar dme na med//srid zhi'i khams kyi lha lam yangs pa'i ngos//rgyal dbang ye shes sgyu ma'i 'od dkar can//bsil ldan chu sgod so sor shar ba las/bka' khrims dge ba'i bcu drug cha nas rdzogs//gangs can kun gsal mdzes ma'i bzhin ras la//thub bstan nam mkha'i sgron me'i spyan gyi dkyus//lung rtogs khyog pa'i snang mdzod lcags kyu yis//phan bde'i 'od dkar gzhon nu ring nas 'gugs//srong btsan dge bcu'i legs lam zla tshes can// log spyod ra ri'i dri ma phyung ba'i 'od//grags ston ral par spud tshe mgrin sngon can//sa bla'i rdzongs su song zhes lha rnams gleng /yid srubs kyis brlams sdig lta'i sems 'chang rigs//legs byas snang ba 'gog tshe khri srong lhas//thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis spel bas dge legs 'od//spur rgyal yangs pa'i sa la kun tu 'bar//ral pa'i zur phud bla bar gris pa mkhar// thun mtshams lang tsho'i sde yis legs 'khyud pas//bdud sde'i rgyal mtshan nags gyi me khyer dag/

198gangs ldan ra ba'i ngos las phyi rol brgal//ma rig stag por 'phyan byed dgra sde'i lhar//mngon dror 'khon pa'i bdud rtsi bod yul thong //'thungs pas chos srid bdag po sa skya pa//stobs ldan sgra gcan gnyis pa sa 'dir snang //rin cen bdun gyi 'dod rgur mnga' sgyur ba'i//sa dbang rgyal po'i go sar gnam gyi mthongs//sgo 'phar yangs pa'i tho nas bum bzang gis//spyi bor dbang bskur sde srid phag mo gru//me ma sngon byon sa spyod lha rnams kyis//bod 'bangs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i phan bde'i 'od//spros tshe nyin byed bdag gis ci bya zhes//gnod sbyin phyogs kyi 'khrig pa'i khyim du bros//khrims gnyis srab kyis ma gcun rengs pa'i gnyar//drang thig 'dzam bu gser gyi 'khor lo yis//mnan tshe ngan spyod skye po'i bag yangs kun//bkres skom gdung bas mnar lus ji bzhin snyam//brnag nus las 'das pha rol rgol ba'i g.yul//rnam pa ra bcom pa'i mgo 'phreng khrug gis brlan//lan gcig min par gsher ba'i dmar 'od kyi//rgod ma kha de rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru yibs//

100gser mngal stobs la skyigs 'dzin 'byor pa'i mdzod//gcig tu bsdus 'dra'i srid kun dge phyogs su//bsgyur bas rnam smin dkar tha'i thigs pa 'bum//'dzag byed dam pa'i spyod tshul mid du byung //mthon po'i mnga' thang phun tshogs dpal 'byor kun//bkod pas khyad 'phags rnam dbyon dbyar rnga'i sgros//che ba'i rnam thar bzang po'i gtsug phun can/ ya rabs dga' ston rnam bkra'i gshog rlabs ngom//kye ma thos bsam bdud rtsi mal bor nas//ngan g.yo zang zing rnyogs ba'i bza' btung gis//sto ba khengs pa'i dregs ldan mthon po'i khrir//'dzegs kyang tha ga pa dang khyad par ci//ya rabs tshal du rigs rus cho 'brang gi/yongs 'du'i smon pa rgyas pa mid byung yang 5che ldan bya ba'i spyod tshul mi shes na//gser skyogs sgod du ngan skyugs blug dang mtshungs//mkhas dang grub pa'i skye bar khas 'che nas//'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros mthu dman na//gnod sbyin nor la spyod pa tshe 'phos nas//dbul po'i khyim du skyes dang khyad par ci// mi 'dzad stobs 'byor gter la mnga' bsgyur yang //

200'di phyi'i phun tshogs bsgrab pa'i rnam dpyod mig longs tshe sa 'og gnas rngu'i klu tshogs dang //srang la bteg tshe snyi yang gang gis 'byed//khungs ldan lo rgyus mthong bar rig lam nas//'dren pa'i rnam 'byed shes rab mthu bra mang //dmug long gcig bur rgyu ba'i gom stobs bzhin//'gal 'du'i khur gyis snyi ba'i glegs bam mang //lo rgyus gzhu la drang po'i rgyud drangs nas//legs bshad 'dab ldan g.yo ba'i nyag bran can//mi shes rmongs pa'i snying la phog srid kyang //gzur gnas mkhas pas mthong tshe sgo ba 'phel//mi mjed zhing gi gangs ri'i spo la sde bzhi'i rtsal gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtho ris rgyal po gdong lnga'i dbang //rim par byon la bsngags chig susnyi'i sgra yi gdub sil 'khrol bas ya rabs mdun sa'i kha rgyan spel legs 'di//shes bya'i rba klong yid mtshor rol pa'i bande tshangs dbang sras mos bzhad pa'i 'dzum ldan legs bshad gter mdzod kyis//mi bdag gsung gi ri bo man tta ra yis bskul ltar dpyad gsum dag pa'i 'chi med lus ba'i pasmo bskrun//gangs can 'dzin ma'i dpyid kyi mngam khur las//blo gros yal 'dab dar ba'i shes ldan rnams//ngo mtshar gtam gyi legs bshagaskye 'dod na//

201deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dbyangs 'di bsten//thub bstan kun gsal mdzes ma'i khor yug tu//rung mthun gos kyis thun mtshams zol bston nas//nges gsang thag pa'i yang rtse sngo skyes 'bras//nya yongs smin gang bu rgyas ba'i g.yur za ldem//de lta na yang nges dzilnga ldan gzugs//bshes gnyen dam pa'i sgyu da yi ngos//zlos gar bsgyur ba'i drin las rig pa'i gnas//sbo tshe dbyangs can dgyes pa'i 'dzum gyis bsu//lhag bsam rabadakar dri bral yid kyi mkhar//bstan bcos chu lha'i bu yi pusta nas//skye rgu'i nyon mongs 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad//legs bshad chu klung dang pos drungs 'byin cing //'dzam bu'i lang tsho dar babs 'khri shing gis//nyer mtshon yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong ba kun//rtsub 'gyur dpal gyi rno ngar rab zhi nas//dge bcu'i khrims kyis rdzogs ldan 'bod par shog/phan bde'i gdugs dkar zin pa'i rtse mo'i bar//khor yug bcig tu khyab pa'i legs pa'i lam//stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang ring lugs snying po'i brgyud//'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du 'bar gyur cig/ces gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs su mchog gsum dam par gtan gyi skyabs

202 su 'dzin cing / rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po'i bstan pa rin po che la phud dud sogs bla na med par bkur ba'i sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal blon rnams gtso bor brjod pa'i deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang / stobs kyi dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i bkas bskul bar brten/ bka' chems bka' khol ma/thugs rje chen po'i skor/ mkhas pa'i dbang po 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang /cal pa'i deb ther sogs khungs thub kyi yig tshang rnams la zhib mor dpyad/mkhas rlom drags ldan gyi khungs med blun tshig gi glegs bam rnams la dgag gzhag cung zad bgyis te/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha pa'i bstan la zhugs pas rgyu mtshan shes nas mi ldog pa'i dad pa thob kyang / 'thad dzin gyi grub pa'i mtha' rnams la chos spong gi sgrib pas ma sbags shing / bcu grag gi rig pa'i gnas la blo gros kyi 'jug pa cung zad shar ba'i za hor gyi rigs las lo rgyus smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ ming gzhan cangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho gsar pa'i sdes/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng gi drag po zhes pa lcags sprel lor bltams nis lo nyis stong drug brgya dang nyag ma gsum 'das pa/ 'phags pa'i yul du sum zhes pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir nyi mar grags shing / mahā mi na'i khyil khams su dbang thang dang bstan pa'i skad gu'i tha'i/ phyogs 'dir chu mo spug tu brjod pa'i glu dbyangs kyi cu ba'i phyogs snga ma'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes ri/ sman ljongs sa'i lte ba dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i sdong khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //mad rlu//
sa rtsa sdum ༅ rṣa/ ṭha tshom /shā sgo lko sa/sna 850mo/76 —1 0rta 17/lha la 172lam 3rnyirnyi129//shārta lhanashā 0 byazarsācan sa 110 mi(8)
